chars.name: Yoimiya
chars.desc: Her Elemental Skill turns her Normal Attacks into Pyro arrows. She stays on the field and keeps firing while her team protects and buffs her.

teams.name: Vaporize Fireworks

members.name: Yoimiya
members.does: Fires Pyro arrows with her Normal Attacks while her Skill is active.

members.name: Xingqiu
members.does: His Rain Swords strike alongside her attacks with Hydro, so her Pyro hits can Vaporize.

members.name: Bennett
members.does: His Burst field heals and gives an ATK bonus to whoever stands in it.

members.name: Layla
members.does: Her shield keeps Yoimiya safe so she can keep attacking.

teams.note: Layla’s shield also fires Cryo Shooting Stars, which can Freeze or Melt with the team’s Hydro and Pyro instead of Vaporize. Many players still pick her for the comfort of a strong shield.
teams.lesson: Set up the supporters first, then let Yoimiya attack inside Bennett’s field while Xingqiu’s Rain Swords keep adding Hydro for Vaporize.

rotation.name: Nights of Formal Focus
rotation.what: Creates the Curtain of Slumber shield.
rotation.why: A shield keeps Yoimiya from being knocked around while she attacks.

rotation.name: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen
rotation.what: Slashes the target with Hydro and gives Energy back to the team.
rotation.why: Puts Hydro on the target and helps charge his Burst.

rotation.name: Guhua Sword: Raincutter
rotation.what: Summons Rain Swords that follow the active character.
rotation.why: From now on, Rain Swords strike alongside Normal Attacks, adding Hydro even after he leaves the field.

rotation.name: Fantastic Voyage
rotation.what: Creates a field that heals and gives an ATK bonus.
rotation.why: Yoimiya gets the ATK bonus while she stands inside the field.

rotation.name: Niwabi Fire-Dance
rotation.what: Her Normal Attacks become Pyro Kindling Arrows for a short time.
rotation.why: Without it her arrows are Physical, so they can’t Vaporize.

rotation.name: Kindling Arrows
rotation.what: A string of Pyro arrows while Rain Swords add Hydro.
rotation.why: Pyro hitting a Hydro-soaked target triggers Vaporize, a big damage boost.

chars.name: Xiao
chars.desc: His Burst lets him leap high and crash down with Anemo plunges. His supporters set everything up first so his Burst window gets every buff.

teams.name: Wind Strike

members.name: Xiao
members.does: Repeated Anemo plunges during his Burst.

members.name: Faruzan
members.does: Her Burst lowers enemies’ Anemo RES and gives the team an Anemo DMG Bonus.

members.name: Sucrose
members.does: Her Skill makes Anemo Energy particles for Xiao and triggers Swirl.

members.name: Bennett
members.does: His Burst field heals and gives an ATK bonus.

teams.note: Xiao’s Burst slowly drains his HP, so Bennett’s healing helps him stay in the fight.
teams.lesson: Do all of the support setup first. Xiao’s Burst window is short, and every buff should already be active when he starts plunging.

rotation.name: The Wind’s Secret Ways
rotation.what: Lowers the target’s Anemo RES and gives the team an Anemo DMG Bonus.
rotation.why: Makes every Anemo plunge that follows hit harder.

rotation.name: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308
rotation.what: A small Anemo blast that pulls enemies in.
rotation.why: Anemo Energy particles go a long way toward charging Xiao’s Burst.

rotation.name: Fantastic Voyage
rotation.what: Creates a field that heals and gives an ATK bonus; its hit puts Pyro on the target.
rotation.why: Xiao starts his Burst inside the field with the ATK bonus.

rotation.name: Bane of All Evil
rotation.what: His attacks become Anemo and he can leap much higher.
rotation.why: This is his damage window; everything before it was preparation.

rotation.name: Plunging Attack
rotation.what: Jumps high and crashes down with Anemo.
rotation.why: Repeated high plunges are where most of his damage comes from. Anemo hitting Pyro triggers Swirl.

rotation.name: Plunging Attack (again)
rotation.what: Keeps jumping and plunging until his Burst ends.
rotation.why: Staying in the rhythm of jump, plunge, jump keeps his damage steady.

chars.name: Eula
chars.desc: During her Burst, her hits charge the Lightfall Sword. When it ends, it crashes down with a big Physical hit. Superconduct makes that hit land harder.

teams.name: Superconduct Lightfall

members.name: Eula
members.does: Builds Lightfall Sword stacks during her Burst for one huge Physical hit.

members.name: Fischl
members.does: Oz applies Electro from off the field, so Cryo hits trigger Superconduct.

members.name: Diona
members.does: Her shield protects Eula and her Cryo particles charge Eula’s Burst.

members.name: Lisa
members.does: Her Burst applies Electro, and her passive lowers enemy DEF by 15%.

teams.note: Superconduct lowers the target’s Physical RES by 40% for 12 seconds. That’s why this team pairs Cryo with Electro for a Physical character.
teams.lesson: Shield and Electro first, then Eula’s Burst. Every hit during the Burst adds a Lightfall stack, so land as many hits as you can before the sword comes down.

rotation.name: Icy Paws
rotation.why: Protects Eula, and her Cryo particles help charge Eula’s Burst.

rotation.name: Nightrider
rotation.what: Summons Oz, who keeps striking with Electro.
rotation.why: Oz keeps putting Electro on the target after Fischl leaves the field.

rotation.name: Lightning Rose
rotation.what: A rose that zaps nearby enemies with Electro.
rotation.why: Her passive lowers enemy DEF by 15%, and the Electro sets up Superconduct.

rotation.name: Icetide Vortex
rotation.what: A quick Cryo slash that gives her a Grimheart stack.
rotation.why: Cryo on an Electro target triggers Superconduct: Physical RES down by 40%.

rotation.name: Glacial Illumination
rotation.what: Summons the Lightfall Sword above the target.
rotation.why: Starts the window where her hits charge the sword.

rotation.name: Favonius Bladework - Edel
rotation.what: A string of heavy claymore swings.
rotation.why: Each hit adds a stack to the Lightfall Sword, so more hits mean a bigger finish.

rotation.name: Burst detonation
rotation.what: The sword crashes down with every stack she built.
rotation.why: The big Physical hit lands while Superconduct is lowering Physical RES.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Xingqiu slashes with water and dashes to cancel the end of the move.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen, dash-cancelled. Applies Hydro and makes particles for his Burst.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: His Burst summons Rain Swords that follow whoever is on the field; one attack starts them.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Guhua Sword: Raincutter; the N1 triggers the first wave. Rain Swords then strike alongside the active character’s Normal Attacks with Hydro.

ordered_actions.display_text: Elemental Skill, Elemental Burst, one attack
ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Bennett makes Energy with his Skill, then drops his healing and ATK-boost field.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Bennett boop. Bennett circle. Stand in circle.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Passion Overload for particles, then Fantastic Voyage: heals below 70% HP and adds an ATK bonus based on Bennett’s base ATK to the character inside.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: If her Energy is full and she isn’t wearing 4-piece Shimenawa’s Reminiscence, she can use her Burst here.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Burst if full. Skip if Shimenawa.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Ryuukin Saxifrage marks a target with Aurous Blaze and buffs teammates’ ATK (A4). Use it only if it’s ready and she isn’t wearing 4-piece Shimenawa’s Reminiscence.

required_conditions.text: Skip this if Yoimiya wears 4-piece Shimenawa’s Reminiscence
Only if her Burst is ready

ordered_actions.display_text: Two attacks, then Skill or Burst
ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Fischl summons Oz, her bird, who keeps zapping with Electro after she leaves.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Nightrider (Skill) one rotation, Midnight Phantasmagoria (Burst) the next; the N2 comes first. Oz attacks from off-field.

branch_conditions.text: Alternate each rotation: Skill (E) one time, Burst (Q) the next.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Her arrows turn into fire for 10 seconds. From now on, stay on her.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Niwabi Fire-Dance: 10s Pyro infusion. Leaving the field ends it.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Keep firing Normal Attacks until her Skill ends. Pyro hitting Hydro from the Rain Swords triggers Vaporize.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Shoot shoot shoot. Fire + water = Vaporize.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Normal Attack strings during Niwabi; Rain Swords and Oz follow. Pyro on a Hydro-affected target triggers Vaporize (and Overloaded with Electro).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Bennett taps his Skill again to make Energy for next time.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Passion Overload after Yoimiya’s field time, for particles toward the next rotation’s Burst.

rotations.energy_assumptions: Enough Energy Recharge for every Burst each rotation (see the build guide for Energy Recharge).
rotations.rotation_notes: One of Xiao’s strongest teams. The order changes with Faruzan’s constellation. Xiao C6 changes the combo, so it isn’t covered here.
common_mistakes: Using Xiao’s Skill during his Burst for Energy: it makes none then.
Switching out of Xiao before his Burst ends.
Skipping a healer: Furina and Xiao both drain HP; Xianyun covers it here.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Furina calls her salon helpers, then starts her party: the team deals more damage as HP goes up and down.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Furina friends out. Party time. Team hit harder.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Salon Solitaire (dash-cancelled), then Let the People Rejoice: Fanfare stacks from HP changes give a team DMG Bonus for most of Xiao’s field time.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Xianyun leaps, plunges, then uses her Burst. Her buff follows Xiao and boosts his plunges.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Bird lady jump. Bird lady buff. Xiao plunge stronger.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: White Clouds at Dawn into its plunge, then Stars Gather at Dusk: a Plunge DMG Base Bonus and CRIT buffs that follow the active character, plus healing.

ordered_actions.display_text: Skill, Burst, then a charged shot
ordered_actions.simple_explanation: At low constellations Faruzan goes after Furina and Xianyun: Skill, Burst, then her special charged shot.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Wind Realm of Nasamjnin, The Wind’s Secret Ways (Anemo DMG Bonus and Anemo RES shred), then the Hurricane Arrow charged shot. The order for C0–C1 Faruzan.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Xiao uses both Skill charges first, while they still make Energy.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Two Lemniscatic Wind Cycling casts before the Burst; particles stop during Bane of All Evil, so this is the last chance to funnel.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Mask on. From here, stay on Xiao for the whole 15 seconds.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Bane of All Evil: 15s, Anemo infusion and plunge DMG bonus; ends if he leaves the field.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Jump and plunge again and again. Anemo hitting Hydro from Furina triggers Swirl.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Jump. Fall. Jump. Fall. Many times.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: The recommended plunge spam for this team: about 12 high plunges and 2 low plunges (JhP / JlP). Plunges stagger enemies and never hurt Xiao.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Raiden places her Eye, which boosts Burst damage and adds Electro to teammates’ hits.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Transcendence: Baleful Omen: Burst DMG Bonus to the party and coordinated Electro attacks, which set up Superconduct.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Zhongli holds his Skill for a strong shield.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Dominus Lapidis (Hold): Jade Shield and RES shred nearby.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Rosaria’s Skill makes Cryo Energy for Eula.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Ravaging Confession: Cryo particles for Eula.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: A quick tap gives Eula her first Grimheart stack. Cryo on the Electro target triggers Superconduct.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Tap. One stack. Ice + zap = Superconduct.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Icetide Vortex (Press): +1 Grimheart. Cryo on an Electro-affected target triggers Superconduct (−40% Physical RES for 12s).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Rosaria’s Burst keeps hitting with Cryo while Eula is on the field.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Rites of Termination: off-field Cryo and CRIT Rate share (A4).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: The Lightfall Sword appears. Her Skill comes back with a second Grimheart stack.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Glacial Illumination; Wellspring of War-Lust resets Icetide Vortex and adds 1 Grimheart (now 2).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Four swings, each one charging the sword.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Swing swing swing swing. Sword bigger.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Each damaging hit adds 1 stack (max once per 0.1s).

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Hold her Skill to spend both Grimheart stacks: a mini Lightfall Sword and lower enemy Physical resistance.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Hold. Spend stacks. Mini sword boom.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Icetide Vortex (Hold) with 2 Grimheart: RES shred, Icewhirl Brands (which also add stacks) and Roiling Rime’s Shattered Lightfall Sword.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Four more swings, then the sword crashes down by itself.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: The default combo (tE Q N4 hE N4) reaches about 13 stacks without Attack SPD buffs. The sword detonates when its 7s ends.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Rosaria’s Skill again for more Cryo Energy.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Ravaging Confession for particles.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: A couple of swings on Eula to collect the Energy.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Eula N2 to absorb particles.

ordered_actions.simple_explanation: Raiden finishes with her own Burst combo.
ordered_actions.razor_explanation: Raiden big sword. Slash slash slash.
ordered_actions.detailed_explanation: Secret Art: Musou Shinsetsu, then 3 × (N3 + Charged Attack); restores Energy to the team.

abilities.name: Firework Flare-Up
abilities.canon: Fires up to 5 consecutive bow shots. A fully charged Aimed Shot also releases up to 3 homing Kindling Arrows that deal Pyro DMG, but not while Niwabi Fire-Dance is active.
abilities.simple: Her regular bow shots. With her Skill on, they turn into fire arrows, and that is where almost all of her damage comes from.
abilities.razor: Shoot. Shoot more. Fire on = fire shoot. Fire shoot = good.
abilities.detailed: Up to 5 Normal Attack hits. Charge level 2 Aimed Shots add up to 3 homing Kindling Arrows (Pyro), which share ICD with infused Normal Attacks and are not created during Niwabi Fire-Dance. Infused Normal Attacks make up roughly 92–96% of her damage, so Normal Attack is her top talent.
abilities.interacts: Niwabi Fire-Dance (makes them Pyro), Tricks of the Trouble-Maker stacks, C6 extra arrows
abilities.mistakes: Charged shots during Niwabi Fire-Dance: they make no Kindling Arrows then, so keep pressing Normal Attack.
abilities.cons: C6 adds a 50% chance of an extra arrow on each Normal Attack during Niwabi Fire-Dance.

abilities.name: Niwabi Fire-Dance
abilities.canon: For 10s, Normal Attack arrows become Pyro Blazing Arrows with increased damage. Cooldown 18s. Leaving the field ends it.
abilities.simple: Turns her normal shots into stronger fire arrows for 10 seconds. Stay on the field: switching out ends it early.
abilities.razor: Press E. Arrows go fire. No leaving. Leave = fire gone.
abilities.detailed: 10s duration, 18s cooldown. Blazing Arrows convert her Normal Attacks to Pyro with a Skill-level DMG multiplier. About 4 Energy particles over the duration (1 per proc, 2s ICD). Ends when she leaves the field. Blazing Arrows snapshot, so arrows already in the air keep the bonus if she swaps right before they land.
abilities.when: After your supports have put out their buffs and off-field damage
abilities.interacts: Bennett’s Burst field, Xingqiu’s Rain Swords (Vaporize), her A1 stacks
abilities.mistakes: Pressing it before setting up teammates: the 10 seconds tick away while she waits.
abilities.cons: C3 raises its level by 3. C4 lowers its cooldown by 1.2s each time her own Aurous Blaze explodes.

abilities.name: Ryuukin Saxifrage
abilities.canon: Deals AoE Pyro DMG and marks one enemy with Aurous Blaze. While it lasts, attacks from other party members (not Yoimiya) that hit the marked enemy set off a Pyro explosion, at most once every 2s. Costs 60 Energy.
abilities.simple: A fire blast that puts a mark on one enemy. When teammates hit that enemy, it explodes with extra fire. It also boosts teammates’ ATK (her 4th ascension passive).
abilities.razor: Big boom. Enemy gets sticker. Friends hit sticker. Sticker go boom.
abilities.detailed: 60 Energy, 15s cooldown. Aurous Blaze (10s) triggers on hits from other party members against the marked enemy: Pyro AoE, standard ICD, once every 2s. It moves to a nearby enemy if the target dies, does not jump to new waves, and does nothing if the first hit misses. The Burst is only about 4–8% of her damage, so rotations use it only when it’s ready.
abilities.use: Extra Pyro from teammates and a team ATK buff
abilities.when: Before her Skill, only if her Energy is full
abilities.interacts: Summer Night’s Dawn (team ATK), Shimenawa’s Reminiscence (which spends her Energy)
abilities.mistakes: Holding the whole rotation for it. It is optional, and is skipped when she wears 4-piece Shimenawa’s Reminiscence.
abilities.cons: C1 makes Aurous Blaze last 4s longer and gives her +20% ATK when a marked enemy is defeated. C5 raises its level by 3.

abilities.name: Tricks of the Trouble-Maker
abilities.canon: During Niwabi Fire-Dance, each Normal Attack arrow that hits gives +2% Pyro DMG Bonus for 3s, up to 10 stacks.
abilities.simple: Every fire arrow that hits makes the next ones a little stronger, up to +20%.
abilities.razor: Hit. Stronger. Hit. Stronger. Ten hits = strongest.
abilities.detailed: +2% Pyro DMG Bonus per hit during Niwabi Fire-Dance, 3s duration, max 10 stacks (20%). Multi-arrow hits can add two stacks.
abilities.interacts: Summer Night’s Dawn reads these stacks
abilities.mistakes: Stopping to swap mid-combo resets the build-up.

abilities.name: Summer Night’s Dawn
abilities.canon: Using Ryuukin Saxifrage gives nearby party members (not Yoimiya) +10% ATK for 15s, plus 1% more for each Tricks of the Trouble-Maker stack she has when she uses it.
abilities.simple: Her Burst gives her teammates an ATK boost, bigger if she used it right after attacking with her Skill.
abilities.razor: Burst = friends strong. More stacks = friends stronger.
abilities.detailed: +10% ATK to other party members for 15s on Burst, plus 1% per A1 stack at cast (up to +20%). The buff lasts its full duration even after that character leaves the party.

abilities.name: Blazing Match
abilities.canon: Refunds some materials when crafting certain furnishings. Not used in combat.
abilities.simple: A crafting perk. Doesn’t affect fights.
abilities.detailed: Refunds a portion of materials when crafting Decoration, Ornament and Landscape-type furnishings. No combat effect.

abilities.name: Agate Ryuukin
abilities.canon: Aurous Blaze lasts 4s longer. Defeating an enemy marked by Aurous Blaze gives Yoimiya +20% ATK for 20s.
abilities.simple: Her Burst mark lasts longer, and defeating a marked enemy boosts her ATK.
abilities.razor: Sticker last longer. Kill sticker = Yoimiya strong.
abilities.detailed: +4s Aurous Blaze; +20% ATK for 20s when a marked enemy dies during the effect. Depends on her Burst, which most rotations use only when available.
abilities.cons: Power only; no rotation change.

abilities.name: A Procession of Bonfires
abilities.canon: When Yoimiya’s Pyro DMG crits, she gains +25% Pyro DMG Bonus for 6s, even while off-field.
abilities.simple: Her fire crits give her a big damage boost that is easy to keep up.
abilities.razor: Crit = more fire. Lots of crit = lots of fire.
abilities.detailed: +25% Pyro DMG for 6s on any Pyro crit, works off-field. Her largest damage gain besides C6, and close to always active.
abilities.cons: Power only; same buttons, same order.

abilities.name: Trickster’s Flare
abilities.canon: Niwabi Fire-Dance level +3 (max 15).
abilities.simple: Her Skill gets stronger.
abilities.razor: Skill level up. Arrows hit harder.
abilities.detailed: +3 Niwabi Fire-Dance levels, raising the Blazing Arrow multiplier.
abilities.cons: Power only.

abilities.name: Pyrotechnic Professional
abilities.canon: When Yoimiya’s own Aurous Blaze explodes, Niwabi Fire-Dance’s cooldown drops by 1.2s.
abilities.simple: Her Skill comes back a little sooner.
abilities.detailed: -1.2s Niwabi cooldown per own Aurous Blaze explosion. A small quality-of-life change that rarely limits rotation length.
abilities.cons: No rotation change.

abilities.name: A Summer Festival’s Eve
abilities.canon: Ryuukin Saxifrage level +3 (max 15).
abilities.simple: Her Burst hits harder.
abilities.detailed: +3 Burst levels; small effect because the Burst is a small part of her damage.
abilities.cons: Power only.

abilities.name: Naganohara Meteor Swarm
abilities.canon: During Niwabi Fire-Dance, Normal Attacks have a 50% chance to fire an extra Blazing Arrow dealing 60% of the original DMG (counts as Normal Attack DMG).
abilities.simple: Her fire arrows sometimes fire an extra arrow. Her best constellation.
abilities.razor: Sometimes two arrow. Two arrow better than one.
abilities.detailed: 50% chance of an extra 60% Blazing Arrow per Normal Attack during Niwabi. About 20–30% more damage outside Vaporize teams, closer to 12–15% in Vaporize because the extra arrows share ICD and can break her Vaporize pattern.
abilities.cons: Power; the button order stays the same.

abilities.name: Whirlwind Thrust
abilities.canon: Up to 6 spear strikes; a Charged Attack (upward thrust); and Plunging Attacks from mid-air. Xiao takes no damage from his own plunges.
abilities.simple: His spear attacks and his plunge from the air. During his Burst, the plunge is his main damage.
abilities.razor: Poke. Jump. Fall on enemy. Fall = damage.
abilities.detailed: Up to 6 hits, Charged Attack (25 Stamina), and Plunge / Low Plunge / High Plunge (High Plunge has the highest multiplier). His plunges never hurt him. Under his Burst, Charged Attacks share Anemo ICD with Normal Attacks.
abilities.interacts: Bane of All Evil’s jump boost and DMG bonus
abilities.mistakes: Using ground Normal Attacks during his Burst instead of plunging.
abilities.cons: C6 rewards plunges that hit 2 or more enemies with extra Skill charges.

abilities.name: Lemniscatic Wind Cycling
abilities.canon: Lunges forward and deals Anemo DMG. 2 charges, 10s cooldown, usable in mid-air. Makes Energy particles, except while his Burst is active.
abilities.simple: A fast wind dash that hits enemies. Use it before his Burst, because it makes Energy for him then.
abilities.razor: Wind dash. Two times. Before Burst = Energy. During Burst = no Energy.
abilities.detailed: 2 charges (C1: 3), 10s cooldown per charge. 3 Anemo particles per use, but particle generation is disabled during Bane of All Evil, so both charges are used before the Burst. Can be used mid-air.
abilities.use: Energy for his Burst and a bit of damage
abilities.interacts: Dissolution Eon: Heaven Fall (+15% Skill DMG per use)
abilities.mistakes: Saving Skill charges for during the Burst: they no longer make Energy then.
abilities.cons: C1 adds a third charge. C3 raises its level by 3. C6 refunds charges during his Burst.

abilities.name: Bane of All Evil
abilities.canon: Costs 70 Energy. For 15s Xiao jumps much higher, his attacks become Anemo (cannot be overridden), and his Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks deal more damage. He loses HP continuously. Leaving the field ends it.
abilities.simple: He puts on his mask for 15 seconds: huge jumps, wind attacks and much more damage, but it slowly drains his HP. Stay on field until it ends.
abilities.razor: Mask on. Jump high. Fall hard. HP go down. No leaving.
abilities.detailed: 70 Energy, 15s duration, 18s cooldown. Anemo infusion, greatly increased jump, Normal/Charged/Plunge DMG bonus (scales with Burst level), HP drain (2% current HP per second). The effects end when he leaves the field.
abilities.when: Last, after every teammate’s buff is active
abilities.interacts: Conqueror of Evil: Tamer of Demons, Faruzan and Xianyun buffs, Bennett healing
abilities.mistakes: Switching out early: the Burst ends immediately.
abilities.cons: C5 raises its level by 3. C6 changes what to do during it (see C6).

abilities.name: Conqueror of Evil: Tamer of Demons
abilities.canon: During Bane of All Evil, all DMG Xiao deals is increased by 5%, plus another 5% every 3s, up to 25%.
abilities.simple: The longer his Burst runs, the stronger he gets, up to +25%.
abilities.detailed: +5% DMG at Burst start, +5% per 3s, max 25% after 12s. Another reason to stay on field for the full Burst.

abilities.name: Dissolution Eon: Heaven Fall
abilities.canon: Each use of Lemniscatic Wind Cycling increases the DMG of later uses by 15% for 7s, stacking up to 3 times; new stacks refresh the duration.
abilities.simple: Using his Skill several times in a row makes each one stronger.
abilities.detailed: +15% Skill DMG per prior use within 7s, max 3 stacks, duration refreshes. Matters most for C6, where he uses many Skills in a row.

abilities.name: Transcension: Gravity Defier
abilities.canon: Reduces the party’s climbing Stamina use by 20%. Not used in combat.
abilities.simple: A climbing perk. Doesn’t affect fights.
abilities.detailed: -20% climbing Stamina for your party; does not stack with the same effect.

abilities.name: Dissolution Eon: Destroyer of Worlds
abilities.canon: Lemniscatic Wind Cycling gains 1 extra charge.
abilities.simple: One more Skill charge.
abilities.detailed: +1 charge. Only one charge recharges at a time, so the third use comes every other rotation; not a big damage gain.
abilities.cons: Changes Energy handling slightly; the button order stays the same.

abilities.name: Annihilation Eon: Blossom of Kaleidos
abilities.canon: While Xiao is in the party but off-field, his Energy Recharge is increased by 25%.
abilities.simple: He gains Energy faster while waiting off-field.
abilities.detailed: +25% ER while off-field. A negligible effect.
abilities.cons: No rotation change.

abilities.name: Conqueror of Evil: Wrath Deity
abilities.canon: Lemniscatic Wind Cycling level +3 (max 15).
abilities.simple: His Skill hits harder.
abilities.detailed: +3 Skill levels; matters more at C6.
abilities.cons: Power only.

abilities.name: Transcension: Extinction of Suffering
abilities.canon: When Xiao’s HP is below 50%, he gains +100% DEF.
abilities.simple: He gets tougher when his HP is low.
abilities.detailed: +100% DEF below 50% HP. Rarely matters.
abilities.cons: No rotation change.

abilities.name: Evolution Eon: Origin of Ignorance
abilities.canon: Bane of All Evil level +3 (max 15).
abilities.simple: His Burst gets stronger.
abilities.detailed: +3 Burst levels; small gain because DMG Bonus is additive.
abilities.cons: Power only.

abilities.name: Conqueror of Evil: Guardian Yaksha
abilities.canon: During Bane of All Evil, a Plunging Attack that hits at least 2 enemies immediately gives 1 Skill charge, and for 1s he can use the Skill ignoring its cooldown.
abilities.simple: Plunges that hit 2 or more enemies give back Skill charges, so he can chain many wind dashes. It changes how he plays.
abilities.razor: Fall on two enemy = free dash. Many dash.
abilities.detailed: On a Plunge hit against 2+ enemies during the Burst: +1 Skill charge and a 1s cooldown-free window. This shifts his play from plunge focus to Skill spam (3–4 Skills in succession) and to level Skill and Normal Attack evenly.
abilities.cons: Changes the combo during his Burst. The Coach doesn’t have a verified C6 combo yet.

abilities.name: Favonius Bladework - Edel
abilities.canon: Up to 5 claymore strikes (Physical). During her Burst, every hit that deals damage adds a stack to the Lightfall Sword.
abilities.simple: Her heavy sword swings. During her Burst, each swing charges up the Lightfall Sword.
abilities.razor: Swing. Swing. Each swing = sword bigger.
abilities.detailed: Up to 5 hits; each damaging hit during Glacial Illumination adds 1 Lightfall stack (max once per 0.1s; multi-hit attacks count per hit). Charged Attack drains Stamina; Plunges available.
abilities.mistakes: Dashing or swapping during the Burst: fewer hits means a smaller explosion.

abilities.name: Icetide Vortex
abilities.canon: Press: a Cryo slash that gives 1 Grimheart stack (max 2). Hold: consumes all Grimheart for an AoE Cryo hit that lowers enemies’ Physical and Cryo RES, plus one Icewhirl Brand per stack consumed. Press cooldown 4s, Hold 10s.
abilities.simple: Tap it to gain Grimheart stacks. Hold it to spend them: a big Cryo hit that makes enemies take more Physical damage.
abilities.razor: Tap = save. Hold = spend. Hold makes enemy soft.
abilities.detailed: Press: Cryo DMG, +1 Grimheart (max 2, gained at most every 0.3s), 4s CD. Hold: consumes Grimheart, AoE Cryo, Physical and Cryo RES down (24% at talent level 9) for 7s, one Icewhirl Brand per stack, 10s CD. Grimheart also gives DEF and persists through swaps.
abilities.use: RES shred and Grimheart for her A1
abilities.when: Tap before her Burst, Hold during it
abilities.interacts: Roiling Rime (2 stacks → Shattered Lightfall Sword), Wellspring of War-Lust (Burst resets it)
abilities.mistakes: Holding with fewer than 2 Grimheart: no Shattered Lightfall Sword.
abilities.cons: C1 adds +30% Physical DMG when Grimheart is consumed. C2 makes Hold’s cooldown the same as Press. C5 raises its level by 3.

abilities.name: Glacial Illumination
abilities.canon: Costs 80 Energy. Deals Cryo DMG and creates a Lightfall Sword for 7s that follows Eula. Her Normal Attack, Skill and Burst hits add stacks. When it ends, it explodes for Physical DMG that grows with stacks. Leaving the field makes it explode right away.
abilities.simple: She summons a giant sword. Every hit she lands during the next 7 seconds makes it stronger, then it crashes down for huge Physical damage.
abilities.razor: Eula make big sword. Eula hit lots. Big sword get stronger. Sword go BOOM.
abilities.detailed: 80 Energy, 20s CD (both reset at hitmark). Lightfall Sword lasts 7s, gains 1 stack per damaging hit at most every 0.1s (the Burst’s first hit gives none), and explodes at the end or when she leaves the field. Cannot be pre-funneled, so her Energy needs are high.
abilities.when: After buffs, Superconduct and shields are up
abilities.interacts: Superconduct (−40% Physical RES), Icetide Vortex Hold, Wellspring of War-Lust
abilities.mistakes: Swapping out during the 7 seconds: the sword explodes early with fewer stacks.
abilities.cons: C3 raises its level by 3. C4: +25% Lightfall DMG against enemies under 50% HP. C6: the sword starts with 5 stacks.

abilities.name: Roiling Rime
abilities.canon: If Holding Icetide Vortex consumes 2 Grimheart stacks, a Shattered Lightfall Sword is created and explodes immediately for 50% of a Lightfall Sword’s basic Physical DMG.
abilities.simple: Hold her Skill with 2 stacks and she drops a mini Lightfall Sword.
abilities.razor: Two stack, hold = mini sword boom.
abilities.detailed: Requires exactly 2 consumed stacks; damage is 50% of the Burst sword’s basic Physical DMG (counts as Burst DMG).

abilities.name: Wellspring of War-Lust
abilities.canon: Casting Glacial Illumination resets Icetide Vortex’s cooldown and gives 1 Grimheart stack.
abilities.simple: Her Burst refreshes her Skill and gives a Grimheart stack.
abilities.detailed: Burst cast resets the Skill CD and grants 1 Grimheart, which enables Tap → Burst → Hold for 2 stacks.
abilities.use: Lets her use Skill again inside the Burst

abilities.name: Aristocratic Introspection
abilities.canon: 10% chance of double output when crafting Character Talent Materials. Not used in combat.
abilities.simple: A crafting perk.
abilities.detailed: 10% chance to double Talent Material crafts. No combat effect.

abilities.name: Tidal Illusion
abilities.canon: Each time Grimheart stacks are consumed, Eula gains +30% Physical DMG for 6s; each stack consumed extends it by 6s, up to 18s.
abilities.simple: Spending Grimheart boosts her Physical damage.
abilities.detailed: +30% Physical DMG for 6s, +6s per extra stack consumed, max 18s. Works well with her normal combos.
abilities.cons: Power only; same order.

abilities.name: Lady of Seafoam
abilities.canon: Icetide Vortex Hold cooldown becomes the same as Press cooldown.
abilities.simple: Her Hold Skill comes back much sooner.
abilities.detailed: Hold CD reduced to match Press (4s). Niche: only useful when spamming Hold off cooldown.
abilities.cons: No change to the standard rotation.

abilities.name: Lawrence Pedigree
abilities.canon: Glacial Illumination level +3 (max 15).
abilities.simple: Her Burst gets stronger.
abilities.detailed: +3 Burst levels.
abilities.cons: Power only.

abilities.name: The Obstinacy of One’s Inferiors
abilities.canon: Lightfall Swords deal 25% more DMG to enemies below 50% HP.
abilities.simple: The sword hits weakened enemies harder.
abilities.detailed: +25% Lightfall DMG vs enemies under 50% HP. Not worth chasing on its own.
abilities.cons: Power only.

abilities.name: Chivalric Quality
abilities.canon: Icetide Vortex level +3 (max 15).
abilities.simple: Her Skill gets stronger.
abilities.detailed: +3 Skill levels (mainly more RES shred).
abilities.cons: Power only.

abilities.name: Noble Obligation
abilities.canon: Lightfall Swords start with 5 stacks, and her Normal Attacks, Skills and Bursts have a 50% chance to add an extra stack.
abilities.simple: The sword starts with 5 stacks and sometimes gains 2 per hit. Her strongest constellation.
abilities.razor: Sword start big. Sometimes double stack.
abilities.detailed: Starts at 5 stacks; 50% chance of +1 extra stack per qualifying hit. Her strongest constellation, and it allows earlier swaps for similar damage.
abilities.cons: Power; the Coach keeps the same order (no separate C6 rotation is recommended).

mitya.name: Mitya
mistakes: Not switching the Detection Core to the state the team needs: tapping his Skill again within 6s changes it.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Chain Reaction
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs a maximum of 3 attacks that deal Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG to the area in front after a short casting time.
Mitya will instead perform the special Charged Attack Gradient Detonation, which consumes no Stamina, if a Detection Core: Overload created by Mitya himself is currently on the field and he has at least 1 Gradient Beacon: Deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG to the area in front and continuously consumes Gradient Beacons while held. Each Gradient Beacon consumed deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG to the area in front that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE Electro DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Electro attacks and an Electro Charged Attack after a short cast.

abilities.name: Principle: Variable Detection
abilities.canon:
Conducts a theoretically relatively safe experiment at a theoretically relatively safe yield, dealing AoE Electro DMG and creating a Detection Core in different ways depending on whether the Skill is tapped or held.

Tapping the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection again within 6s after using it changes the Detection Core's state. The Detection Core's state can be changed in this way every 1.5s.
abilities.simple: Electro damage and a Detection Core. Tap the Skill again within 6s to change the Core’s state (every 1.5s at most).

abilities.name: Analysis: Gradient Theory
abilities.canon: Let the elements burst forth like inspiration itself! Deals AoE Electro DMG and creates 3 Gradient Beacons.
abilities.simple: Electro damage and 3 Gradient Beacons.

abilities.name: Baseline Stress Test
abilities.simple: The Detection Core gives a different buff by state; in Steady State the party gains 30 Elemental Mastery per Gradient Beacon.

abilities.name: Explosive Reagent: Safe Limits Exceeded
abilities.canon: The duration of Gradient Beacons is increased to 10s. Additionally, Mitya's CRIT Rate increases by 5% for 15s after creating a Gradient Beacon. This effect can stack up to 4 times.
abilities.simple: Gradient Beacons last 10s, and creating one gives him 5% CRIT Rate for 15s (up to 4 stacks).

abilities.name: Stellar Jubilee: Top-Secret Protocol
abilities.canon:
When party members trigger Superconduct, it will be changed to Stellar-Conduct. Stellar-Conduct reactions will no longer create Starlight Prisms, and will instead create 1 Gradient Beacon nearby every 1.5s for 3s. These Beacons can be carried by Mitya and transform the area around them into an even larger Polestar Field. Triggering another Stellar-Conduct reaction will refresh the duration of the aforementioned effects.
Additionally, the Base Stellar-Conduct DMG dealt by all nearby party members will be increased based on Mitya's Elemental Mastery: Every point of Elemental Mastery he has increases Base Stellar-Conduct DMG by 0.028%. The maximum Base DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%. While within a Polestar Field, Mitya will also enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state.
abilities.simple: In his party, Superconduct becomes Stellar-Conduct, which creates Gradient Beacons instead of Starlight Prisms.

abilities.name: Energy Catalysis
abilities.canon:
When destructible rocks are nearby, Detection Core: Steady State can quickly clear them.
Additionally, when Mitya is in the party, creating Prime Ice Construct: Basic Heat Source does not consume Kresnik Energy.
abilities.simple: His Steady State Core can clear destructible rocks nearby. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: The Observer Seeking What Is Missing
abilities.canon:
The maximum number of Gradient Beacons Mitya can carry is increased to 5. Using the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection additionally creates 1 Gradient Beacon.
While the Detection Core is present, your own active character's CRIT DMG is increased by 40%.
Additionally, Mitya regenerates 10 Elemental Energy when a Gradient Beacon is created. This effect can be triggered once every 8s.
abilities.simple: He can carry up to 5 Gradient Beacons, and his Skill makes 1 more.

abilities.name: The Matter That Slumbers Beyond Inertness
abilities.canon:
While the Detection Core is present, all opponents within the Polestar Field have their Cryo RES and Electro RES decreased by 20%.
Additionally, if the Detection Core created is:
·Steady State: All nearby party members gain 123 Elemental Mastery;
·Overloaded: Your own active character gains 234 Elemental Mastery.
abilities.simple: While his Detection Core is out, enemies in the Polestar Field lose 20% Cryo and Electro RES.

abilities.name: The Knotted String of Invariant Topology
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of the Elemental Skill Principle: Variable Detection by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: The Isotopes Born of Decay
abilities.canon: Detection Cores created by Mitya himself deals 1 instance of AoE Electro DMG equal to 300% of Mitya's Elemental Mastery to nearby opponents for every 5 Gradient Beacons consumed while it is on the field. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.
abilities.simple: His Detection Core deals Electro damage based on his Elemental Mastery for every 5 Gradient Beacons used.

abilities.name: The Periodic Law That Orders All
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Chain Reaction by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Normal Attack: Chain Reaction by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Elemental Transition at the Gate of Reason
abilities.canon:
Detection Core is enhanced. If the Detection Core:
 · Is in the Steady State: Detection Core deals 115% of its original DMG.
· Is Overloaded: There is a 34% chance to create 1 new Gradient Beacon whenever Mitya consumes a Gradient Beacon with the Detection Core.
Additionally, Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is Elevated by 20%.
abilities.simple: The Detection Core gets stronger in each state; for example, Steady State deals 115% of its damage.

fundamentals.simple: Mitya places a Detection Core whose state you can switch, and his Burst creates Gradient Beacons that power his passives.

valeriy.name: Valeriy
valeriy.role: Stellar support: Electro shield and buffs
mistakes: Using his special Charged Attack with little Impact Momentum: more Momentum gives his buff more power.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to leap forward and slam the ground, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
When Valeriy has at least 40 Impact Momentum, he will consume all Impact Momentum to instead perform the special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 sword strikes and a leaping slam Charged Attack that deals Physical damage. With enough Impact Momentum it changes.

abilities.name: Active Defense: Bastion Charge
abilities.canon:
Valeriy raises his shield cannon and charges forward, dealing AoE Electro DMG, gaining 40 Impact Momentum, and deploying a Supercharged Shield.
The Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption scales with Valeriy's ATK, and has 250% absorption efficiency against Electro DMG.
abilities.simple: He charges forward with Electro damage, gains 40 Impact Momentum and deploys a Supercharged Shield that is extra strong against Electro.

abilities.name: Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo
abilities.canon: Deals AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents and fires a Thunderburst Shell high into the air. The Thunderburst Shell disperses into a barrage of projectiles that rain down, dealing AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents.
abilities.simple: Electro damage, then a Thunderburst Shell bursts into a rain of Electro projectiles.

abilities.name: Advance With the Creeping Barrage
abilities.canon: Valeriy gains 5 Impact Momentum whenever another nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an Electro attack while the Thunderburst Shells from his Elemental Burst Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo are falling. He can gain up to 80 Impact Momentum in this way after each use of his Elemental Burst.
abilities.simple: While his shells fall, other active characters’ Electro hits give him 5 Impact Momentum each (up to 80 per Burst).

abilities.name: Into the Breach
abilities.simple: Spending more Impact Momentum on his special Charged Attack makes the Offensive Directive buff stronger.

abilities.name: Subzero Conditioning
abilities.canon: Valeriy enters the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state while within a Polestar Field.
abilities.simple: He enters Radiance: Stellar-Conduct while inside a Polestar Field.

abilities.name: Tundra Operational Intelligence
abilities.canon: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Snezhnaya (not including Nod-Krai) Expedition for 20 hours.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: The Cadence of Suppressive Fire
abilities.canon:
Valeriy regenerates 6 Elemental Energy after performing the special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment. For every 10 Impact Momentum consumed beyond 40 when performing this special Charged Attack, he regenerates an additional 1.5 Elemental Energy. Each time he performs Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment, he can regenerate up to 15 Elemental Energy in this way. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Additionally, each time Valeriy enters combat, the first time he uses his Elemental Skill Active Defense: Bastion Charge, he gains an additional amount of Impact Momentum equal to 150% of the amount normally gained.
abilities.simple: His special Charged Attack restores 6 Energy, plus more for extra Impact Momentum used.

abilities.name: Ranks That Charge as One
abilities.canon:
All nearby party members gain 100 Elemental Mastery for 18s after Valeriy uses his Elemental Skill Active Defense: Bastion Charge.
Additionally, while protected by a Supercharged Shield, if Valeriy is already at maximum Impact Momentum, any further Impact Momentum he would gain is instead converted into increased DMG Absorption for the shield. Each point of excess Impact Momentum increases the Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption by an amount equal to 8% of Valeriy's ATK. Up to 20 excess Impact Momentum can be converted in this way.
abilities.simple: After his Skill, the party gains 100 Elemental Mastery for 18s.

abilities.name: Vigilance at Close Quarters
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Normal Attack Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Fortitude Unshaken by Attrition
abilities.canon:
Impact Momentum's limit is increased by 30, and its charging efficiency is increased by 30%.
Additionally, the Ascension Talent Advance With the Creeping Barrage is enhanced: The maximum amount of Impact Momentum that can be gained from this Talent after using the Elemental Burst is 104. You must unlock the Ascension Talent Advance With the Creeping Barrage to gain access to this effect.
abilities.simple: Impact Momentum’s limit rises by 30 and it charges 30% faster.

abilities.name: Resolve to Divide and Destroy
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill Active Defense: Bastion Charge by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of the Elemental Skill Active Defense: Bastion Charge by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: The Strength to Breach Enemy Lines
abilities.canon: The special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment and Thunderburst Shells from Elemental Burst Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo are enhanced: Their DMG is increased by 100%, and opponents they hit have the CRIT Rate of Electro DMG they take increased by 10% for 7s. If the Electro DMG taken is Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, that DMG instance's CRIT DMG is also increased by 40%.
abilities.simple: His special Charged Attack and Burst shells deal 100% more damage and weaken enemies’ resistance to CRIT hits.

fundamentals.simple: Valeriy charges in with a shield, builds Impact Momentum, and spends it on a special Charged Attack.

varesa.name: Varesa
mistakes: Using her Charged Attack without the Skill first: the Skill makes the headbutt free and sets up the plunge.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: By the Horns
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Gotta try... to do battle like the greatest champion luchadors do! Varesa launches up to 3 strikes, dealing Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to headbutt opponents in front, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG and using the momentum to leap into the air.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon impact. If Varesa is in a combat state upon landing, or if the shockwave from her plunging attack hits an opponent, she will gain 25 Nightsoul points. She enters the Fiery Passion state upon reaching maximum Nightsoul points through this method.

Fiery Passion
In this state, Varesa's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will gain corresponding buffs:

Normal Attack
Fight like a superstar champion luchador! Launches up to 3 fierce strikes, dealing greater Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to slam into her opponents, dealing greater amounts of Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG and using the momentum to leap into the air.

Plunging Attack
Consumes all her Nightsoul points and slams down on the ground from mid-air, dealing DMG to opponents in her path and dealing greater amounts of Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon hitting the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Electro strikes. Her Charged Attack is a headbutt that launches her into the air, ready to plunge.

abilities.name: Riding the Night-Rainbow
abilities.canon:
With footwork swift as lightning and fierce as thunder, Varesa displays the true spirit of lucha libre, rushing forward a certain distance and dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG to opponents in her path.
After using this Skill, Varesa gains 20 Nightsoul points and gains the "Follow-Up Strike" effect: Varesa has increased interruption resistance during this time, and upon pressing her Normal Attack, she will quickly unleash a Charged Attack that does not consume Stamina. "Follow-Up Strike" will be canceled after Varesa uses a Charged Attack.
She will use different techniques based on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Quickly rush a certain distance forward.

Hold
Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and switches to Sudden Onrush mode.

Sudden Onrush
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. In this state, Varesa's Movement SPD and interruption resistance are increased. She can use terrain to execute flying leaps or consume additional Nightsoul points to traverse atop water or liquid Phlogiston while remaining immune to DMG from the latter.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Varesa
When she runs out of Nightsoul points, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will be canceled. When Varesa is in the Sudden Onrush state or Fiery Passion state, she will always be counted as being in the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Has 2 charges. When Varesa enters the Fiery Passion state, she will obtain an additional Tap charge of her Elemental Skill and its DMG will be increased.

Fiery Passion
· While not in the Fiery Passion state, Varesa can use Plunging Attacks to gain Nightsoul points. She will enter Fiery Passion when she reaches maximum Nightsoul points via this method, or when she uses her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent!
· While in the Fiery Passion state, her Normal Attacks, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst will gain unique buffs. She can also use a special Elemental Burst shortly after using a Plunging Attack.
· The Fiery Passion state lasts for up to 15s and will end when she runs out of Nightsoul points or after she leaves combat for a period of time.
abilities.simple: A lightning-fast rush that gives her 20 Nightsoul points and a Follow-Up Strike: her next Normal Attack becomes a free Charged Attack headbutt. Tap and Hold work differently.

abilities.name: Guardian Vent!
abilities.canon:
Leaps into the air before using the momentum of the drop to unleash a powerful flying kick, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG to opponents — just like those heroes of justice in woven scrolls for kids!
After using this Skill, Varesa's Nightsoul points will be restored to maximum and she will enter the Fiery Passion state.

In the Fiery Passion state, Varesa's Elemental Burst will deal a greater amount of Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG.

Additionally, she will briefly activate Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack while in her Fiery Passion state.

Apex Drive
Increases Varesa's interruption resistance. While affected by Apex Drive, Varesa can ignore her Elemental Burst CD and consume less Energy to use her special Elemental Burst, "Guardian Vent: Volcano Kablam": This causes her to use the especially powerful Plunging Attack, the "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," which deals Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG upon landing before causing her to exit Apex Drive. This DMG is considered Plunging Attack DMG.
Varesa will exit Apex Drive after using her Elemental Skill.
abilities.simple: A flying kick that refills her Nightsoul points and puts her in Fiery Passion, which makes her Burst hit harder. Plunging during Fiery Passion briefly activates Apex Drive.

abilities.name: Tag-Team Triple Jump!
abilities.canon:
After using the Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow, Varesa gains "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
During this time, when Varesa uses a Plunging Attack, the shockwave DMG dealt when she hits the ground is increased by 50% of her ATK. If Varesa is in the Fiery Passion state, this ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK instead.

The Rainbow Crash effect will be canceled once a ground impact hits an opponent, or when its duration expires.
abilities.simple: For 5s after her Skill, her plunge’s landing shockwave deals extra damage, and much more during Fiery Passion.

abilities.name: The Hero Twice-Returned!
abilities.canon: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Varesa's ATK increases by 35% for 12s. Max 2 stacks. Each stack's duration is counted independently.
abilities.simple: When a party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Varesa gains 35% ATK for 12s (up to 2 stacks).

abilities.name: Night Realm's Gift: A Torch That Incinerates Evil
abilities.canon:
After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted, Varesa will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain the Sudden Onrush mode from her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Varesa can be used. When the current active character is sprinting or in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Varesa will trigger the following: Varesa enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state, switches to Sudden Onrush mode, and obtains 20 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Varesa will not take fall DMG when using terrain differences to make leaps.
abilities.simple: When her Nightsoul points run out she keeps her rushing mode going with Phlogiston. In Natlan she can also use Nightsoul Transmission.

abilities.name: Blazing Heart, Singular Advance!
abilities.canon:
Varesa's Sprint speed is increased. When she is not in combat, her Sprint Stamina consumption will also increase.
Additionally, while in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, your party members will restore 20 Phlogiston when consuming food. This effect can occur once every 10s and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
abilities.simple: Faster sprinting, plus Phlogiston help for the party in Natlan. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Undying Passion
abilities.canon:
The effects of the Ascension Talent "Tag-Team Triple Jump!" are enhanced:
When performing the Special Plunging Attack "Thunderous Tornado Eruption," Varesa will also gain "Rainbow Crash" for 5s.
When "Rainbow Crash" is in effect, Varesa's Plunging Attack ground impact DMG is increased by 180% of her ATK, whether she is in the Fiery Passion state or not. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Tag-Team Triple Jump!" to access the above effect.

Additionally, when Varesa is in the Sudden Onrush mode of her Nightsoul's Blessing, she consumes 30% less Nightsoul points or Phlogiston.
abilities.simple: Her special plunge also grants Rainbow Crash, and Rainbow Crash makes her plunges stronger.

abilities.name: Beyond the Edge of Light
abilities.canon:
Varesa will enter Apex Drive after using a Plunging Attack, regardless of whether she is in the Fiery Passion state or not.
When Apex Drive is active, Varesa's interruption resistance will also further increase.
Additionally, Varesa will restore 11.5 Energy when her Plunging Attack ground impact hits an opponent.
abilities.simple: Every plunge now activates Apex Drive, even outside Fiery Passion, and she restores some Energy.

abilities.name: Unbowed Resolve
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Guardian Vent! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Guardian Vent! by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: The Courage to Press On
abilities.canon:
Varesa will receive various buffs based on her state when using her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! If Varesa:
· Has neither Fiery Passion nor Apex Drive active, she will gain Diligent Refinement for 15s, which will increase her Plunging Attack ground impact DMG by 500% of her ATK, with a maximum increase of 20,000 DMG. This effect will be canceled once the ground impact hits an opponent, or if its duration ends.
· If she has either Fiery Passion or Apex Drive active, this instance of her Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! deals 100% increased DMG.
abilities.simple: Her Burst grants a different buff depending on whether Fiery Passion or Apex Drive is active.

abilities.name: Thoughts Floating on the Warm Breeze
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: By the Horns by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Normal Attack: By the Horns by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: A Hero of Justice's Triumph
abilities.canon:
Varesa restores 30 Energy when she enters Apex Drive.
Her Plunging Attacks and Elemental Burst Guardian Vent! gain 10% CRIT Rate and 100% CRIT DMG.
Additionally, when Varesa uses the Hold version of her Elemental Skill Riding the Night-Rainbow, or Taps her Elemental Skill while in the Sudden Onrush mode, she will restore Nightsoul points up to her maximum.
abilities.simple: Entering Apex Drive restores 30 Energy, and her plunges and Burst gain 10% CRIT Rate and 100% CRIT DMG.

furina.name: Furina
mistakes: Playing her without healing: her Salon Members use the party’s HP.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Soloist's Solicitation
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a solo dance, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents and changing her Arkhe alignment. If Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters summoned by her Elemental Skill "Salon Solitaire" is present, their lineup will switch in response.

Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular
At intervals, when Furina's Normal Attacks hit, a Spiritbreath Thorn or a Surging Blade will descend based on her current Arkhe alignment, dealing Pneuma- or Ousia-aligned Hydro DMG.
When Furina takes the field, her starting Arkhe alignment will be Ousia.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 rapier strikes. Her Charged Attack switches her between Ousia and Pneuma, which changes what her Skill summons.

abilities.name: Salon Solitaire
abilities.canon:
Invites the guests of the Salon Solitaire to come forth and aid in Furina's performance. Will summon either the Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters based on Furina's current Arkhe alignment.

Ousia
Foaming bubbles like celebrants shall dance, dealing AoE Hydro DMG based on Furina's Max HP and summoning 3 Salon Members: the Ball Octopus-shaped Gentilhomme Usher, the Bubbly Seahorse-shaped Surintendante Chevalmarin, and the Armored Crab-shaped Mademoiselle Crabaletta.
They will attack nearby opponents at intervals, prioritizing the target of the active character, dealing Hydro DMG based on Max HP.
When they attack, if character(s) with more than 50% HP are nearby, the Members will increase their current attack's power based on the number of such characters, and consume said characters' HP. If 1/2/3/4 (or more) characters meet these requirements, the Members' attacks will deal 110%/120%/130%/140% of their original DMG.

Pneuma
Summons the Singer of Many Waters, who will heal nearby active character(s) based on Max HP at intervals.

The Salon Members and Singer of Many Waters share a duration, and when Furina uses her Charged Attack to change the guest type, the new guests will inherit the remaining duration.
While the Salon Members or the Singer of Many Waters is on the field, Furina can move on the water's surface.
abilities.simple: Ousia: her Salon Members deal Hydro damage and use some HP from healthy party members. Pneuma: the Singer of Many Waters heals instead.

abilities.name: Let the People Rejoice
abilities.canon:
Rouses the impulse to revel, creating a stage of foam that will deal AoE Hydro DMG based on Furina's Max HP and cause nearby party members to enter the Universal Revelry state: During this time, when nearby party members' HP increases or decreases, 1 Fanfare point will be granted to Furina for each percentage point of their Max HP by which their HP changes.
At the same time, Furina will increase the DMG dealt by and Incoming Healing Bonus of all nearby party members based on the amount of Fanfare she has.
When the duration ends, Furina's Fanfare points will be cleared.
abilities.razor: Party time. HP goes up and down = team hits harder.
abilities.simple: Starts her Universal Revelry: every change in the party’s HP gives Fanfare, which boosts the party’s damage and incoming healing.

abilities.name: Endless Waltz
abilities.canon: When the active character in your party receives healing, if the source of the healing is not Furina herself and the healing overflows, then Furina will heal nearby party members for 2% of their Max HP once every 2s for the next 4s.
abilities.simple: When the active character is healed past full HP, Furina heals the whole party for a while.

abilities.name: Unheard Confession
abilities.canon:
Every 1,000 points of Furina's Max HP can buff the different Arkhe-aligned Salon Solitaire in the following ways:
Will increase Salon Members' DMG dealt by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 28%.
Will decrease the Singer of Many Waters' healing interval for nearby active characters by 0.4%, up to a maximum of 16%.
abilities.simple: Her Salon Members deal more damage based on her Max HP, and the Singer heals more often.

abilities.name: The Sea Is My Stage
abilities.canon: Xenochromatic Fontemer Aberrant ability CD decreased by 30%.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: "Love Is a Rebellious Bird That None Can Tame"
abilities.canon:
When using Let the People Rejoice, Furina will gain 150 Fanfare.
Additionally, Furina's Fanfare limit is increased by 100.
abilities.simple: Fanfare’s limit is higher and her Burst starts with 150 Fanfare.

abilities.name: "A Woman Adapts Like Duckweed in Water"
abilities.canon: While Let the People Rejoice lasts, Furina's Fanfare gain from increases or decreases in nearby characters' HP is increased by 250%. Each point of Fanfare above the limit will increase Furina's Max HP by 0.35%. Her maximum Max HP increase is 140%.
abilities.simple: Fanfare builds much faster, and extra Fanfare raises the party’s Max HP.

abilities.name: "My Secret Is Hidden Within Me, No One Will Know My Name"
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Let the People Rejoice by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Let the People Rejoice by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "They Know Not Life, Who Dwelt in the Netherworld Not!"
abilities.canon: When the Salon Members from Salon Solitaire hit an opponent, or the Singer of Many Waters restores HP to nearby active characters, Furina will restore 4 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
abilities.simple: Her Salon Members’ hits and the Singer’s healing restore Energy to her.

abilities.name: "His Name I Now Know, It Is...!"
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Salon Solitaire by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Salon Solitaire by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "Hear Me — Let Us Raise the Chalice of Love!"
abilities.canon:
When using Salon Solitaire, Furina gains "Center of Attention" for 10s.
Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted into Hydro DMG which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion. DMG is also increased by an amount equivalent to 18% of Furina's max HP.
Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attacks, and the impact of Plunging Attacks will cause different effects up to every 0.1s after hitting opponents depending on her current Arkhe alignment:

Arkhe: Ousia
Every 1s, all nearby characters in the party will be healed by 4% of Furina's max HP, for a duration of 2.9s. Triggering this effect again will extend its duration.
Arkhe: Pneuma
This Normal Attack (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack ground impact DMG will be further increased by an amount equivalent to 25% of Furina's max HP. When any of the attacks mentioned previously hit an opponent, all nearby characters in the party will consume 1% of their current HP.

During the duration of each instance of "Center of Attention," the above effects can be triggered up to 6 times. "Center of Attention" will end when its effects have triggered 6 times or when the duration expires.
abilities.simple: For a while her attacks become Hydro and gain damage from her Max HP, with extra healing or HP use depending on her mode.

varka.name: Varka
varka.role: Main DPS: Anemo with the party’s elements
mistakes: Trying to plunge in Sturm und Drang: he can’t.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Favonius Bladework: Dancing Radiance
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Imitating an ancient knightly war-dance, Varka wields dual claymores to perform up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to charge forward and perform an especially powerful dual blade slash toward the front.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 strikes with two claymores, a charging slash, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Windbound Execution
abilities.canon:
Manifest the true essence of Favonius Bladework with absolute power. Produces different effects depending on whether the skill is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Leap forward and slash in one fluid motion, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and switching to Sturm und Drang mode.
While in Sturm und Drang, Varka's Normal Attack and Charged Attack DMG is increased, and he cannot perform Plunging Attacks. Also, when performing Normal or Charged Attacks, Varka's dual-wielded claymores will deal corresponding Elemental DMG based on the Elemental Types of the characters in the party, respectively. This Elemental DMG cannot be overridden by infusions.
Additionally, when in Sturm und Drang, if there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, Varka's Elemental Skill Windbound Execution will be converted to the special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, dealing corresponding Elemental DMG and Anemo DMG. Additionally, Varka can also expend uses of the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension to perform a special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, that does not consume stamina to deal corresponding Elemental DMG and Anemo DMG.

Hold
After charging for a while, leap forward. The duration of the charge will increase the distance of the leap.
abilities.simple: Tap: he leaps forward with Anemo and enters Sturm und Drang: his Normal and Charged Attacks get stronger and also deal the party’s element (Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo), and he can’t plunge. Hold works differently.

abilities.name: Northwind Avatar
abilities.canon:
In the name of the mightiest Knight of Boreas, unleash a powerful double slash attack toward the front, dealing 2 instances of Anemo DMG.
If there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, the first slash will be converted to deal corresponding Elemental DMG according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types.
abilities.razor: Double slash. Wind and friend element.
abilities.simple: Two slashes of Anemo; with a Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo character in the party, the first becomes that element.

abilities.name: Dawn Wind's March
abilities.canon:
When there are Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo characters in the party, according to the aforementioned priority order of Elemental Types, every 1,000 points of Varka's ATK will grant Varka a 10% Anemo DMG Bonus and corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus (among the aforementioned Elemental Types, only one element can gain bonus DMG this way). Up to 25% bonus DMG can be gained this way. 

Additionally, if there are at least 2 Anemo characters, or at least 2 characters of the same Element among Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo in the party, the Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Special Charged Attack Azure Devour and the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension that Varka deals or unleashes while in the Sturm und Drang mode will deal 140% of their original DMG. If there are at least 2 Anemo characters and at least 2 other characters of the same element among Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo present in the party at the same time, the aforementioned effect will be increased to 220%.
abilities.simple: With a Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo character in the party, every 1,000 ATK gives him 10% Anemo and that element’s DMG Bonus (up to 25%).

abilities.name: Wind's Vanguard
abilities.canon: When nearby party members trigger a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, Varka gains 1 stack of Azure Fang's Oath, increasing the DMG dealt by his Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, special Charged Attack Azure Devour and special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension by 7.5% for 8s. Max 4 stacks. Each character can grant Varka with 1 stack of Azure Fang's Oath every second this way.
abilities.simple: When the party triggers Swirl, he gains a stack that boosts his attacks by 7.5% for 8s (up to 4).

abilities.name: Homebound Wind's Paean
abilities.canon:
For every party member from Mondstadt, the Hold version of Varka's Elemental Skill Windbound Execution's CD is decreased by 5%.
This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
abilities.simple: Each Mondstadt party member lowers his Hold Skill cooldown by 5% (not in Domains, Trounce Domains or the Spiral Abyss).

abilities.name: "Come, Friend, Let Us Dance Beneath the Moon's Soft Glow"
abilities.canon:
When Varka switches to Sturm und Drang, he will obtain an additional use of the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension.
Additionally, after switching to Sturm und Drang, Varka will gain the Lyrical Libation effect: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension, or when performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, Varka will consume this effect to deal 200% of the original DMG dealt by Four Winds' Ascension or Azure Devour.
abilities.simple: Entering Sturm und Drang gives an extra use of his special Skill, plus Lyrical Libation.

abilities.name: "When Dawn Breaks, Our Journey Shall Take Flight"
abilities.canon: When unleashing the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension, or when performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, Varka will perform an additional strike, dealing AoE Anemo DMG equal to 800% of Varka's ATK.
abilities.simple: His special Skill and special Charged Attack add a strike for 800% of his ATK as Anemo damage.

abilities.name: "O Friend, Quaff Not the Bitter Wine That Brings Tears of Woe"
abilities.canon:
Increases Elemental Skill Windbound Execution Level by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of a talent by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "For None May Take From Us Our Freedom of Song"
abilities.canon: When Varka triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, based on the Elemental Types involved in the reaction, all nearby party members gain a 20% Anemo DMG Bonus and the corresponding Elemental DMG Bonus for 10s.
abilities.simple: When he triggers Swirl, the party gains 20% Anemo and matching element DMG Bonus for 10s.

abilities.name: "Fill High the Cup With Fine Wine, for Tyrants Come and Go"
abilities.canon:
Increases Elemental Burst Northwind Avatar Level by 3.
 Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of a talent by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "Beloved Mondstadt, Steadfast You Shall Shine"
abilities.canon:
Sturm und Drang is enhanced:
· For a short time after unleashing the special Elemental Skill Four Winds' Ascension, Tapping on Varka's Elemental Skill or Holding his Normal Attack will not expend any uses of Four Winds' Ascension, and will perform one additional instance of the special Charged Attack, Azure Devour.
· For a short time after performing the special Charged Attack Azure Devour, tap on Varka's Elemental Skill to unleash an additional instance of Four Winds' Ascension without expending any uses of Four Winds' Ascension.
When triggering an additional special Charged Attack, Azure Devour, or unleashing an additional special Elemental Skill, Four Winds' Ascension, in this manner, the above effect cannot be triggered.

Additionally, the Azure Fang's Oath effect in Ascension Talent Wind's Vanguard is enhanced: Every stack of Azure Fang's Oath will increase Varka's CRIT DMG by 20%.
abilities.simple: Sturm und Drang gets stronger: for a short time after his special Skill, some actions don’t use up its charges and add extra special Charged Attacks.

vesna.name: Vesna
mistakes: Using Windborne Sword before stacking Sword Essence: higher levels hit harder.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Vila Blade Dance
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to trample opponents in front of her.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along her path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 6 strikes, a trampling Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: The Art of Victory
abilities.canon:
Calls forth Spirit Blades passed down through generations of the Vila to deal AoE Anemo DMG, then switches to the Armed for Action mode and gains 2 stacks of Sword Essence.

Armed for Action
DMG dealt by Vesna with her Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks become Anemo DMG that cannot be overridden by another elemental infusion instead. She will also summon a wind pinion that attacks the opponent at the same time, dealing additional Anemo DMG. Each time the wind pinion is summoned, Vesna will regenerate a certain amount of Sword Essence.
Vesna can consume Sword Essence to unleash the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword, which deals to the opponent Anemo DMG.
Each use of the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword in the same instance of Armed for Action will increase the level of Windborne Sword, beginning from Lv. 1 to Lv. 3 max, for more Anemo DMG. Using Windborne Sword at Lv. 2 and Lv. 3 will also summon Spirit Blades which deal Anemo DMG.
Vesna will exit the mode when its duration ends or when she has used Windborne Sword at the highest level 3 times. Exiting will clear all remaining Sword Essence she has accrued.
Additionally, when in this mode, Vesna's resistance to interruption is increased.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: DMG dealt with the Spirit Blades becomes Anemo DMG that is also considered Stellar Swirl reaction DMG.
abilities.simple: Anemo damage, then Armed for Action mode with 2 stacks of Sword Essence: her attacks deal Anemo that can’t be overridden, and a wind pinion attacks alongside her.

abilities.name: For the Tsaritsa!
abilities.canon: Summons multiple Spirit Blades, dealing AoE Anemo DMG. Also gains a stack of Sword Essence.
abilities.simple: Spirit Blades deal Anemo damage, and she gains a Sword Essence stack.

abilities.name: Rite of Spring's Procession
abilities.canon:
After Vesna uses the special Elemental Skill Windborne Sword or the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa!, she also gains 1 stack of Disciplinary Action which lasts 20s. Max 6 stacks, and the duration of each stack is independent of the others'.
When she has Disciplinary Action stacks active, the Spirit Blades summoned by Vesna will deal DMG equal to (100% + 10% × Disciplinary Action stack count) of the original DMG instead. All active stacks of Disciplinary Action are cleared when Vesna uses the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory or when she leaves the field.
abilities.simple: After Windborne Sword or her Burst she gains Disciplinary Action stacks (up to 6, 20s each).

abilities.name: Truth Prevails
abilities.canon:
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Vesna will gain the corresponding effect based on the Elemental Type of her party members: 
· For every Cryo or Anemo character in her current party, Vesna's ATK increases by 6%; and
· For every character of all other Elemental Types in her current party, Vesna's Elemental Mastery increases by 25 instead.
abilities.simple: In Radiance: Stellar Swirl, each Cryo or Anemo party member gives her 6% ATK, and other elements give a different bonus.

abilities.name: Stellar Jubilee: Splendid Prelude
abilities.canon:
When party members trigger Cryo Swirl, it will be changed to a Stellar Swirl reaction, and party members' Base DMG for the Stellar Swirl will be increased based on Vesna's ATK. Every 100 ATK she has increases the Base Stellar Swirl DMG by 0.7%. The maximum DMG increase that can be gained this way is 14%.
After a party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction nearby, Vesna enters the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s.
abilities.simple: In her party, Cryo Swirl becomes Stellar Swirl, and her ATK raises its base damage.

abilities.name: The Grand Circuit
abilities.canon:
Holding on Sprint or Jump when Vesna is not in combat will cause her to enter the Coursing state.

Coursing
Continuously consumes Stamina to hover in mid-air. Sprinting or tapping Jump to go higher expends additional Stamina. Including the hold on Jump that triggers Coursing, Vesna can go higher up to 3 times in each instance of the Coursing state.

Additionally, in Snezhnaya (excluding Nod-Krai), when Vesna is switched onto the field while the currently active party member is in mid-air and not in combat, she will immediately enter the Coursing state and regenerate 50 Stamina. This effect can trigger once every 10s, and does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
abilities.simple: Outside combat, holding Sprint or Jump lets her hover in the Coursing state using Stamina. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Winter's Farewell Feast
abilities.canon:
