When in the Armed for Action mode, Vesna can unleash Windborne Sword at the highest level 4 times instead of 3. Also, each time she enters the Armed for Action mode, she will not consume Sword Essence the first time she uses Windborne Sword at the highest level.
Additionally, Vesna deals 20% increased Stellar Swirl reaction DMG when in the Armed for Action mode.
abilities.simple: In Armed for Action she can use the highest-level Windborne Sword 4 times instead of 3.

abilities.name: Kolo of Spring's Arrival
abilities.canon:
The Ascension Talent Rite of Spring's Procession is enhanced: Vesna gains the maximum number of Disciplinary Action stacks when she enters Armed for Action mode. Vesna's ATK is increased by 40% when she has maximum Disciplinary Action stacks.
You must unlock the Ascension Talent "Rite of Spring's Procession" to gain access to the above effects.
abilities.simple: Entering Armed for Action gives her maximum Disciplinary Action stacks, and 40% ATK at max stacks.

abilities.name: Winter's Last Offering
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of the Elemental Skill The Art of Victory by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Glory to Our Forebears
abilities.canon: The Ascension Talent Truth Prevails is enhanced: Its ATK and Elemental Mastery bonuses increase to 3 times their original values.
abilities.simple: Her 4th Ascension Passive’s ATK and Elemental Mastery bonuses are 3 times as strong.

abilities.name: The Nobleborn's Charge
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of the Elemental Burst For the Tsaritsa! by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Unwavering Ardor
abilities.canon:
Tapping on Normal Attack or Elemental Skill in the 5s after Vesna uses Windborne Sword at its highest level will unleash the secret Vila ability Windborne Sword: Transpose, dealing Anemo DMG at 150% of Vesna's ATK as well as summoning Spirit Blades which deal an additional instance of Anemo DMG at 200% of Vesna's ATK. If Vesna is in the Armed for Action mode, she will also summon a wind pinion to perform Coordinated Attacks against opponents.
Additionally, Vesna's Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt is elevated by 20%.
abilities.simple: Right after a top-level Windborne Sword, tapping Normal Attack or Skill unleashes Windborne Sword: Transpose for extra Anemo damage.

fundamentals.simple: Vesna’s Skill makes her attacks Anemo and gives Sword Essence for her special Skill, Windborne Sword.

arlecchino.name: Arlecchino
mistakes: Normal Attacking before her Charged Attack absorbs the Directive: the Bond of Life is what powers her attacks.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Invitation to a Beheading
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina, dashing toward a nearby opponent and cleaving once.
Continuously holding this button will cause Arlecchino to consume Stamina and engage in up to 5s of high-speed movement.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

Masque of the Red Death
When Arlecchino has a Bond of Life equal to or greater than 30% of her Max HP, she will enter the "Masque of the Red Death" state, where her Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to deal Pyro DMG. This cannot be overridden.
When in the "Masque of the Red Death" state, Arlecchino's Normal Attacks will deal extra DMG to opponents on hit that scales off her ATK multiplied by a certain ratio of her current Bond of Life percentage. This will consume 7.5% of said current Bond of Life. Her Bond of Life can be consumed this way every 0.03s. When her Bond of Life is consumed in this manner, All Is Ash's CD will decrease by 0.8s.
abilities.simple: Up to 6 spear strikes and a dash Charged Attack. With a big enough Bond of Life (Masque of the Red Death) her Normal Attacks get much stronger.

abilities.name: All Is Ash
abilities.canon:
Summons forth Balemoon Bloodfire, dealing Pyro DMG to multiple nearby opponents and performing a dash-cleave against one of them, dealing AoE Pyro DMG.
Opponents hit by the aforementioned attack will have a Blood-Debt Directive applied to them.

Blood-Debt Directive
·Lasts 30s. Every 5s, it will deal 1 instance of Pyro DMG to the opponent. Max 2 instances. This DMG will be considered Elemental Skill DMG.
·When Arlecchino uses a Charged Attack or her Elemental Burst, Balemoon Rising, she will absorb and clear nearby Blood-Debt Directives. Each Directive absorbed grants her a Bond of Life worth 65% of her Max HP.
·The maximum value of the Bond of Life she can be granted through Blood-Debt Directives within 35s after using her Elemental Skill is 145% of her Max HP. Using the Elemental Skill again during this duration will restart the count on duration and the limit on the value of Bond of Life she may gain from Blood-Debt Directives.
abilities.simple: Pyro damage and a dash-cleave that mark enemies with a Blood-Debt Directive. Her Charged Attack or Burst absorbs the mark for a Bond of Life.

abilities.name: Balemoon Rising
abilities.canon: Arlecchino's great wing of Balemoon Bloodfire beats as she absorbs and clears Blood-Debt Directives around her. She deals AoE Pyro DMG before clearing the CD of All Is Ash and healing herself. The healing is based on her Bond of Life value and ATK.
abilities.simple: Absorbs nearby Directives, deals Pyro damage, resets her Skill cooldown and heals her based on her Bond of Life.

abilities.name: Agony Alone May Be Repaid
abilities.canon:
Blood-Debt Directives have the following characteristics:
·Arlecchino will be granted a Bond of Life worth 130% of her Max HP when an opponent to which she herself applied a Directive is defeated.
·5s after a Directive is applied, it will be upgraded to a Blood-Debt Due. When absorbed, it will instead grant Arlecchino a Bond of Life worth 130%.
A Bond of Life created in the aforementioned ways cannot exceed the original limit on the value of Bonds of Life obtained through All Is Ash.
abilities.simple: Directives upgrade to Blood-Debt Due after 5s, and absorbing those gives a bigger Bond of Life.

abilities.name: Strength Alone Can Defend
abilities.canon: Arlecchino gains 1% All Elemental and Physical RES for every 100 ATK she has in excess of 1,000. The maximum RES increase she can gain this way for each is 20%.
abilities.simple: She gains 1% elemental and Physical RES for every 100 ATK over 1,000 (up to 20%).

abilities.name: The Balemoon Alone May Know
abilities.canon: While in combat, Arlecchino gains a 40% Pyro DMG Bonus and can only be healed through Balemoon Rising.
abilities.simple: In combat she gains 40% Pyro DMG Bonus but can only be healed by her own Burst.

abilities.name: "All Reprisals and Arrears, Mine to Bear..."
abilities.canon: Masque of the Red Death is further enhanced, the value of the increase is 100%. Additionally, Arlecchino's interruption resistance is increased when she performs Normal or Charged Attacks while affected by the Masque of the Red Death.
abilities.simple: Masque of the Red Death gets stronger, and she resists interruption while attacking with it.

abilities.name: "All Rewards and Retribution, Mine to Bestow..."
abilities.canon:
Blood-Debt Directives are now already Blood-Debt Due when first applied.
When Arlecchino absorbs such a Due, she unleashes Balemoon Bloodfire in front of her, dealing 900% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG and increasing her All Elemental RES and Physical RES by 20% for 15s. This effect can trigger once every 10s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Agony Alone May Be Repaid."
abilities.simple: Directives start as Blood-Debt Due, and absorbing one releases extra Pyro damage and gives her more RES.

abilities.name: "You Shall Become a New Member of Our Family..."
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Normal Attack: Invitation to a Beheading by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "You Shall Love and Protect Each Other Henceforth..."
abilities.canon: When Arlecchino successfully absorbs a Blood-Debt Directive, Balemoon Rising's CD will decrease by 2s and 15 Elemental Energy will be restored to her. This effect can occur once every 10s.
abilities.simple: Absorbing a Directive cuts her Burst cooldown by 2s and restores 15 Energy (once every 10s).

abilities.name: "For Alone, We Are as Good as Dead..."
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Balemoon Rising by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Balemoon Rising by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "From This Day On, We Shall Delight in New Life Together."
abilities.canon:
The DMG of Balemoon Rising is increased by Arlecchino's ATK multiplied by 700% of Arlecchino's current Bond of Life percentage.
For 20s after Arlecchino uses All Is Ash, both her Normal Attacks and Elemental Burst gain 10% increased CRIT Rate and 70% increased CRIT DMG. This effect can be triggered up to once every 15s.
abilities.simple: Her Burst gains damage from her Bond of Life, and after her Skill her Normal Attacks and Burst gain CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG.

columbina.name: Columbina
columbina.role: Support / sub DPS: Hydro for Lunar reactions
mistakes: Using her Skill away from the action: Gravity Ripple follows the active character, so keep the fight near it.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Moondew Cascade
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Summons Moonlit Tides, performing up to 3 attacks that deal Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Hydro DMG after a short casting time.
If you have at least 1 Verdant Dew, Columbina's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Moondew Cleanse, which will not consume Stamina: Consume 1 Verdant Dew to deal 3 instances of AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Hydro attacks. With Verdant Dew, her Charged Attack becomes Moondew Cleanse: no Stamina, 3 hits of Dendro.

abilities.name: Eternal Tides
abilities.canon:
Awaken Moonbound Tides, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and summoning Gravity Ripple.
Gravity Ripple will follow the active character on the field, while continuously dealing AoE Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents. While Gravity Ripple is on the field, and nearby party members trigger Lunar reactions or inflict Lunar Reaction DMG, Columbina will accrue a special Gravity. Once Gravity is accumulated to its limit, different types of damage will be dealt to enemies based on the type of Lunar Reaction that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Gravity Ripple inflicts AoE Hydro DMG over a wider area.
abilities.simple: Summons Gravity Ripple, which follows the active character and keeps dealing Hydro. Lunar reactions near it build Gravity, which triggers extra damage when full.

abilities.name: Moonlit Melancholy
abilities.canon: Hills and tides unite under the silver light of a pristine new moon. Temporarily transforms the surrounding terrain into Lunar Domain, dealing AoE Hydro DMG.
abilities.simple: Hydro damage, and the area becomes her Lunar Domain for a while.

abilities.name: Lunacy's Lure
abilities.canon: When triggering Gravity Interference, Columbina gains the Lunacy effect, increasing her CRIT Rate by 5% for 10s. This effect can be stacked up to 3 times.
abilities.simple: Each Gravity Interference gives her 5% CRIT Rate for 10s (up to 3 stacks).

abilities.name: Law of the New Moon
abilities.canon:
When characters within the Lunar Domain trigger Lunar reactions, they will gain the following effects respectively: 
· Lunar-Charged: When the Thundercloud performs lightning strike(s) against a valid target, it has a 33% chance to perform an additional lightning strike. 
· Lunar-Bloom: When triggering Lunar-Bloom reactions, the party gains a special Moonridge Dew. Up to 3 Moonridge Dews can be gained every 18s. 
· Lunar-Crystallize: When Moondrift Harmony is triggered, every Moondrift has a 33% chance to inflict an extra attack.
abilities.simple: Lunar reactions inside her Lunar Domain get extra effects, such as a 33% chance of an extra lightning strike for Lunar-Charged and Moonridge Dew for Lunar-Bloom.

abilities.name: Moonsign Benediction: Moonlight, Lent Unto You
abilities.canon:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged, Bloom, or Hydro-Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into a Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, or Lunar-Crystallize reaction respectively. Lunar Reaction DMG inflicted by party members gain a Base DMG increase based on Columbina's Max HP. For every 1,000 points of Max HP, the Base DMG of Lunar reactions is increased by 0.2%, up to a maximum of 7%.

Additionally, when Columbina is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
abilities.simple: With Columbina in the party, Electro-Charged, Bloom and Hydro-Crystallize become Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom and Lunar-Crystallize, with base damage from her Max HP.

abilities.name: Lunar Vigil
abilities.canon:
If one of your party members is incapacitated while in the Nod-Krai or Frost Moon regions, Columbina will revive this character. The amount of HP the character will have upon revival is based on Columbina's Friendship Level. This effect can occur once every 100s. This effect does not trigger in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
Additionally, Columbina appears to have a special affinity for certain animals who are influenced by kuuvahki...
abilities.simple: In Nod-Krai or Frost Moon regions she can revive an incapacitated party member. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Radiance Over Blossoms and Peaks
abilities.canon:
Unleashing her Elemental Skill Eternal Tides will immediately trigger an effect equivalent to the effect of Gravity Interference. This effect can be triggered once every 15s.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
When Gravity Interference is triggered, if the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
· Lunar-Charged: Your current active character will recover 6 Energy.
· Lunar-Bloom: Your active character's interruption resistance will be increased for 8s.
· Lunar-Crystallize: Summons a Rainsea Shield. The Rainsea Shield's DMG absorption is based on 12% of Columbina's Max HP, and it will absorb Hydro DMG with 250% effectiveness for 8s.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is elevated by 1.5%.
abilities.simple: Her Skill immediately triggers a Gravity Interference effect (once every 15s), with an extra effect under Ascendant Gleam.

abilities.name: Not in Lone Splendor
abilities.canon:
Rate of accumulating Gravity increases by 34%. 
When Gravity Interference is triggered, Columbina will receive the Lunar Brilliance effect, which increases her Max HP by 40% for 8s.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam:
When Lunar Brilliance is active, if, during the current trigger of Gravity Interference, the Lunar reaction type that has accumulated the most Gravity for Columbina is:
· Lunar-Charged: ATK of your current active character increases. Increase in ATK is equal to 1% of Columbina's Max HP.
· Lunar-Bloom: Elemental Mastery of your current active character increases. Increase in Elemental Mastery is equal to 0.35% of Columbina's Max HP.
· Lunar-Crystallize: DEF of your current active character increases. Increase in DEF is equal to 1% of Columbina's Max HP.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is elevated by 7%.
abilities.simple: Gravity builds 34% faster, and Gravity Interference gives her 40% Max HP for 8s.

abilities.name: Dreamlike Glow Across Tranquil Waters
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill Eternal Tides by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is elevated by 1.5%.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Elemental Skill Eternal Tides by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Cloudveiled Ridges in Floral Mists
abilities.simple: Gravity Interference restores 4 Energy and boosts her main Lunar reaction type.

abilities.name: Silence Tending One Lone Song
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Elemental Burst Moonlit Melancholy by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is elevated by 1.5%.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Elemental Burst Moonlit Melancholy by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Through Darkness Led by Moonlight
abilities.canon:
For 8s after characters in the Lunar Domain trigger a Lunar reaction, based on the elements involved in the reaction, the CRIT DMG of the corresponding Elemental DMG done by all party members is increased by 80%. The CRIT DMG-increasing effects for the same Elemental Type do not stack.

All nearby party members' Lunar Reaction DMG is elevated by 7%.
abilities.simple: For 8s after a Lunar reaction in her Lunar Domain, the party’s CRIT DMG for those elements rises by 80%.

mavuika.name: Mavuika
mistakes: Using her Burst before the team has built her Fighting Spirit with Skills and attacks.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Flames Weave Life
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive claymore strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an especially powerful Severing Splendor strike toward the front.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 claymore strikes, a powerful Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: The Named Moment
abilities.canon:
Calling upon her authority over "conflict," Mavuika summons the All-Fire Armaments passed down through the line of human Archons, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.
After using this, Mavuika's Nightsoul points are restored to max value, and she enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

All-Fire Armaments
Has different forms when Tapped or Held.

Tap
"Divine Name Unleashed": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Ring of Searing Radiance. The Ring follows the current active character and attacks nearby opponents at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG.

Hold
"Ancient Name Unbound": The All-Fire Armaments manifest as a Flamestrider. In this state, Mavuika can ride the Flamestrider at high speed, or activate its hidden backup propulsion module to temporarily cross various terrain types and glide in mid-air. Mavuika's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will also be converted to deal Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG which cannot be overridden. When sprinting, she also deals Nightsoul-aligned Pyro DMG to opponents along her path.

While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Tapping the Elemental Skill can switch the All-Fire Armaments' form. The Armaments will disappear once Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Mavuika
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points according to the All-Fire Armaments' form. Mavuika's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends once her Nightsoul points are exhausted.
abilities.simple: Summons the All-Fire Armaments and refills her Nightsoul points. Tap: a Ring of Searing Radiance follows the active character and attacks with Pyro. Hold: she rides the Flamestrider.

abilities.name: Hour of Burning Skies
abilities.canon:
Let the people's inner voices reach the divine throne in the heavens.
Mavuika's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Energy, but instead, on "Fighting Spirit."

Fighting Spirit
When Mavuika has at least 50% Fighting Spirit, she can consume it all to unleash her Elemental Burst.
Mavuika can obtain Fighting Spirit via the following methods:
· When in combat, Nightsoul points consumed by nearby party members are converted to Fighting Spirit.
· When nearby party members' Normal Attacks hit opponents, Mavuika gains 1.5 Fighting Spirit. This can trigger once every 0.1s.

After using this, Mavuika gains 10 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Riding her Flamestrider high in the air, she uses a powerful Sunfell Slice against opponents on the ground, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG and entering the "Crucible of Death and Life" state.

Crucible of Death and Life
During this time, Mavuika's various actions will no longer consume Nightsoul points, and her interruption resistance is increased. Also, the DMG dealt by Sunfell Slice and "Ancient Name Unbound"'s Normal and Charged Attacks is increased based on the amount of Fighting Spirit she has when using the Elemental Burst.
Crucible of Death and Life will be canceled when Mavuika leaves the field.
abilities.razor: Team fight = fire queen. Big boom.
abilities.simple: Her Burst runs on Fighting Spirit, not Energy. She gains it when the party uses Nightsoul points and lands Normal Attacks. At 50% or more she can unleash it.

abilities.name: Gift of Flaming Flowers
abilities.canon: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mavuika's ATK increases by 30% for 10s.
abilities.simple: When a party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mavuika gains 30% ATK for 10s.

abilities.name: "Kiongozi"
abilities.canon: After using her Elemental Burst, Hour of Burning Skies, every point of Fighting Spirit present when it is used increases the DMG that the current active party member deals by 0.2%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 40%, and this effect lasts 20s, decaying over this duration until it reaches 0.
abilities.razor: More Fighting Spirit = friends hit harder.
abilities.simple: After her Burst, the active character deals more damage based on the Fighting Spirit she used (up to 40%). It fades over 20s.

abilities.name: Night Realm's Gift: Exhaust Mode
abilities.canon:
After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted, Mavuika will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain the All-Fire Armaments' Flamestrider form.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Mavuika can be used. When the current active character is sprinting, climbing, swimming, in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Mavuika will trigger the following: Mavuika enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and obtains 50% of her maximum Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
abilities.simple: When her Nightsoul points run out she keeps the Flamestrider going with Phlogiston. In Natlan she can use Nightsoul Transmission.

abilities.name: Night-Shattering Radiance
abilities.canon: The party's Nightsoul Transmission CD is decreased by 20%.
abilities.simple: Shorter Nightsoul Transmission cooldown for the party. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: The Night-Lord's Explication
abilities.canon:
Mavuika's maximum Nightsoul points are increased to 120, and she gains Fighting Spirit 25% more efficiently.
Additionally, she gains 40% ATK for 8s after gaining Fighting Spirit.
abilities.simple: More Nightsoul points, Fighting Spirit gained faster, and 40% ATK for 8s after gaining Fighting Spirit.

abilities.name: The Ashen Price
abilities.canon:
When in the Nightsoul's Blessing State, Mavuika's Base ATK is increased by 200, and she obtains the following effects based on All-Fire Armaments' form:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: Nearby opponents' DEF is decreased by 20%.
· Flamestrider: Mavuika's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and her Sunfell Slice from the Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies deal 60%, 90%, and 120% of her ATK as increased DMG respectively.
abilities.razor: More base ATK. Ring = less enemy DEF.
abilities.simple: In Nightsoul’s Blessing her Base ATK rises by 200, with an extra effect for each form; the Ring lowers nearby enemies’ DEF by 20%.

abilities.name: The Burning Sun
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Hour of Burning Skies by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Hour of Burning Skies by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: The Leader's Resolve
abilities.canon:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent "Kiongozi":
The DMG increase gained after using the Elemental Burst Hour of Burning Skies will not decay over time, and an additional 10% DMG Bonus will be gained.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Kiongozi."
abilities.simple: Her 4th Ascension Passive’s damage bonus no longer fades and gets an extra 10%.

abilities.name: The Meaning of Truth
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of The Named Moment by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of The Named Moment by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "Humanity's Name" Unfettered
abilities.canon:
The All-Fire Armaments from the Elemental Skill The Named Moment receive all-round improvements:
· Ring of Searing Radiance: When the Ring's attacks hit opponents, a Flamestrider will crash into the struck opponent, dealing 200% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG.
· Flamestrider: When Mavuika is riding the Flamestrider, she will also summon a Scorching Ring of Searing Radiance to follow her, which will decrease nearby opponents' DEF by 20% and deal 500% of ATK as Nightsoul-aligned AoE Pyro DMG to nearby opponents once every 3s. Mavuika's terrain-crossing abilities will also be further improved.

Additionally, when Mavuika is riding her Flamestrider and is not in combat, when her Nightsoul points drop to 5, she will gain 80 Nightsoul points. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
abilities.simple: Both forms of the All-Fire Armaments get stronger: for example, the Ring’s hits also call down a Flamestrider for extra Pyro damage.

kinich.name: Kinich
mistakes: Swinging without a target nearby: his Skill needs one to attach to.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Nightsun Style
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 rapid strikes.
After using his Elemental Skill "Canopy Hunter: Riding High"'s mid-air swing, he can perform a Normal Attack in mid-air before landing.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to spin and throw his Claymore forward to attack opponents.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 claymore strikes, a Charged Attack and a plunge.

abilities.name: Canopy Hunter: Riding High
abilities.canon:
Kinich uses his big-game hunting skills to either move swiftly or attack his opponent.
When there is an opponent or object that can be attacked nearby, he will attach a grappling hook to the target and enter Nightsoul's Blessing with 0 Nightsoul points. If neither is nearby, he fires a grappling hook forward and swings in mid-air, and this Skill's CD is decreased by 60%.
This skill can be Held to release. When it is Held, Kinich can aim the grappling hook.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Kinich
Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing lasts 10s and generates 2 Nightsoul points every second.
In this state, Kinich will hook onto a nearby opponent and perform a variable attack:
·When using a Normal Attack, Kinich will fire Loop Shots as he loops around the grappled target based on his current movement direction, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Dendro DMG and generating 3 Nightsoul points. Loop Shot DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
·When Nightsoul points are at max, he can use the Elemental Skill "Scalespiker Cannon": Consume all Nightsoul points to deal Nightsoul-aligned Dendro DMG. When "Scalespiker Cannon" is Held, Kinich can aim this shot. After firing the Cannon, Kinich will try to grapple to its target.
While in Nightsoul's Blessing, after grappling an opponent or firing "Scalespiker Cannon," a Blind Spot will be generated next to the opponent. When Kinich enters this Blind Spot, it will disappear and he will generate 4 Nightsoul points.
If the grapple connection should snap due to exceeding the maximum distance or some other reason, using a Normal Attack will establish a new connection with a nearby opponent before performing Loop Shots.
abilities.simple: He grapples to a target and enters Nightsoul’s Blessing; while swinging around enemies his Normal Attacks become Loop Shots, building up to a big Scalespiker Cannon.

abilities.name: Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord
abilities.canon:
Unleashes the power of the Almighty Dragonlord, K'uhul Ajaw (on a limited, conditional, restricted, contractual, partial, temporary basis), dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Dendro DMG. Ajaw will unleash his Dragon Breath at intervals, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Dendro DMG.
If Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing when this is used, this Blessing's duration is extended by 1.7s.
abilities.simple: Calls his dragon partner K’uhul Ajaw to deal Dendro damage, with extra dragon breath attacks.

abilities.name: The Price of Desolation
abilities.canon: When Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing state, opponents hit by his Elemental Skill will enter the Desolation state, and when affected by Burning or Burgeon reaction DMG, they will restore 7 Nightsoul points to him. Nightsoul points can be gained this way once every 0.8s. The Desolation state will persist until this instance of Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.
abilities.simple: In Nightsoul’s Blessing his Skill puts enemies in Desolation; Burning and Burgeon on them give him Nightsoul points.

abilities.name: Flame Spirit Pact
abilities.canon: After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Kinich will gain 1 stack of Hunter's Experience that lasts 15s. Max 2 stacks. When Kinich uses Canopy Hunter: Riding High's Scalespiker Cannon, all stacks of Hunter's Experience will be consumed, with each stack consumed increasing the DMG dealt by this Cannon shot by 320% of Kinich's ATK.
abilities.simple: Party Nightsoul Bursts give stacks that strengthen his next Scalespiker Cannon.

abilities.name: Night Realm's Gift: Repaid in Full
abilities.canon:
When Kinich is in the air following Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, he can consume 10 Phlogiston points to perform another mid-air swing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Kinich. When the current active character is sprinting, in movement states that result from specific Talents, or in the air, when you switch to Kinich: Kinich will perform one of the following actions depending on the conditions met:
·When facing a Coilgrass Sigil that can be interacted with: He will fire a grappling hook towards it to move;
·When there are nearby opponents and you are in combat: Kinich will use Canopy Hunter: Riding High in the direction of the opponents;
Otherwise, Kinich will fire a grappling hook and swing, prioritizing valid Coilgrass Sigils as grapple targets.
Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.

When interacting with Coilgrass Sigils and other items that Yumkasaurs can interact with, "Canopy Hunter: Riding High" will be converted to "Yumkasaur Mimesis," which causes interactions with such items to follow rules applicable to Yumkasaurs, and which will not put Canopy Hunter: Riding High on CD.
abilities.simple: In the air after his swing he can spend Phlogiston for extra movement. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Swift Envoy
abilities.canon: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, interacting with some harvestable items will increase your own party members' Movement SPD by 15% for 10s. Additionally, the location of nearby resources unique to Natlan will appear on your mini-map.
abilities.simple: In Natlan’s Phlogiston areas, harvesting some items gives extra rewards. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Parrot's Beak
abilities.canon:
After Kinich lands from Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, his Movement SPD will increase by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, Scalespiker Cannon's CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.
abilities.simple: After landing from his swing he moves 30% faster and his cannon’s CRIT DMG rises.

abilities.name: Tiger Beetle's Palm
abilities.canon:
When Kinich's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, it will decrease their Dendro RES by 30% for 6s.
Additionally, the first Scalespiker Cannon Kinich fires after entering Nightsoul's Blessing has increased AoE, and its DMG increases by 100%.
abilities.simple: His Skill hits lower the enemy’s Dendro RES by 30% for 6s.

abilities.name: Protosuchian's Claw
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Canopy Hunter: Riding High by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Canopy Hunter: Riding High by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Hummingbird's Feather
abilities.canon:
When in Nightsoul's Blessing, Kinich will restore 5 Energy after using his Loop Shots or after unleashing the Scalespiker Cannon. Energy can be regenerated this way once every 2.8s.
Additionally, Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord deals 70% more DMG.
abilities.simple: In Nightsoul’s Blessing his Loop Shots and Scalespiker Cannon restore Energy.

abilities.name: Howler Monkey's Tail
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Auspicious Beast's Shape
abilities.canon:
After Scalespiker Cannon hits an opponent, it will bounce between opponents once, dealing 700% of Kinich's ATK as Dendro DMG.
If this Scalespiker Cannon triggers the buffs that Ascension Talent "Flame Spirit Pact" or the Constellation "Tiger Beetle's Palm" grant to the Cannon, the bouncing attack will also obtain the relevant buffs.
abilities.simple: Scalespiker Cannon bounces to another enemy for big Dendro damage.

odette.name: Odette
mistakes: Letting her Solo Dance Double run out: her Skill re-summons it and resets its duration.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Snow Swan Variation
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Unleashes a sword attack of up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a dazzling slash on opponents in front of her.

Plunging Attack
Attacks opponents in her path while plunging from mid-air, then deals AoE DMG upon landing.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 sword strikes, a dazzling Charged Attack slash, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers
abilities.canon:
With slow, graceful dance steps, Odette deals AoE Cryo DMG to the opponent, and also summons her Solo Dance Double to the field.
If a Dance Double summoned by Odette is already on the field, this will re-summon the Dance Double and reset its duration.

Solo Dance Double
Alternates between the Plume and Wing dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them AoE Cryo DMG.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers, Odette's Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers will become the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling instead, where a dance duet deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents over time. Then, when the duet ends, she deals another instance of AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG.
abilities.simple: Cryo damage and she summons her Solo Dance Double, which alternates Plume and Wing dance moves to attack with Cryo. Using it again re-summons the Double.

abilities.name: Presto: Bluebird Finale
abilities.canon:
With quick, lively dance steps, Odette deals multiple instances of AoE Cryo DMG, and summons her Solo Dance Double. She also gains Snow Swan's Dream, which increases the Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG Odette deals.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Burst Presto: Bluebird Finale, Odette's Elemental Skill Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling instead.

If there is a Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette on the field, it will be summoned to her side with its duration refreshed.
abilities.simple: Several hits of Cryo damage, summons her Solo Dance Double, and gives her Snow Swan’s Dream, which raises her Stellar Glimmer reaction damage. Her Skill changes into a special version for 6s afterwards.

abilities.name: Spring Rite of the Chosen One
abilities.canon: When Odette summons her Solo Dance Double, she also obtains 4 stacks of Marvelous Splendor.
abilities.simple: Summoning her Solo Dance Double gives her 4 stacks of Marvelous Splendor.

abilities.name: Pathetique of Pateticheskaya
abilities.canon: For every 100 ATK Odette has over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer DMG is additionally increased by 1.5% of the original DMG. She can deal up to 30% more additional DMG in this way.
abilities.simple: For every 100 ATK over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer damage rises by 1.5% of the original damage (up to 30%).

abilities.name: Stellar Jubilee: Dance of Aurore
abilities.canon:
Odette will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a Polestar Field, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Odette's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
abilities.simple: She enters Radiance: Stellar-Conduct inside a Polestar Field, or Radiance: Stellar Swirl for 8s after a party member triggers Stellar Swirl.

abilities.name: Echo of Winter Daydreams
abilities.canon:
Shows the locations of Snezhnaya's Local Specialties on the mini-map, and this effect also applies in the Shadow Realm.
Practicing dance in one's spare time might even trigger other effects...
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: "On This Danceless Morn, She Gazes at Her Reflection"
abilities.canon:
After unleashing the special Elemental Skill Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling, at the dance duet's end Odette will deal an additional instance of Cryo AoE DMG to nearby opponents that is considered:
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 300% of Odette's ATK;
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 450% of Odette's ATK.

Additionally, the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is also enhanced: now, when the Solo Dance Double is summoned, Odette also gains 2 stacks of Marvelous Splendor. When Odette is off-field, the rate at which Marvelous Splendor is removed is sped up to 2 stacks per second.
abilities.simple: After her special Skill, the dance duet’s end deals an extra Cryo hit that counts as a Radiance reaction.

abilities.name: "I Must See the Snow Swan's Unseen Dream for Myself, She Thought"
abilities.canon:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: every stack of Marvelous Splendor active also increases the character's ATK by 7%.
Additionally, if Odette is in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state when there is a Solo Dance Double on the field, opponents near the Dance Double will also have their corresponding Elemental RES lowered by 20%.
·Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: Cryo and Electro.
·Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Cryo and Anemo.
abilities.simple: Each Marvelous Splendor stack also raises the character’s ATK by 7%, with more effects in Radiance: Stellar-Conduct.

abilities.name: "I'll Chase the Shouting Wind Along, Climbing Alone As I Go"
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue"
abilities.canon:
The Elemental Burst Presto: Bluebird Finale is enhanced as follows: when Odette obtains Snow Swan's Dream, Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other nearby party members is increased by 50% of Snow Swan Dream's effects.

Additionally, when a party member deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to an opponent, Odette will also join in with a coordinated attack, dealing an instance of AoE Cryo DMG. This effect, which can trigger once every 3.5s, will be considered:
·Radiance: Stellar-Conduct or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 66% of Odette's ATK.
·Radiance: Stellar Swirl: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 99% of Odette's ATK.
abilities.simple: When she gains Snow Swan’s Dream, other party members’ Stellar Glimmer damage also rises.

abilities.name: "Oh! I Have Slipped the Surly Bonds of Earth"
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Presto: Bluebird Finale by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Presto: Bluebird Finale by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "Put Out My Hand, and Touched the Face of the Divine"
abilities.canon:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: When Odette grants Marvelous Splendor to all nearby party members, her own Marvelous Splendor stacks will no longer decrease.
Additionally, characters affected by Marvelous Splendor have their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt to opponents elevated by 25%, and Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Odette is elevated by an additional 20%.
abilities.simple: When she gives Marvelous Splendor to the party, her own stacks no longer go down, with extra effects for the party.

fundamentals.simple: Odette summons her Solo Dance Double, which keeps attacking with Cryo, and she powers up Stellar Glimmer reactions.

sandrone.name: Sandrone
mistakes: Using her Charged Attack without Decoding Power built up: her strongest beams depend on it.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Generates threads that control her weapon using formulae, performing up to 3 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Summons the Facilitatrice Automatisee Generaliste Interactive et Omnitache, or "Fagio," and switches it to Decoding mode: Unleashes a sweeping fire attack on enemies in front, as well as periodically fires condensed beams, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The condensed beams will instead deal AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
While in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power will continuously increase. Firing condensed beams will also further increase its Decoding Power.
When Fagio's Decoding Power reaches the maximum of 100 points, it switches to Power Overdrive mode, in which it fires at opponents with longer intervals, dealing Cryo DMG. It will be unable to switch to Decoding mode at this time.
When not in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power gradually decreases. When Sandrone is off-field, she will focus on maintaining Fagio, causing its Decoding Power to decrease at 300% the original rate.
Fagio exits Power Overdrive mode when its Decoding Power has decreased to under 50.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from midair to strike the ground below, dealing DMG to opponents along their path and causing AoE DMG on landing.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 thread-controlled strikes. Her Charged Attack summons Fagio.

abilities.name: Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis
abilities.canon:
With her impeccable, ladylike poise, Sandrone boards the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech and hovers forward for 6s. During this time, Sandrone can control the travel direction of the craft. Pressing Sprint consumes 10 Stamina and launches her into an elegant high-speed hover mode, in which she will move even faster at the cost of 15 Stamina per second.

When Sandrone starts hovering, if there are opponents nearby, she will also summon a Prismatic Resonance Cannon and fire 2 Prism Shots at any opponents who have yet to cool down, dealing Cryo DMG.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The second Prism Shot will instead deal Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.

When on the Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech, Sandrone will also elegantly and quietly repair Fagio, causing Decoding Power to swiftly decrease.
abilities.simple: She boards her Hovermech and hovers for 6s; Sprint launches a faster hover mode that costs Stamina. Starting near enemies triggers an attack.

abilities.name: Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D.
abilities.canon:
In line with established ladylike behavior, Sandrone summons a large number of Prismatic Resonance Cannons for a frontal bombardment before firing on her foes with a Convective Inhibition Ray, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The Convective Inhibition Ray instead deals AoE Cryo DMG that is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
abilities.simple: Prismatic Resonance Cannons fire, then a Convective Inhibition Ray deals Cryo damage. In Radiance: Stellar Glimmer the ray counts as Stellar Glimmer damage.

abilities.name: Eternal Speculation Engine
abilities.canon:
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: When using the Elemental Skill Formule Phenomenale: Differential Analysis, if Fagio's Decoding Power is greater than 50, the second Prism Shot fired by Fagio at nearby opponents will deal 400% of its original DMG as Fagio's Decoding Power is decreased.
Additionally, for every 10 points of Decoding Power Fagio loses, it gains 1 stack of Refined Tactics for 60s (max 10 stacks). When Sandrone uses the Elemental Burst Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D. while in the Radiance: Stellar Glimmer state, all stacks of Refined Tactics are cleared, causing the Convective Inhibition Ray to deal 100% + (number of stacks cleared) × 10% of its original DMG.
abilities.simple: In Radiance: Stellar Glimmer, with over 50 Decoding Power, Fagio’s second Prism Shot from her Skill deals 400% of its damage.

abilities.name: A Lady's Code of Conduct
abilities.canon: Increases Sandrone's Elemental Mastery based on her ATK. Every 100 ATK will increase her Elemental Mastery by 8. The maximum increase she can gain this way is 160.
abilities.simple: Every 100 ATK gives her 8 Elemental Mastery (up to 160).

abilities.name: Stellar Jubilee: Light of Rationalisme
abilities.canon:
Sandrone will enter the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state when she is inside a Polestar Field, or the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.
When a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of the aforementioned reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Sandrone's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.
abilities.simple: She enters Radiance: Stellar-Conduct inside a Polestar Field, or Radiance: Stellar Swirl for 8s after a party Stellar Swirl.

abilities.name: A Caucus Prelude and a Long Tale
abilities.canon: When Sandrone is in the party, you will gain additional snack rewards after turning in your Daily Commissions with Katheryne.
abilities.simple: Extra snack rewards from Katheryne’s Daily Commissions. A world perk.

abilities.name: Morrow After the Golden Dusk
abilities.canon: When in Decoding mode, Fagio's Decoding Power increases at a 50% lower rate, and all party members deal 30% increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG.
abilities.simple: In Decoding mode, Fagio’s Decoding Power builds 50% slower, and the party deals 30% more Stellar Glimmer damage.

abilities.name: An Heiress Gazed Into the Looking-Glass
abilities.canon: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: Increases CRIT DMG from Charged Attack condensed beams by 40%. Also, each time a beam is fired, CRIT DMG dealt by all condensed beams fired during this Decoding mode period will be further increased by 20%. Max 3 stacks.
abilities.simple: In Radiance: Stellar Glimmer her Charged Attack beams gain 40% CRIT DMG, and each beam adds more.

abilities.name: Refuse the Wake of Dusk, the Moonlit Yoke
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Formule Phenomenale: Self-Evident Proposition by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: In Knowledge Lies the World's True Ground
abilities.canon: When Sandrone deals Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG to an opponent, she will also summon an extra Prismatic Resonance Cannon to fire off a coordinated attack which deals Cryo DMG at 125% or 187.5% of her ATK, respectively. This DMG is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, and the effect can occur once every 4s.
abilities.simple: Her Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl damage summons an extra cannon for a coordinated Cryo attack.

abilities.name: Of All Beside, She Takes No Part
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D. by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Formule Phenomenale: Q.E.D. by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Narcissus Wakes, Her Eyes Upon the Dawn
abilities.canon:
When Fagio fires a condensed beam for the third time while in Decoding mode, the beam becomes a more powerful Condensed Cluster Beam that fires continuously. This beam will deal up to 4 additional instances of AoE Cryo DMG at 100% of Sandrone's ATK on top of any subsequent original beam fired.
Radiance: Stellar Glimmer: The Condensed Cluster Beam attack deals 4 additional instances of AoE Cryo DMG. The DMG dealt with this attack, which is considered the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, is equal to:
Radiance: Stellar-Conduct: 80% of Sandrone's ATK.
Radiance: Stellar Swirl: 120% of Sandrone's ATK.
Additionally, all Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Sandrone is elevated by 20%.
abilities.simple: The third beam in Decoding mode becomes a Condensed Cluster Beam that keeps firing extra Cryo hits.

fundamentals.simple: Sandrone hovers on her Tea Party Tactical Assault Hovermech and fights with her automaton Fagio; in Radiance: Stellar Glimmer her attacks count as reaction damage.

vodyanitsa.name: Vodyanitsa
vodyanitsa.role: Support: Hydro, healing and RES shred
mistakes: Swapping her in late: her Song of Ages Past effect should be up before the damage dealer’s turn.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Psyshkhwe Arietta
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Sings an ancient song of the Water Imps, unleashing up to 4 strikes. This deals Hydro DMG to the opponent.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a water ball forward, dealing Hydro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 Hydro attacks, a water-ball Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn
abilities.canon:
Reveals her true Water Imp form, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and gaining the Song of Ages Past effect: While this effect is active, Vodyanitsa summons the ancient Horn of Spring's Call, periodically moving closer to an opponent in a swift movement to attack them, dealing Hydro DMG.
The above two types of attacks will also decrease the Hydro RES and Cryo RES of opponents hit. Additionally, while the Song of Ages Past effect is active, your active character gains increased resistance to interruption and periodically regenerates HP based on Vodyanitsa's Max HP.
abilities.simple: Hydro damage and Song of Ages Past: the Horn of Spring’s Call attacks enemies with Hydro, and her attacks lower their Hydro and Cryo RES.

abilities.name: Koda: Sink With Thee
abilities.canon:
Leads a song of the Water Imps which lures its listeners to their doom. This deals AoE Hydro DMG to the opponent.
When in the Song of Ages Past state, DMG dealt is further increased.
abilities.simple: Hydro damage; it deals more while Song of Ages Past is active.

abilities.name: The Last Djeguako Songstress
abilities.canon:
When the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn is used, any Stellar Vortex on the field will turn into a Wandering Vortex instead. While the Song of Ages Past effect is active, nearby party members' Stellar Swirl reactions will generate Wandering Vortex instead.
Generating or detonating a Wandering Vortex will also reduce nearby opponents' Anemo RES by 35% for 6s. 
Additionally, nearby party members who enter the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state while Song of Ages Past is in effect will have the Radiance: Stellar Swirl state extended by 4s.
abilities.simple: Her Skill turns Stellar Vortexes into Wandering Vortexes, and during Song of Ages Past the party’s Stellar Swirl makes Wandering Vortexes instead.

abilities.name: Dirge of the Fandyr
abilities.canon:
When the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn is used, Vodyanitsa will also gain 25 stacks of Lead Vocal as well as 10 stacks of Chorus.
The two effects above last 30s each, and the stack count is refreshed when the Elemental Skill is used.
abilities.simple: Her Skill gives her 25 stacks of Lead Vocal and 10 stacks of Chorus for 30s, refreshed each time she uses it.

abilities.name: Echoes Over the Frozen Lake
abilities.canon:
Holding the Elemental Skill outside of combat will cause Vodyanitsa to embody her true Water Imp form and swim for up to 10s at the cost of Stamina. Naturally, as a Water Imp, she can also move across the water's surface. Vodyanitsa will exit her Water Imp form when the Elemental Skill is used again, when the duration ends, or when all Stamina is depleted.
Additionally, while Vodyanitsa can swim faster, her Stamina consumption rate is also increased.
abilities.razor: Swim like an imp. Not for fighting.
abilities.simple: Outside combat, holding her Skill lets her swim in Water Imp form for up to 10s using Stamina. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Heartless Siren Song
abilities.canon: As the Prima Donna of the Korolevskiy Troupe, Vodyanitsa sings in person in place of playing an instrument.
abilities.simple: A flavour perk: she sings in person instead of playing an instrument. No combat effect.

abilities.name: Waters in Full Splendor
abilities.canon: Each time Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of Song of Ages Past, it also increases the ATK of all nearby party members by 0.8% of her Max HP for 5s.
abilities.simple: Each Song of Ages Past heal also raises the party’s ATK by 0.8% of her Max HP for 5s.

abilities.name: Echoes That Pierce the Snow
abilities.canon:
When the Horn of Spring's Call from the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn attacks the opponent, Vodyanitsa gains the "Two Voices in Black and White" effect which increases the CRIT DMG from Hydro DMG and Cryo DMG dealt by your own currently active party member by 50% for 5s.
If there is a Wandering Vortex present on the field or in the 5s after a Wandering Vortex explodes, the effect changes to: increases the CRIT DMG from Stellar Swirl reaction DMG caused by your own currently active party member by 60% for 5s.
Additionally, the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn is enhanced as follows: the duration of the Song of Ages Past effect is extended by 9s.
abilities.simple: When the Horn of Spring’s Call attacks, she gains Two Voices in Black and White, raising the CRIT DMG of her Hydro damage.

abilities.name: Song Lingering on a Spring Morning
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of the Elemental Skill Rechitativ: Sonorous Dawn by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Melancholic Voice Upon the Gentle Waters
abilities.canon:
When Vodyanitsa triggers the healing effect of Song of Ages Past, an additional effect will be triggered based on the healed character's HP.
· If the character's HP is below 40%: The healing is increased by 50%; and
· If the character's HP is 40% or above: Vodyanitsa's Max HP is increased by 20% for 6s. Max 3 stacks, and each stack's duration is counted independently.
abilities.simple: Song of Ages Past healing gets an extra effect depending on the healed character’s HP, such as stronger healing below 40%.

abilities.name: Together, Down Into the Deep
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst Koda: Sink With Thee by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of the Elemental Burst Koda: Sink With Thee by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Neverending Song of Revelry
abilities.canon:
The Constellation Echoes That Pierce the Snow is enhanced: "Two Voices in Black and White" now applies to all nearby party members.
Additionally, while the Song of Ages Past effect is active, Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is elevated by 25% while Hydro DMG and Cryo DMG dealt are increased by 60%.
abilities.simple: Two Voices in Black and White now applies to the whole party, and party Stellar Swirl damage gets a boost.

fundamentals.simple: Her Skill reveals her Water Imp form: she attacks with Hydro from off the field and lowers enemies’ Hydro and Cryo RES.

yumemizukimizuki.name: Yumemizuki Mizuki
mistakes: Leaving Dreamdrifter early: her Swirl bonuses only work while she floats.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Pure Heart, Pure Dreams
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of Anemo, she plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Anemo attacks, an Anemo Charged Attack after a short cast, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage
abilities.canon:
Weaves memories of lovely dreams, entering a Dreamdrifter state where Yumemizuki Mizuki floats above the ground, and dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents.

Dreamdrifter
·While in the Dreamdrifter state, Yumemizuki Mizuki will continuously drift forward, dealing AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents at regular intervals.
·During this time, Yumemizuki Mizuki can control her direction of drift, and the pick-up distance of Yumemi Style Special Snacks from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will be increased.
·Increases the Swirl DMG and Stellar Swirl reaction DMG that nearby party members deal based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery.
·Dreamdrifter will end when Mizuki leaves the field or uses her Elemental Skill again.
abilities.simple: Anemo damage and the Dreamdrifter state: she floats, attacks enemies with Anemo and buffs Swirl damage based on her Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: Anraku Secret Spring Therapy
abilities.canon:
Summons forth countless lovely dreams and nightmares that pull in nearby objects and opponents, dealing AoE Anemo DMG and summoning a Mini Baku.

Mini Baku:
Follows the current active character. At regular intervals, the Mini Baku will create 1 Yumemi Style Special Snack nearby. After one of your own party members picks up a Special Snack, if their HP is higher than 70%, the Snack will explode and unleash a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to nearby opponents. Otherwise, it will heal the character who picked it up based on Yumemizuki Mizuki's Elemental Mastery. When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers healing by picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack, the amount of healing is increased by 100%. If a Snack is not picked up after a period of time, it will explode and release a Munen Shockwave, dealing 1 instance of AoE Anemo DMG to surrounding opponents.
abilities.simple: Pulls in enemies with Anemo damage and summons a Mini Baku that follows the active character and creates snacks that heal or deal damage.

abilities.name: Bright Moon's Restless Voice
abilities.canon: When Yumemizuki Mizuki triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while in her Dreamdrifter state, Dreamdrifter's duration increases by 2.5s. This effect can trigger once every 0.3s for a maximum of 2 times per Dreamdrifter state.
abilities.simple: Triggering Swirl or Stellar Swirl in Dreamdrifter extends its duration.

abilities.name: Thoughts by Day Bring Dreams by Night
abilities.canon: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, when other nearby party members hit opponents with Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro attacks, her Elemental Mastery will increase by 100 for 4s.
abilities.simple: In Dreamdrifter, when teammates hit with Pyro, Hydro, Cryo or Electro, she gains Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: All Ailments Banished
abilities.canon: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the party, party members have a chance to recover 30% additional HP when using healing foods that do not have reviving properties. The trigger chance for this effect increases with the corresponding character's Friendship Level. (This effect will always trigger if the Traveler is the character consuming healing food.)
abilities.razor: Better food heals. Not for fighting.
abilities.simple: Party members sometimes recover extra HP from healing foods. A world perk.

abilities.name: In Mist-Like Waters
abilities.canon: When Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, she will continuously apply the "Twenty-Three Nights' Awaiting" effect to nearby opponents for 3s every 3.5s. When an opponent has a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction triggered against them by Anemo DMG while the aforementioned effect is active, the effect will be canceled, and this Swirl or Stellar Swirl instance deals DMG against this opponent increased by 1,100% and 550% of Mizuki's Elemental Mastery, respectively.
abilities.simple: In Dreamdrifter she keeps applying Twenty-Three Nights’ Awaiting to nearby enemies for extra Swirl damage.

abilities.name: Your Echo I Meet in Dreams
abilities.canon: When Yumemizuki Mizuki enters the Dreamdrifter state, every Elemental Mastery point she has will increase all nearby party members' Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, and Electro DMG Bonuses by 0.04% until the Dreamdrifter state ends.
abilities.simple: Entering Dreamdrifter gives the party elemental damage bonus based on her Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: Till Dawn's Moon Ends Night
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Aisa Utamakura Pilgrimage by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Buds Warm Lucid Springs
abilities.canon: Picking up a Yumemi Style Special Snack from the Elemental Burst Anraku Secret Spring Therapy will both deal DMG and heal, and will restore 5 Energy to Yumemizuki Mizuki. Energy can be restored this way 4 times per Anraku Secret Spring Therapy duration.
abilities.simple: Picking up her Burst’s snacks deals damage and heals, and restores Energy.

abilities.name: As Setting Moon Brings Year's End
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Anraku Secret Spring Therapy by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Anraku Secret Spring Therapy by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: The Heart Lingers Long
abilities.canon: While Yumemizuki Mizuki is in the Dreamdrifter state, Swirl reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 30%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. Any Stellar Swirl reaction DMG dealt by these characters will also have its CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG increased by 10% and 20%, respectively.
abilities.simple: In Dreamdrifter, the party’s Swirl damage can crit.

fundamentals.simple: Mizuki’s Skill puts her in Dreamdrifter: she floats and Swirls, and teammates’ elemental hits extend it.

chasca.name: Chasca
chasca.role: Main DPS: Anemo with the party’s elements
mistakes: Playing her without Pyro, Hydro, Cryo or Electro teammates: her elemental shells need them.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Phantom Feather Flurry
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, mighty winds will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged wind arrow will deal Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 bow shots and an Aimed Shot.

abilities.name: Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt
abilities.canon:
Chasca and the will residing in her weapon resonate, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Anemo DMG.
After using this Skill, Chasca gains 80 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Chasca
Continually consume Nightsoul points. When Nightsoul points are fully depleted or the skill is used again, Chasca's Nightsoul's Blessing state will end. Her Nightsoul's Blessing has the following traits:
·Mounts "Soulsniper: Ritual Staff," increasing Chasca's Movement SPD and interruption resistance. In this state, Chasca will continually consume Nightsoul points to remain airborne. When Sprinting or increasing height, extra Nightsoul points will be consumed.
·When using Normal or Charged Attacks, Tap or Hold to switch between using "Multitarget Fire" in different ways.

Multitarget Fire
Tap
Deal Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG to opponents in front. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG.
Hold
Enter Aiming Mode and choose a certain number of opponents within a certain range, before loading up to 6 Shadowhunt Shells based on the duration for which the skill was charged. When 6 Shells have been loaded or charging is stopped, these Shells will be fired at the chosen opponents in sequence.

Shadowhunt Shells
·Deal Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG, which is considered Charged Attack DMG.
·The 4th, 5th, and 6th Shells loaded into the cylinder will undergo Elemental Conversion based on the Elemental Types of the other characters in the party: For each Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro character in the party, one Shadowhunt Shell will randomly be Converted into a "Shining Shadowhunt Shell" of one of these corresponding Elemental Types, dealing Nightsoul-aligned DMG corresponding to that Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
·The Shells loaded into the cylinder are fired starting from the last Shadowhunt Shell to be loaded, in a "last in, first out" order.

Additionally, when Chasca is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, Holding her Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt will cause her to execute a Nightsoul-aligned Plunging Attack. Release the Elemental Skill to interrupt this Plunging Attack and maintain her airborne state. Should Chasca hit the ground with her Plunging Attack, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.
abilities.simple: Anemo damage and she rides her weapon into the air with 80 Nightsoul points. Holding Normal Attack charges Multitarget Fire.

abilities.name: Soul Reaper's Fatal Round
abilities.canon:
Chasca concentrates her will, firing a single "Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell" that deals Nightsoul-aligned AoE Anemo DMG. Afterward, the Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell will split into 6 Soulseeker Shells, which attack nearby opponents.

Soulseeker Shells
·Deal Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG.
·For each Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro character in the party, two Soulseeker Shells will undergo corresponding Elemental Conversions to become "Radiant Soulseeker Shells," which deal Nightsoul-aligned Elemental DMG from a randomly selected one of the corresponding Elemental Types.
abilities.simple: One Galesplitting Soulseeker Shell, which splits into more shells that can carry the party’s elements.

abilities.name: Bullet Trick
abilities.canon:
When the Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt's Multitarget Fire is being charged, if there are party members who meet the Elemental Conversion Type requirements, gain the following effects based on the number of different eligible Elemental Types present:
·There is a 33.3%/66.7%/100% chance for each Type to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" and cause the 3rd Shadowhunt Shell loaded into the cylinder to be randomly converted into a Shining Shadowhunt Shell from one of the corresponding Elemental Types.
·Each Elemental Type will grant Chasca 1 stack of Spirit of the Radiant Shadow, increasing the DMG of Shining Shadowhunt Shell by 15%/35%/65%. This effect lasts until the current Multitarget Fire ends. Max 3 stacks.
abilities.simple: With Pyro, Hydro, Cryo or Electro teammates, Multitarget Fire loads Shadowhunt Shells of those elements.

abilities.name: Intent to Cover
abilities.canon:
When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Chasca will fire a "Burning Shadowhunt Shot" at a nearby opponent, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Anemo DMG equal to 150% of the Shadowhunt Shell DMG from her Elemental Skill Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt. If the party has Pyro, Hydro, Cryo, or Electro characters, the Burning Shadowhunt Shot will be converted to deal Nightsoul-aligned Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type equal to 150% of the DMG dealt by Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt's Shining Shadowhunt Shells.
The DMG done in this way is considered Charged Attack DMG.
abilities.simple: When the party triggers a Nightsoul Burst, she fires a Burning Shadowhunt Shot.

abilities.name: Night Realm's Gift: Everburning Heart
abilities.canon:
After her Nightsoul points are exhausted, Chasca will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, she can use Nightsoul Transmission: Chasca. When the active character is in the air, the following will occur when switching to Chasca: Chasca will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 32 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.
abilities.simple: When her Nightsoul points run out she keeps flying with Phlogiston. In Natlan she has Nightsoul Transmission.

abilities.name: Mediation's True Meaning
abilities.canon:
25 Phlogiston will be restored when your own party members defeat an opponent. This effect can trigger once every 12s.
This has no effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
abilities.simple: Defeating enemies in Natlan’s Phlogiston areas restores Phlogiston. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Cylinder, the Restless Roulette
abilities.canon:
When triggering the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick"'s "Spiritbinding Conversion," the 2nd Shadowhunt Shell loaded into the cylinder will be additionally converted into a Shining Shadowhunt Shell.
The chance to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" is increased: If there are party members who meet the Elemental Conversion Type requirements, the chance to trigger "Spiritbinding Conversion" is increased by 33.3%, up to a maximum of 100%.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick."
In addition, Chasca's Nightsoul point and Phlogiston consumption in her Nightsoul's Blessing state is decreased by 30% while out of combat.
abilities.simple: Her 1st Ascension Passive converts an extra shell to an element.

abilities.name: Muzzle, the Searing Smoke
abilities.canon:
When Chasca takes the field, she will obtain 1 stack of "Spirit of the Radiant Shadow" from the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick." You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick" for this effect.
In addition, when the Shining Shadowhunt Shells from Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt's Multitarget Fire hit opponents, they will deal AoE Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type of the Shining Shadowhunt Shells equal to 400% of Chasca's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once each time Chasca uses Multitarget Fire.
abilities.simple: When she takes the field she gets a stack of her passive’s buff.

abilities.name: Reins, Her Careful Control
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Sparks, the Sudden Shot
abilities.canon:
When the Radiant Soulseeker Shells from Soul Reaper's Fatal Round hit opponents, they will restore 1.5 Elemental Energy to Chasca, and deal AoE Elemental DMG of the corresponding Elemental Type of the Radiant Soulseeker Shells equal to 400% of Chasca's ATK. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
The aforementioned corresponding elemental AoE DMG effect can be triggered once each time Chasca uses Soul Reaper's Fatal Round.
abilities.simple: Her Burst’s shells restore Energy when they hit.

abilities.name: Brim, the Sandshadow's Silhouette
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Soul Reaper's Fatal Round by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Soul Reaper's Fatal Round by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Showdown, the Glory of Battle
abilities.canon:
Chasca's Multitarget Fire charge time is decreased, and after the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick"'s "Spiritbinding Conversion" is triggered, Chasca will gain the "Fatal Rounds" state: For the next 3s, the next time Chasca uses Spirit Reins, Shadow Hunt's Multitarget Fire, the shots will finish charging instantly, and the CRIT DMG of that instance of Multitarget Fire's Shadowhunt Shells and Shining Shadowhunt Shells increases by 120%. 1 "Fatal Rounds" effect can be gained once every 3s.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Bullet Trick" to gain access to the above effect.
abilities.simple: Multitarget Fire charges faster and her elemental shells get a CRIT DMG boost.

nicole.name: Nicole
nicole.role: Support: ATK buffs, shield and coordinated attacks
mistakes: Swapping the next character out before 3s: Guidance of Theosis needs them on the field for 3s.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Allegoria
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Proclaims a decree in the primordial tongue and performs up to 3 attacks that deal Pyro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Pyro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Nicole plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Also deals AoE Pyro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Pyro attacks, a Pyro Charged Attack after a short cast, and a Pyro plunge.

abilities.name: Revelation: Uncreated Light
abilities.canon:
Recreates a fleeting glimpse of an age long past, when the angels acted on the authority of the heavens, bestowing the Grace of Kenosis effect on nearby party members. This increases their ATK and deals AoE Pyro DMG, as well as creates a Shield of Blazing Light.
The Shield of Blazing Light's DMG Absorption is based on Nicole's ATK, and it will absorb Pyro DMG at 250% effectiveness.
abilities.simple: Gives nearby party members Grace of Kenosis (more ATK), deals Pyro damage and creates a Shield of Blazing Light that is extra strong against Pyro.

abilities.name: Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent
abilities.canon:
As Nicole weaves the path of anchored fate with golden threads of light, she deals AoE Pyro DMG and switches to Silent Contemplation mode.
In this mode, when nearby active party members hit an opponent, an Arcane Projection is summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG scales based on the corresponding character's ATK and will be considered as having been dealt by them.
This effect can occur once every 3s, and can be triggered up to 4 times each time Nicole switches to Silent Contemplation mode.

It is worth noting that Hexerei characters' Arcane Projections appear to differ somehow in appearance from the others...
abilities.simple: Pyro damage, then Silent Contemplation: when the active character hits, an Arcane Projection makes a coordinated attack in that character’s element, scaling on their stats.

abilities.name: Methexis
abilities.canon:
For 20s after unleashing the Elemental Skill Revelation: Uncreated Light, Nicole will continuously "observe" the other current active party members. After the observed character has remained on the field for 3s, their Grace of Kenosis is upgraded to Guidance of Theosis, increasing their ATK by an additional 300. If the observed character is a Hexerei character, Grace of Kenosis is upgraded to Guidance of Theosis straight away.
When characters other than Nicole who have Guidance of Theosis leave the field, their effect reverts to Grace of Kenosis.
abilities.simple: For 20s after her Skill, an active character who stays on the field for 3s gets Guidance of Theosis: an extra 300 ATK.

abilities.name: Philokalia
abilities.canon: When Elemental DMG from nearby active party members hits an opponent, Nicole's own Grace of Kenosis effect is upgraded to Guidance of Theosis for 8s.
abilities.simple: When the active character’s elemental damage hits, Nicole’s own Grace of Kenosis upgrades to Guidance of Theosis for 8s.

abilities.name: Nepsis
abilities.canon:
When you are in Teyvat and not in combat, Nicole's Charged Attack becomes "Emissarial Guidance" if you have already obtained the current region's Treasure Compass. Emissarial Guidance: Calls upon nearby Seelie to show the way, triggering an effect similar to the region's Treasure Compass.
This effect has a cooldown time of 5 seconds and does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, and the Spiral Abyss.
abilities.simple: Outside combat her Charged Attack can call Seelie to show the way, like the region’s Treasure Compass. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: "Do Not Be Afraid, Child Who Is Loved"
abilities.canon:
When the current active character of your own in the party hits an opponent, an additional special "Arcane Projection: Unity" will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack against the opponent, dealing AoE Elemental DMG of the character's corresponding Elemental Type at 600% of their ATK. This DMG will be considered as having been dealt by the corresponding character.
This effect can trigger once every 6s.
abilities.simple: The active character’s hits also summon an extra Arcane Projection for another coordinated attack.

abilities.name: "I Will Guide You and Show You the Path You Should Tread"
abilities.canon:
Enhances the effects of the Elemental Skill Revelation: Uncreated Light: Grace of Kenosis increases ATK by an additional 300 (which does not count toward this effect's ATK Bonus limit), while Guidance of Theosis decreases nearby opponents' Elemental RES based on the corresponding character's Elemental Type by 25%. This effect does not stack for the same Element.
Additionally, when Nicole unleashes her Elemental Skill Revelation: Uncreated Light, nearby active party members will also gain a Shield of Blazing Light.
