abilities.simple: Grace of Kenosis gives an extra 300 ATK, and Guidance of Theosis also lowers nearby enemies’ Elemental RES.

abilities.name: "A Lamp by Your Side, A Light to Shine the Way"
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Revelation: Uncreated Light by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Revelation: Uncreated Light by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "Whether Left or Right, No Matter Which Way You Turn"
abilities.canon:
When nearby party members have their Grace of Kenosis upgraded to Guidance of Theosis, Nicole also bestows upon them the Pathfinder's Blessing effect for 20s. Each character can gain this effect once every 16s.
The Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG of characters with Pathfinder's Blessing is increased by 70% of Nicole's ATK. This effect will be removed once it has taken effect 8 times or when its duration is over.
When multiple opponents are hit at once, instances of Pathfinder's Blessing are consumed equal to the number of opponents hit. Each character's Pathfinder's Blessing is counted independently.
abilities.simple: Characters upgraded to Guidance of Theosis also get Pathfinder’s Blessing for 20s (once every 16s each).

abilities.name: "You Will Hear My Voice Beside You"
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Revelation: Ladder of Divine Ascent by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "This Is the Path, Walk It Without Delay"
abilities.canon:
When Nicole's Grace of Kenosis is upgraded to Guidance of Theosis, all nearby party members' Grace of Kenosis will also be upgraded to Guidance of Theosis. Once upgraded, Guidance of Theosis will no longer revert to Grace of Kenosis.
Additionally, DMG dealt by characters with Guidance of Theosis will ignore 40% of opponents' DEF.
abilities.simple: When Nicole is upgraded, the whole party is too, and it no longer reverts; upgraded characters also deal more damage.

linnea.name: Linnea
linnea.role: Geo support: Lunar-Crystallize, healing and RES shred
mistakes: Forgetting Lumi’s Geo RES shred only works near Lumi: keep fights close to her.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Capture Protocol
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, stone crystals will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged crystalline arrow will deal Geo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 bow shots and an Aimed Shot that builds stone crystals on the arrowhead when charged.

abilities.name: Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!
abilities.canon:
Adventure with Lumi! Depending on how you Tap, Lumi attacks in different forms.

Tap
Lumi strikes in a Super Power Form, attacking nearby enemies continuously, dealing AoE Geo DMG. If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will also deal AoE Geo DMG to nearby enemies, which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

Continuous Tapping
Time to show what we're really capable of! After using her Elemental Skill, Linnea will feed Lumi sparkling gemstones when her Elemental Skill or Normal Attack is Tapped repeatedly. A full-bellied Lumi will strike in her Ultimate Power Form, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to Standard Power Form.
Additionally, tapping the Elemental Skill increases Linnea's interruption resistance.
abilities.simple: Lumi attacks in different forms depending on how you tap. In Super Power Form she keeps dealing Geo damage, and near Moondrifts some of it counts as Lunar-Crystallize.

abilities.name: Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions
abilities.canon:
Even master adventurers need proper rest! Linnea summons Lumi to strike in Super Power Form, healing nearby party members. For a short duration, she will continuously heal nearby active party members based on Linnea's DEF.
If Lumi is already on the field when Linnea unleashes Elemental Burst, Lumi's active duration will be reset instead and her Strike Form will not change.
abilities.simple: Summons Lumi in Super Power Form and heals the party, then keeps healing the active character based on Linnea’s DEF. If Lumi is out, her timer resets instead.

abilities.name: Field Observation Notes
abilities.canon:
When Lumi is present on the field, the Geo RES of opponents near Lumi will decrease by 15%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Linnea's Elemental Skill Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry! and Elemental Burst Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions are enhanced. After summoning Lumi, the Geo RES of opponents near Lumi will be further decreased by 15%.
abilities.simple: While Lumi is out, nearby enemies’ Geo RES drops by 15%, with stronger effects under Ascendant Gleam.

abilities.name: Universal Naturalist Archive
abilities.canon:
Linnea will increase the Elemental Mastery of certain characters in your party according to your current active character. Increase in Elemental Mastery is based on 5% of Linnea's DEF. If your current active character:
· Is a Moonsign character: Increase this character's Elemental Mastery.
· Is not a Moonsign character: Increase Linnea's own Elemental Mastery.
abilities.simple: Raises some party members’ Elemental Mastery by 5% of her DEF, depending on who is active.

abilities.name: Moonsign Benediction: Habitat Survey
abilities.canon:
When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Linnea has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Linnea is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
abilities.simple: With Linnea in the party, Hydro Crystallize becomes Lunar-Crystallize, and her DEF raises its base damage.

abilities.name: Master Adventurer
abilities.canon:
When Linnea is not in combat, the charge time of her Aimed Shot is greatly decreased, and she will shoot an Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow instead. Different effects will occur depending on the targets hit:
· Specific animals: Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow will be transformed into a special "Net" that can capture the essence and form of these animals, using them as a medium to manifest the animal's physical form again. The "Net" can only be used for a limited number of times each week. 
· Ore veins used in forging: Linnea will dispatch Lumi, who will quickly strike at the ore marked by the Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow, then collect the dislodged ore. If Lumi is not on the field, Linnea will summon her for a short duration to help obtain the ore.

The DMG dealt to opponents by Linnea's Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow is reduced to 20% of her original Charged Arrow. Additionally, after firing a certain number of Ultra Convenient Quick Arrows within a short period of time, Linnea needs to take a temporary break before she can continue using them.
abilities.simple: Outside combat her Aimed Shot charges much faster as an Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Provisional Classification
abilities.canon:
When unleashing Elemental Skill Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea gains 6 stacks of the Field Catalog effect for 10s. Max 18 stacks. When nearby party members deal Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, consume 1 stack of Field Catalog to increase the DMG dealt. The increase in DMG is equal to 75% of Linnea's DEF.
Additionally, when Lumi uses Million Ton Crush in her Ultimate Power Form, Linnea can consume up to 5 stacks of Field Catalog. Each stack will increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Linnea's DEF.
abilities.simple: Her Skill or Moondrift Harmony gives Field Catalog stacks (6 at a time, up to 18) that boost party damage.

abilities.name: Tidings of Joy and Sorrow
abilities.canon:
Within 8s after triggering Moondrift Harmony, all Hydro and Geo party members have their CRIT DMG increased by 40%. Additionally, when Lumi uses Million Ton Crush in her Ultimate Power Form, the CRIT DMG of that attack increases by an additional 150%. 

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When Lumi uses Heavy Overdrive Hammer in her Super Power Form, or when she uses Million Ton Crush in her Ultimate Power Form, an instance of Moondrift Harmony will be triggered. For this instance of Moondrift Harmony, all Hydro and Geo characters in the party will be considered to have applied their Elements in the reaction.
abilities.simple: For 8s after Moondrift Harmony, Hydro and Geo party members gain 40% CRIT DMG.

abilities.name: Eventful Log Page
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry! by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry! by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Expert Instinct
abilities.canon: Within 5s after Moondrift Harmony is triggered, increase the DEF of Linnea and your current active character by 25% respectively. When Linnea is on field, the DEF-increasing effect can be stacked.
abilities.simple: For 5s after Moondrift Harmony, Linnea and the active character gain 25% DEF.

abilities.name: Fairyland's Farewell Gift
abilities.canon:
Elemental Burst Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions increases by 3 Levels.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of a talent by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Golden Beagle's Dream
abilities.canon:
The effects of the Constellation, Provisional Classification, are enhanced: When unleashing Elemental Skill Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea will directly gain the maximum number of Field Catalog stacks. When consuming Field Catalog, consume twice the original number of stacks, such that the increase in DMG will be boosted to 150% of the original value.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is elevated by 25%.
abilities.simple: Her Skill or Moondrift Harmony gives the maximum Field Catalog stacks right away.

fundamentals.simple: Linnea fights through her partner Lumi, who deals Geo damage, lowers Geo RES and heals. Her support scales on DEF.

sucrose.name: Sucrose
sucrose.role: Support: Swirl, EM sharing and grouping
mistakes: Using her Skill before teammates have applied an element: there’s nothing to Swirl yet.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Wind Spirit Creation
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 attacks using Wind Spirits, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of her Wind Spirits, Sucrose plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 Anemo attacks, an Anemo Charged Attack after a short cast, and an Anemo plunge.

abilities.name: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308
abilities.canon: Creates a small Wind Spirit that pulls opponents and objects towards its location, launches opponents within its AoE, and deals Anemo DMG.
abilities.simple: A small wind spirit that pulls enemies in and deals Anemo damage.

abilities.name: Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II
abilities.canon:
Sucrose hurls an unstable concoction that creates a Large Wind Spirit.
While it persists, the Large Wind Spirit will continuously pull in surrounding opponents and objects, launch nearby opponents, and deal Anemo DMG.

Elemental Absorption
If the Wind Spirit comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro energy, it will deal additional elemental DMG of that type.
Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use.
abilities.simple: A big wind spirit that pulls enemies in for a while. If it touches Pyro, Hydro, Electro or Cryo, it adds that element.

abilities.name: Catalyst Conversion
abilities.canon: When Sucrose triggers a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, all characters in the party with the matching element (excluding Sucrose) have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50 for 8s.
abilities.simple: When she triggers Swirl, party members of that element gain 50 Elemental Mastery for 8s.

abilities.name: Mollis Favonius
abilities.canon: When Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 or Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Sucrose) Elemental Mastery by an amount equal to 20% of Sucrose's Elemental Mastery for 8s.
abilities.simple: When her Skill or Burst hits, the party gains 20% of her Elemental Mastery for 8s.

abilities.name: Astable Invention
abilities.canon: When Sucrose crafts Character and Weapon Enhancement Materials, she has a 10% chance to obtain double the product.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: Clustered Vacuum Field
abilities.canon: Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 gains 1 additional charge.
abilities.simple: Her Skill gets 1 extra charge.

abilities.name: Beth: Unbound Form
abilities.canon: The duration of Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II is increased by 2s.
abilities.simple: Her Burst lasts 2s longer.

abilities.name: Flawless Alchemistress
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Alchemania
abilities.canon:
Sucrose will reduce the CD of Astable Anemohypostasis Creation - 6308 by 1-7s for every 7 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores against opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.
abilities.simple: Every 7 Normal or Charged Attacks cut her Skill cooldown by 1–7s.

abilities.name: Caution: Standard Flask
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Chaotic Entropy
abilities.canon: If Forbidden Creation - Isomer 75 / Type II triggers an Elemental Absorption, all party members gain a 20% Elemental DMG Bonus for the corresponding absorbed element during its duration.
abilities.simple: If her Burst absorbs an element, the party gains 20% DMG Bonus of that element.

ineffa.name: Ineffa
mistakes: Letting her shield and Birgitta run out: refresh her Skill every rotation.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Cyclonic Duster
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a spinning attack.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 spear strikes, a spinning Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency
abilities.canon:
Ineffa engages her Enhanced Cleaning Module, dealing a single instance of AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents, activating her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, and summoning the Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, Birgitta.
The Optical Flow Shield Barrier absorbs DMG based on Ineffa's ATK, and it will absorb Electro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
abilities.simple: Electro damage, an Optical Flow Shield Barrier (extra strong against Electro) and her helper Birgitta, who keeps attacking.

abilities.name: Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator
abilities.canon:
Through Multipurpose Smart Assistance Unit, Birgitta, Ineffa can use Rocket Punches to quickly clean up opponents! Shoots Birgitta into the fray, dealing AoE Electro DMG and allowing Birgitta to remain on the field.

If Birgitta is already on the field, having been summoned by Ineffa, this Skill will re-summon Birgitta at the target's location and reset her duration.
abilities.simple: Shoots Birgitta into the fight for Electro damage and keeps her out; if she’s already out, she moves to the target and her timer resets.

abilities.name: Overclocking Circuit
abilities.canon: If there are thunderclouds created by Lunar-Charged reactions nearby when Birgitta unleashes Discharge attacks, she will initiate an additional attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 65% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
abilities.simple: When Birgitta discharges near Lunar-Charged thunderclouds, she adds an Electro hit worth 65% of Ineffa’s ATK, counted as Lunar-Charged.

abilities.name: Panoramic Permutation Protocol
abilities.canon: When using the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator, all your party members will gain the Parameter Permutation effect: Increases Ineffa and your own active party member's Elemental Mastery by 6% of Ineffa's ATK for 20s.
abilities.simple: Her Burst gives Ineffa and the active character Elemental Mastery equal to 6% of her ATK for 20s.

abilities.name: Moonsign Benediction: Assemblage Hub
abilities.canon:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Ineffa has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Ineffa is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
abilities.simple: With Ineffa in the party, Electro-Charged becomes Lunar-Charged, and her ATK raises its base damage (up to 14%). She also raises the party’s Moonsign.

abilities.name: Flavor Synthesis Unit
abilities.canon:
When Ineffa uses food, there is a 30% chance of gaining a seasoning ingredient.

Additionally, in Nod-Krai, it seems you'll be able to change Birgitta's appearance through certain means...
abilities.simple: Sometimes gives a seasoning ingredient when she uses food. A world perk.

abilities.name: Rectifying Processor
abilities.canon: When Ineffa activates her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, all nearby party members will gain the Carrier Flow Composite effect for 20s: Increases Lunar-Charged DMG by 2.5% for every 100 ATK that Ineffa has, up to a maximum of 50%.
abilities.simple: Her shield gives the party more Lunar-Charged damage based on her ATK (up to 50%).

abilities.name: Support Cleaning Module
abilities.canon:
After the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator hits opponents, it will inflict the Punishment Edict status on one of those hit opponents: After a brief delay, or when this opponent is defeated, nearby opponents will take AoE Electro DMG equal to 300% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Additionally, when the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator is unleashed, nearby party members will gain Optical Flow Shield Barriers.
abilities.simple: Her Burst marks an enemy; after a short delay, or when it’s defeated, nearby enemies take Electro damage.

abilities.name: Enhanced Emotion Emulator
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: The Edictless Path
abilities.canon: When your own party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, recover 5 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 4s.
abilities.simple: Party Lunar-Charged reactions restore 5 Energy to her (once every 4s).

abilities.name: Mirror's Dream Transcension
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: A Dawning Morn for You
abilities.canon: When Ineffa is affected by the Carrier Flow Composite effect, she will deal AoE Electro DMG equal to 135% of her ATK to opponents in the current active character's vicinity after nearby thunderclouds release bursts of lightning at opponents. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 3.5s.
abilities.simple: With her Carrier Flow buff, thundercloud strikes are followed by extra Electro damage from her, counted as Lunar-Charged.

skirk.name: Skirk
mistakes: Starting her combo before her Hydro and Cryo teammates have hit: they give her Death’s Crossing stacks.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Havoc: Sunder
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive attacks.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a spinning crystal spear, dealing DMG to opponents ahead.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 sword strikes, a spinning crystal spear Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Havoc: Warp
abilities.canon:
Imitates the combat style of "The Foul." Produces different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

Tap
Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and switches to Seven-Phase Flash mode.

Hold
Skirk gains 45 Serpent's Subtlety and will continuously move at high speed. Her interruption resistance is increased in this state.
During this time, Skirk can control her movement direction and move atop water. She can also use this Skill again to end rapid movement prematurely.
abilities.simple: Both versions give her 45 Serpent’s Subtlety. Tap: she switches to Seven-Phase Flash mode. Hold: she moves at high speed, even over water.

abilities.name: Havoc: Ruin
abilities.canon:
Skirk's Elemental Burst is not reliant on Elemental Energy but instead on Serpent's Subtlety.
When Skirk has at least 50 Serpent's Subtlety, she can expend all her Serpent's Subtlety to unleash her Elemental Burst, ripping the space before her apart and using rapid consecutive slashes that deal AoE Cryo DMG. At the same time, the DMG dealt by an instance of this Elemental Burst will be increased by every point of Serpent's Subtlety over 50 when it is unleashed. Up to 12 points can be counted for this purpose.

When Skirk is in Seven-Phase Flash mode, Havoc: Ruin will be replaced by Havoc: Extinction.

Havoc: Extinction
A special Elemental Burst that can be used even without consuming Serpent's Subtlety.
After using it, Skirk will gain the "All Shall Wither" effect, which will last until Seven-Phase Flash ends. After unlocking the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason, she can also absorb nearby Void Rifts.
While "All Shall Wither" is active, every 0.1s, after Skirk's Normal Attack hits an opponent, that Normal Attack will deal increased DMG. If she absorbed any Void Rifts while using Havoc: Extinction, this Normal Attack's DMG will be further increased based on the number of Rifts absorbed.
This effect will be canceled when it has triggered 10 times.
abilities.simple: Runs on Serpent’s Subtlety, not Energy. With at least 50 she spends it all on fast Cryo slashes; every point over 50 (up to 12) adds damage. In Seven-Phase Flash mode it changes.

abilities.name: Reason Beyond Reason
abilities.canon:
When nearby party members trigger Frozen, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Cryo Swirl, Stellar Swirl, or Cryo Crystallize reactions against opponents, a Void Rift will be created near this opponent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.5s. 3 Void Rifts created by Skirk herself can exist on the field at once.

Skirk can use the following methods to absorb nearby Void Rifts:
· When she hits an opponent with a Charged Attack in her Seven-Phase Flash mode.
· When she uses the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in Seven-Phase Flash mode.
· When she Holds her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp to engage in rapid movement.

Each Rift absorbed will grant her 8 Serpent's Subtlety points.
abilities.razor: Friend reactions make holes. Eat holes.
abilities.simple: When the party triggers Frozen, Superconduct, Cryo Swirl or Cryo Crystallize (and their Stellar versions), a Void Rift appears near the enemy (once every 2.5s). Skirk can absorb them.

abilities.name: Return to Oblivion
abilities.canon:
When nearby Hydro party members' Hydro attacks hit opponents, or when nearby Cryo party members apart from Skirk hit opponents with Cryo attacks, Skirk will gain the "Death's Crossing" effect for 20s. Max 3 stacks, each stack's duration is counted independently.
Each character can grant Skirk at most 1 "Death's Crossing" stack by this means.
Each "Death's Crossing" stack increases the Normal Attack DMG dealt by Skirk in Seven-Phase Flash mode to 110%/120%/170% of its original DMG and the DMG dealt when using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin to 105%/115%/160% of its original DMG.
abilities.simple: When Hydro teammates’ Hydro attacks, or other Cryo teammates’ Cryo attacks, hit enemies, Skirk gains a Death’s Crossing stack for 20s (max 3, one per teammate).

abilities.name: Mutual Weapons Mentorship
abilities.canon: When all party members are either Hydro or Cryo, and if there is at least 1 Hydro and 1 Cryo character, your own party members' Elemental Skill Level is increased by 1.
abilities.simple: If every party member is Hydro or Cryo, with at least one of each, the party’s Elemental Skill level goes up by 1.

abilities.name: Far to Fall
abilities.canon:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason: Every Void Rift absorbed will summon a crystal blade to attack nearby opponents, dealing 500% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason.
abilities.simple: Each Void Rift she absorbs also summons a crystal blade for 500% of her ATK as Cryo damage.

abilities.name: Into the Abyss
abilities.canon:
After unleashing her Elemental Skill Havoc: Warp, Skirk will gain 10 additional Serpent's Subtlety points.
When using her Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, the DMG of this Elemental Burst instance will be increased by taking up to 10 more Serpent's Subtlety points into account.
Additionally, within 12.5s after Skirk unleashes the special Elemental Burst Havoc: Extinction while in her Seven-Phase Flash mode, her ATK is increased by 70%. This effect will be canceled when she leaves the Seven-Phase Flash mode.
abilities.simple: Her Skill gives 10 more Serpent’s Subtlety, and her Burst can count up to 10 more points for damage.

abilities.name: Serendipitous Sin
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Havoc: Ruin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Havoc: Ruin by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Fractured Flow
abilities.canon:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent Return to Oblivion: Each Death's Crossing stack also increases Skirk's ATK by 10%/20%/40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Return to Oblivion.
abilities.simple: Each Death’s Crossing stack also raises her ATK (10%, 20% or 40%).

abilities.name: End of Wishes
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Havoc: Warp by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Havoc: Warp by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: To the Source
abilities.canon:
Each Void Rift Skirk absorbs via the effects of the Ascension Talent Reason Beyond Reason will grant her 1 Havoc: Sever stack. She can consume such stacks to initiate coordinated attacks and decrease the DMG she takes while in Seven-Phase Flash mode. These stacks last for 15s, and each stack's duration is counted independently (max 3 stacks).
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Reason Beyond Reason."

Havoc: Sever
· When Skirk uses the Elemental Burst Havoc: Ruin, she will consume all Havoc: Sever stacks to initiate a coordinated attack in which each Havoc: Sever stack will deal 750% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
· When she uses Normal Attacks while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 Havoc: Sever stack will be consumed when her third or fifth sequenced attacks hit an opponent to launch 3 coordinated attacks. Each coordinated attack deals 180% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This damage is considered Normal Attack DMG.
· When Skirk takes DMG while in Seven-Phase Flash mode, 1 Havoc: Sever stack will be consumed to decrease this DMG instance by 80% and attack nearby opponents 3 times, with each attack dealing 180% of Skirk's ATK as Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
abilities.simple: Each absorbed Void Rift gives her a Havoc: Sever stack, which she spends on coordinated attacks and damage reduction in Seven-Phase Flash mode.

bennett.name: Bennett
mistakes: Walking out of his Burst field: both the healing and the ATK bonus are only inside it.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Strike of Fortune
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 sword strikes, a two-hit Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Passion Overload
abilities.canon:
Bennett puts all his fire and passion for adventuring into his sword. Results may vary based on how fired up he is...

Press
A single, swift flame strike that deals Pyro DMG.

Hold (Short)
Charges up, resulting in different effects when unleashed based on the Charge Level.
·Level 1: Strikes twice, dealing Pyro DMG and launching opponents.
·Level 2: Unleashes 3 consecutive attacks that deal impressive Pyro DMG, but the last attack triggers an explosion that launches both Bennett and the enemy.
Bennett takes no damage from being launched.
abilities.simple: A quick Pyro strike. Holding charges it up for more hits.

abilities.name: Fantastic Voyage
abilities.canon:
Bennett performs a jumping attack that deals Pyro DMG, creating an Inspiration Field.

Inspiration Field
·If the health of a character within the AoE is equal to or falls below 70%, their health will continuously regenerate. The amount of HP restored scales off Bennett's Max HP.
·If the health of a character within the AoE is higher than 70%, they gain an ATK Bonus that is based on Bennett's Base ATK.
·Imbues characters within the AoE with Pyro.
abilities.razor: Stand in circle. Heal and strong.
abilities.simple: A Pyro hit and an Inspiration Field: inside it, characters at 70% HP or less keep healing, characters above 70% gain an ATK bonus based on Bennett’s base ATK, and everyone inside is affected by Pyro.

abilities.name: Rekindle
abilities.canon: Decreases Passion Overload's CD by 20%.
abilities.simple: His Skill cooldown is 20% shorter.

abilities.name: Fearnaught
abilities.canon:
Within the area created by Fantastic Voyage, Passion Overload takes on the following effects:
·CD is reduced by 50%.
·Bennett will not be launched by the effects of Charge Level 2.
abilities.simple: Inside his Burst field, his Skill cooldown is halved.

abilities.name: It Should Be Safe...
abilities.canon: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: Grand Expectation
abilities.canon: Fantastic Voyage's ATK increase no longer has an HP restriction, and gains an additional 20% of Bennett's Base ATK.
abilities.simple: The field’s ATK bonus no longer needs HP above 70%, and it gets bigger (an extra 20% of his base ATK).

abilities.name: Impasse Conqueror
abilities.canon: When Bennett's HP falls below 70%, his Energy Recharge is increased by 30%.
abilities.simple: He gains 30% Energy Recharge while his HP is below 70%.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Fervor
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Passion Overload by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Passion Overload by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Unexpected Odyssey
abilities.canon:
Using a Normal Attack as the second attack of Passion Overload's Charge Level 1 will perform a follow-up attack.
This additional attack does 135% of the second attack's DMG.
abilities.simple: Charge level 1 of his Hold Skill adds an extra attack.

abilities.name: True Explorer
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Fantastic Voyage by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Fantastic Voyage by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Fire Ventures With Me
abilities.canon: Sword, Claymore, or Polearm-wielding characters inside Fantastic Voyage's radius gain a 15% Pyro DMG Bonus and their weapons are infused with Pyro.
abilities.simple: Sword, Claymore and Polearm users in his field gain 15% Pyro DMG Bonus and their attacks become Pyro.

zibai.name: Zibai
mistakes: Letting Lunar Phase Shift run out with Radiance unused: spend it on Spirit Steed’s Stride.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Golden Blade's Petaled Touch
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 rapid strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 rapid strikes, a 2-hit Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Heaven and Earth Made Manifest
abilities.canon:
Summoning a shadow of her former powers, she switches to the Lunar Phase Shift mode.
In this mode, Zibai's Normal Attacks and Charged Attacks will deal Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by other infusions, and she can accrue special Phase Shift Radiance through different methods. Zibai can consume Phase Shift Radiance to unleash the special Elemental Skill Spirit Steed's Stride.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
While in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, when Zibai performs Normal Attacks, the fourth attack will deal an additional instance of Geo DMG, which is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
abilities.simple: She enters Lunar Phase Shift: her Normal and Charged Attacks deal Geo that can’t be overridden, and she builds Phase Shift Radiance to use Spirit Steed’s Stride.

abilities.name: Tri-Sphere Eminence
abilities.canon:
Zibai operates the Jadelight Canopy, dealing two instances of Geo DMG, with the second damage instance being considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
When cast, if Zibai is in the Lunar Phase Shift, the duration of the current Lunar Phase Shift will extend by an additional 1.7s.
abilities.simple: Two hits of Geo damage; the second counts as Lunar-Crystallize. In Lunar Phase Shift it extends the mode by 1.7s.

abilities.name: The Selenic Adeptus Descends
abilities.canon: When casting the Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest, or when nearby party members trigger Moondrift Harmony, Zibai gains the Selenic Descent effect for 4s: The DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of Spirit Steed's Stride is increased by 60% of Zibai's DEF.
abilities.simple: After her Skill, or when the party triggers Moondrift Harmony, the 2nd hit of Spirit Steed’s Stride gains damage from 60% of her DEF for 4s.

abilities.name: Layered Peaks Pierce the Clouds
abilities.canon: Other Geo party members increase Zibai's DEF by 15% each. Hydro party members increase her Elemental Mastery by 60 each.
abilities.razor: Geo friends = DEF. Hydro friends = EM.
abilities.simple: Each other Geo party member gives her 15% DEF; each Hydro party member gives her 60 Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: Moonsign Benediction: The Coursing Sun and Moon
abilities.canon:
When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Zibai has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Zibai is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
abilities.simple: With Zibai in the party, Hydro Crystallize becomes Lunar-Crystallize, and her DEF raises its base damage.

abilities.name: Moonlit Flower Forest
abilities.canon:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), when not in combat, restore 1 Elemental Energy to Zibai every 2 seconds.
This effect does not work in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
abilities.simple: At night outside combat she slowly restores Energy. Doesn’t work in Domains and similar.

abilities.name: Burst Forth With Vigor, But Enter in Silence
abilities.canon:
After using the Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest, Zibai will immediately gain 100 Phase Shift Radiance, and the max number of Spirit Steed's Stride usages per Lunar Phase Shift mode is increased to 5 times.
Additionally, each time you switch to the Lunar Phase Shift mode, the first Spirit Steed's Stride's 2nd-hit Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 220%.
abilities.simple: Her Skill gives 100 Phase Shift Radiance right away and more Spirit Steed’s Stride uses per mode.

abilities.name: At Birth Are Souls Born, and in Death Leave But Husks
abilities.canon:
When in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, all nearby party members' Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG is increased by 30%.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Ascension Talent The Selenic Adeptus Descends is enhanced: the DMG dealt by the 2nd hit of Spirit Steed's Stride is further increased by 550% of Zibai's DEF. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "The Selenic Adeptus Descends."
abilities.simple: In Lunar Phase Shift, the party’s Lunar-Crystallize damage rises by 30%.

abilities.name: Free From Constraints and Worldly Ties
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Elemental Skill Heaven and Earth Made Manifest by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: The Spirit Passes, Then Form Follows
abilities.canon: While in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, Zibai's Normal Attack sequence will not reset, and when Spirit Steed's Stride hits opponents, Zibai will gain the "Scattermoon Splendor" effect: The next time she uses Normal Attacks, the additional attack from her 4th hit will deal 250% of the original damage as Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.
abilities.simple: In Lunar Phase Shift her Normal Attack string doesn’t reset, and Spirit Steed’s Stride hits give her Scattermoon Splendor.

abilities.name: Perceive the Worthless and Debate It Not
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Tri-Sphere Eminence by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Tri-Sphere Eminence by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: The World, A Journey in Passing
abilities.canon:
While Zibai is in the Lunar Phase Shift mode, her Phase Shift Radiance gain rate is increased by 50%.
Additionally, Spirit Steed's Stride will change such that it will consume all Phase Shift Radiance. This will elevate the DMG dealt by this instance of Spirit Steed's Stride and the Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by Zibai within the next 3s by 1.6% for every point consumed above 70. This effect cannot stack.
abilities.simple: Radiance builds 50% faster, and Spirit Steed’s Stride uses all of it for more damage.

fundamentals.simple: Zibai’s Skill starts Lunar Phase Shift: her attacks become Geo and she builds Phase Shift Radiance for Spirit Steed’s Stride.

flins.name: Flins
mistakes: Trying to plunge in Manifest Flame form: he can’t.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Pocztowy Demonspear
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward spear throw.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 spear strikes, a spear-throw Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Ancient Rite: Arcane Light
abilities.canon:
Flins summons forth the ancient power concealed within his lamp and switches to his Manifest Flame form. This form has the following characteristics:
· Flins's Normal and Charged Attacks deal Electro DMG that cannot be overridden by other Elemental infusions, and he is unable to perform Plunging Attacks.
· His interruption resistance is increased.
· His Elemental Skill Ancient Rite: Arcane Light is replaced with the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm.

Northland Spearstorm
Flins summons a flurry of spears in front, dealing AoE Electro DMG and causing his Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night to be replaced with the special Elemental Burst Thunderous Symphony for the next 6s.
The base CD of Northland Spearstorm is 6s and will not be affected by other effects.
abilities.simple: Switches him to Manifest Flame form: his Normal and Charged Attacks deal Electro that can’t be overridden, he can’t plunge, and his Skill becomes Northland Spearstorm, which also upgrades his Burst.

abilities.name: Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night
abilities.canon:
Flins unleashes the true power of his lamp, dealing AoE Electro DMG and, after a short delay, dealing 2 instances of middle-phase and 1 instance of final-phase AoE Electro DMG, all of which are considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional 2 instances of middle-phase Lunar-Charged AoE Electro DMG.

After using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, Flins's Elemental Burst Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night will be replaced with the special Elemental Burst Thunderous Symphony for the next 6s.

Thunderous Symphony
Consume less Elemental Energy to unleash a special Elemental Burst. Flins deals a single instance of AoE Electro DMG that is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Flins's Skill is enhanced: If there are thunderclouds nearby, Flins will deal an additional instance of Lunar-Charged AoE Electro DMG.
abilities.simple: Electro damage now, then more hits after a short delay, all counted as Lunar-Charged damage. With Ascendant Gleam and nearby thunderclouds it adds two more.

abilities.name: Symphony of Winter
abilities.canon:
Flins will gain a corresponding buff effect based on the party's Moonsign.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged reactions triggered by Flins will deal an additional 20% DMG.
abilities.simple: With Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam, Lunar-Charged reactions Flins triggers deal 20% more damage.

abilities.name: Whispering Flame
abilities.canon: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 160.
abilities.simple: Flins gains Elemental Mastery equal to 8% of his ATK (up to 160).

abilities.name: Moonsign Benediction: Old World Secrets
abilities.canon:
When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Flins has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Flins is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
abilities.simple: With Flins in the party, Electro-Charged becomes Lunar-Charged, and his ATK raises its base damage (up to 14%). He also raises the party’s Moonsign.

abilities.name: A Light in the Dark
abilities.canon:
Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
Additionally, Flins appears to be able to decipher the whispers of the Wild Hunt...
abilities.simple: Shows nearby Nod-Krai resources on the mini-map. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Part the Veil of Snow
abilities.canon:
The basic cooldown of the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm is reduced to 4s.
Additionally, when party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, Flins will recover 8 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 5.5s.
abilities.simple: Northland Spearstorm’s cooldown drops to 4s, and he recovers 8 Energy when the party triggers Lunar-Charged (once every 5.5s).

abilities.name: The Devil's Wall
abilities.canon:
For the next 6s after using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, when Flins's next Normal Attack hits an opponent, it will deal an additional 50% of Flins's ATK as AoE Electro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: While Flins is on the field, after his Electro attacks hit an opponent, that opponent's Electro RES will be decreased by 25% for 7s.
abilities.simple: After Northland Spearstorm, his next Normal Attack hit deals extra Electro damage counted as Lunar-Charged.

abilities.name: Stranger in the Night
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Night on Bald Mountain
abilities.canon:
Flins's ATK is increased by 20%.
Additionally, his Ascension Talent Whispering Flame is enhanced: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 10% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 220.
abilities.simple: 20% more ATK, and his 4th Ascension Passive converts more ATK into Elemental Mastery (up to 220).

abilities.name: Exile's Shadow
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Ancient Rite: Arcane Light by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Ancient Rite: Arcane Light by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Songs and Dances of Death
abilities.canon:
The DMG dealt to opponents by Flins's Lunar-Charged reactions is elevated by 35%.
Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Charged DMG is elevated by 10%.
abilities.simple: His Lunar-Charged damage is elevated by 35%; with Ascendant Gleam the whole party’s Lunar-Charged damage is elevated by 10%.

yaemiko.name: Yae Miko
mistakes: Bursting before all 3 Sesshou Sakura are placed: the Burst gets stronger with each one, and gives Skill charges back.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Spiritfox Sin-Eater
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Summons forth kitsune spirits, initiating a maximum of 3 attacks that deal Electro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Electro DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path with thunderous might. Deals AoE Electro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Electro attacks, an Electro Charged Attack after a short cast, and an Electro plunge.

abilities.name: Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura
abilities.canon:
To Yae, such dull tasks as can be accomplished by driving spirits out need not be done personally.
Moves swiftly, leaving a Sesshou Sakura behind.

Sesshou Sakura
Has the following properties:
· Periodically strikes one nearby opponent with lightning, dealing Electro DMG
· When there are other Sesshou Sakura nearby, their level will increase, boosting the DMG dealt by these lightning strikes.

This skill has three charges.
A maximum of 3 Sesshou Sakura can exist simultaneously. The initial level of each Sesshou Sakura is 1, and the initial highest level each sakura can reach is 3. If a new Sesshou Sakura is created too close to an existing one, the existing one will be destroyed.
abilities.simple: She dashes away and leaves a Sesshou Sakura that keeps striking enemies with Electro lightning. Up to 3 can be out at once.

abilities.name: Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin
abilities.canon:
Legends of "kitsunetsuki," or the manifestation of a kitsune's might, are common in Inazuma's folktales. One that particularly captures the imagination is that of the Sky Kitsune, said to cause lightning to fall down upon the foes of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Summons a lightning strike, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
When she uses this skill, Yae Miko will unseal nearby Sesshou Sakura, destroying their outer forms and transforming them into Tenko Thunderbolts that descend from the skies, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Each Sesshou Sakura destroyed in this way will create one Tenko Thunderbolt.
abilities.simple: A big Electro strike; each Sesshou Sakura on the field is destroyed for a Tenko Thunderbolt that deals more Electro damage.

abilities.name: The Shrine's Sacred Shade
abilities.canon: When casting Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin, each Sesshou Sakura destroyed resets the cooldown for 1 charge of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura.
abilities.simple: Each Sesshou Sakura her Burst destroys resets the cooldown of 1 Skill charge.

abilities.name: Enlightened Blessing
abilities.canon: Every point of Elemental Mastery Yae Miko possesses will increase Sesshou Sakura DMG by 0.15%.
abilities.simple: Each point of Elemental Mastery raises Sesshou Sakura damage by 0.15%.

abilities.name: Meditations of a Yako
abilities.canon: Has a 25% chance to get 1 regional Character Talent Material (base material excluded) when crafting. The rarity is that of the base material.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: Yakan Offering
abilities.canon: Each time Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin activates a Tenko Thunderbolt, Yae Miko will restore 8 Elemental Energy for herself.
abilities.simple: Each Tenko Thunderbolt restores 8 Energy to her.

abilities.name: Fox's Mooncall
abilities.canon: Sesshou Sakura start at Level 2 when created, their max level is increased to 4, and their attack range is increased by 60%.
abilities.simple: Sesshou Sakura start at level 2, go up to level 4 and reach further.

abilities.name: The Seven Glamours
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Sakura Channeling
abilities.canon: When Sesshou Sakura lightning hits opponents, the Electro DMG Bonus of all nearby party members is increased by 20% for 5s.
abilities.razor: Totem hits = Electro up for party.
abilities.simple: When Sesshou Sakura lightning hits, the party gains 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 5s.

abilities.name: Mischievous Teasing
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Forbidden Art: Daisesshou
abilities.canon: The Sesshou Sakura's attacks will ignore 60% of the opponents' DEF.
abilities.simple: Sesshou Sakura attacks ignore 60% of enemy DEF.

baizhu.name: Baizhu
mistakes: Using his Burst too early: the shields heal and buff the active character, so swap to your damage dealer.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: The Classics of Acupuncture
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 attacks that deal Dendro DMG to opponents in front of him.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of him after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Baizhu plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 Dendro attacks, a Dendro Charged Attack after a short cast, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Universal Diagnosis
abilities.canon:
Controls a Gossamer Sprite that cruises and attacks nearby opponents, dealing Dendro DMG.
After it performs 3 attacks or if there are no opponents nearby, the Sprite will return, healing all nearby party members based on Baizhu's Max HP.
abilities.simple: A Gossamer Sprite attacks nearby enemies with Dendro; after 3 attacks it returns and heals the party.

abilities.name: Holistic Revivification
abilities.canon:
Enters the Pulsing Clarity state, creating a Seamless Shield that absorbs Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness.
While in this state, Baizhu will generate a new Seamless Shield every 2.5s.

The Seamless Shield will heal your own active character based on Baizhu's Max HP and attack opponents by unleashing Spiritveins, dealing Dendro DMG under the following circumstances:
·When a character is under the protection of a Seamless Shield and a new Seamless Shield is generated.
·When the Seamless Shield's effects expire, or when it is shattered.
abilities.simple: Pulsing Clarity: a Seamless Shield (extra strong against Dendro) appears every 2.5s, healing the active character.

abilities.name: Five Fortunes Forever
abilities.canon:
Baizhu gains different effects according to the current HP of your current active character:
·When their HP is less than 50%, Baizhu gains 20% Healing Bonus.
·When their HP is equal to or more than 50%, Baizhu gains 25% Dendro DMG Bonus.
abilities.simple: He gives a different bonus depending on whether the active character’s HP is below or above 50%.

abilities.name: All Things Are of the Earth
abilities.canon: Characters who are healed by Seamless Shields will gain the Year of Verdant Favor effect: Each 1,000 Max HP that Baizhu possesses that does not exceed 50,000 will increase the Burning, Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon reaction DMG dealt by these characters by 2%, their Lunar-Bloom DMG by 0.7%, and the DMG Bonus provided by Aggravate and Spread by 0.8%. This effect lasts 6s.
abilities.simple: Characters healed by Seamless Shields gain Year of Verdant Favor, boosting their Dendro reactions based on Baizhu’s Max HP.

abilities.name: Herbal Nourishment
abilities.canon: When Baizhu is in the party, interacting with certain harvestable items will heal your current active character for 2.5% of Baizhu's Max HP.
abilities.simple: With Baizhu in the party, harvesting some items heals the active character. A world perk.

abilities.name: Attentive Observation
abilities.canon: Universal Diagnosis gains 1 additional charge.
abilities.simple: His Skill gains 1 extra charge.

abilities.name: Incisive Discernment
abilities.canon:
When your own active character hits a nearby opponent with their attacks, Baizhu will unleash a Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
Gossamer Sprite: Splice will initiate 1 attack before returning, dealing 250% of Baizhu's ATK as Dendro DMG and healing for 20% of Universal Diagnosis's Gossamer Sprite's normal healing.
DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
abilities.simple: When the active character hits, he sends out a Gossamer Sprite: Splice for extra damage and healing.

abilities.name: All Aspects Stabilized
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Holistic Revivification by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Holistic Revivification by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Ancient Art of Perception
abilities.canon: For 15s after Holistic Revivification is used, Baizhu will increase all nearby party members' Elemental Mastery by 80.
abilities.simple: For 15s after his Burst the party gains 80 Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: The Hidden Ebb and Flow
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Universal Diagnosis by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Universal Diagnosis by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Elimination of Malicious Qi
abilities.canon:
Increases the DMG dealt by Holistic Revivification's Spiritveins by 8% of Baizhu's Max HP.
Additionally, when a Gossamer Sprite or Gossamer Sprite: Splice hits opponents, there is a 100% chance of generating one of Holistic Revivification's Seamless Shields. This effect can only be triggered once by each Gossamer Sprite or Gossamer Sprite: Splice.
abilities.simple: His Burst’s Spiritveins gain damage from 8% of his Max HP, with extra healing effects.

fundamentals.simple: Baizhu’s Gossamer Sprite attacks with Dendro and comes back to heal; his Burst keeps making Seamless Shields that heal and buff.

wanderer.name: Wanderer
mistakes: Bursting at the start of Windfavored: casting it ends the float.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Yuuban Meigen
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks using wind blades, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina, gathers a build up of high wind pressure, and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of Anemo, the Wanderer plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Anemo wind blades, a wind-pressure Charged Attack, and an Anemo plunge.

abilities.name: Hanega: Song of the Wind
abilities.canon:
Concentrates the power of the winds to break free from the shackles of the earth, dealing AoE Anemo DMG before leaping into the air and entering the Windfavored state.

Windfavored
The Wanderer cannot perform Plunging Attacks in this state. When he uses Normal and Charged Attacks, they will be converted into Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai respectively; the DMG they deal and their AoE will be increased, and their DMG will be considered Normal and Charged Attack DMG respectively. Kuugo: Toufukai will not consume Stamina.
The Wanderer will hover persistently during this time. While this state is active, the Wanderer's movements gain the following properties:
·Persistently consumes Kuugoryoku Points to maintain this hovering state.
·When sprinting, additional Kuugoryoku Points will be consumed for the Wanderer to accelerate mid-air. Holding sprint will cause persistent Kuugoryoku Point consumption to maintain speed. This effect will replace his default sprint.
·Jumping expends extra Kuugoryoku Points to increase hovering height. Holding jump will cause persistent Kuugoryoku Point consumption to keep increasing hovering height.

Running out of Kuugoryoku Points will end the Windfavored state.
A second cast during the duration of Windfavored will also end it.
abilities.simple: Anemo damage, then he leaps into the air in Windfavored: his Normal and Charged Attacks become stronger wind attacks and he can’t plunge.

abilities.name: Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays
abilities.canon:
Compresses the atmosphere into a singular vacuum that grinds all troubles away, dealing multiple instances of AoE Anemo DMG.
If the character is in the Windfavored state due to the skill "Hanega: Song of the Wind," Windfavored state will end after casting.
abilities.simple: Several hits of Anemo damage. If he’s in Windfavored, it ends after the cast.

abilities.name: Jade-Claimed Flower
abilities.canon:
If Hanega: Song of the Wind comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro when it is unleashed, this instance of the Windfavored state will obtain buffs according to the contacted element(s):
·Hydro: Kuugoryoku Point cap increases by 20.
·Pyro: ATK increases by 30%.
·Cryo: CRIT Rate increases by 20%.
·Electro: When Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent, 0.8 Energy will be restored. Energy can be restored this way once every 0.2s.

You can have up to 2 different kinds of these buffs simultaneously.
abilities.simple: If his Skill touches Hydro, Pyro, Cryo or Electro, that Windfavored gets a matching buff: more points (Hydro), ATK (Pyro), CRIT Rate (Cryo) or Energy (Electro).

abilities.name: Gales of Reverie
abilities.canon:
When the Wanderer hits opponents with Kuugo: Fushoudan or Kuugo: Toufukai in his Windfavored state, he has a 16% chance to obtain the Descent effect: The next time the Wanderer accelerates in mid-air while in this instance of the Windfavored state, this effect will be removed, this acceleration instance will not consume any Kuugoryoku Points, and he will fire off 4 wind arrows that deal 35% of his ATK as Anemo DMG each.
For each Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai that does not produce this effect, the next attack of those types will have a 12% increased chance of producing it. The calculation of the effect production is done once every 0.1s.
abilities.simple: His Windfavored attacks have a 16% chance to give Descent: his next mid-air acceleration is free and fires wind arrows.

abilities.name: Strum the Swirling Winds
abilities.canon: Mora expended when ascending Bows and Catalysts is decreased by 50%.
abilities.simple: Halves the Mora cost of ascending bows and catalysts. A crafting perk.

abilities.name: Shoban: Ostentatious Plumage
abilities.canon:
When in the Windfavored state, the Attack SPD of the Wanderer's Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai is increased by 10%.
Additionally, the wind arrows fired by the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie" will deal an additional 25% of his ATK as DMG. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie."
abilities.simple: 10% faster Windfavored attacks, and his wind arrows deal extra damage.

abilities.name: Niban: Isle Amidst White Waves
abilities.canon:
When in the Windfavored state, Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays will see its DMG increased by 4% per point of difference between the max amount of Kuugoryoku Points contrasted with Kuugoryoku's present capacity when using this skill.
Through this method, you can increase Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays's DMG by a maximum of 200%.
abilities.simple: In Windfavored his Burst deals more damage the more Kuugoryoku points he has used.

abilities.name: Sanban: Moonflower Kusemai
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Yonban: Set Adrift into Spring
abilities.canon:
When casting Hanega: Song of the Wind, should the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower" be triggered, the character will gain buffs in correspondence to the contacted Elemental Type(s), and also obtain a random untriggered buff. A maximum of 3 such corresponding elemental buffs can exist simultaneously.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower."
abilities.simple: When his 1st Ascension Passive triggers, he also gets a random buff he didn’t trigger.

abilities.name: Matsuban: Ancient Illuminator From Abroad
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Hanega: Song of the Wind by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Hanega: Song of the Wind by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Shugen: The Curtains' Melancholic Sway
abilities.canon:
When the Wanderer actively hits an opponent with Kuugo: Fushoudan while in the Windfavored state, the following effects will occur:
·Deals an additional instance of Kuugo: Fushoudan at the position hit, dealing 40% of the attack's original DMG. This DMG will be considered Normal Attack DMG.
·When the Wanderer falls below 40 Kuugoryoku Points, restores 4 Points to him. Kuugoryoku Points can be restored in this manner once every 0.2s. This restoration can occur up to 5 times within one Windfavored duration.
abilities.simple: His Windfavored Normal Attacks deal an extra hit, with more benefits when his points run low.

tartaglia.name: Tartaglia
mistakes: Staying in Melee Stance too long: his Skill cooldown grows the longer he stays.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Cutting Torrent
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, the power of Hydro will accumulate on the arrowhead. An arrow fully charged with the torrent will deal Hydro DMG and apply the Riptide status.

Riptide
Opponents affected by Riptide will suffer from AoE Hydro DMG effects when attacked by Tartaglia in various ways. DMG dealt in this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
·Riptide Flash: A fully-charged Aimed Shot that hits an opponent affected by Riptide deals consecutive bouts of AoE DMG. Can occur once every 0.7s.
·Riptide Burst: Defeating an opponent affected by Riptide creates a Hydro burst that inflicts the Riptide status on nearby opponents hit.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
When Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, he cannot perform a plunging attack.
abilities.simple: Up to 6 bow shots. A fully charged Aimed Shot marks enemies with Riptide.

abilities.name: Foul Legacy: Raging Tide
abilities.canon:
Unleashes a set of weaponry made of pure water, dealing Hydro DMG to surrounding opponents and entering Melee Stance.
In this Stance, Tartaglia's Normal and Charged Attacks are converted to Hydro DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion and change as follows:

Normal Attack
Performs up to 6 consecutive Hydro strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a cross slash, dealing Hydro DMG.

Riptide Slash
Hitting an opponent affected by Riptide with a melee attack unleashes a Riptide Slash that deals AoE Hydro DMG. DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Skill DMG, and can only occur once every 1.5s.

After 30s, or when the ability is unleashed again, this skill will end. Tartaglia will return to his Ranged Stance and this ability will enter CD. The longer Tartaglia stays in his Melee Stance, the longer the CD.
If the return to a ranged stance occurs automatically after 30s, the CD is even longer.
abilities.simple: Hydro damage and he switches to Melee Stance: his Normal and Charged Attacks become Hydro slashes. Using it again goes back to ranged.

abilities.name: Havoc: Obliteration
abilities.canon:
Performs different attacks based on what stance Tartaglia is in when casting.

Ranged Stance: Flash of Havoc
Swiftly fires a Hydro-imbued magic arrow, dealing AoE Hydro DMG and applying the Riptide status.
Returns a portion of its Energy Cost after use.

Melee Stance: Light of Obliteration
Performs a slash with a large AoE, dealing massive Hydro DMG to all surrounding opponents, which triggers Riptide Blast.

Riptide Blast
When the obliterating waters hit an opponent affected by Riptide, it clears their Riptide status and triggers a Hydro Explosion that deals AoE Hydro DMG.
DMG dealt in this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG.
abilities.simple: Different attacks depending on his stance: ranged returns Energy and marks Riptide; melee hits harder and bursts Riptide.

abilities.name: Never Ending
abilities.canon: Extends Riptide duration by 8s.
abilities.simple: Riptide lasts 8s longer.

abilities.name: Sword of Torrents
abilities.canon: When Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, on dealing a CRIT hit, Normal and Charged Attacks apply the Riptide status effect to opponents.
abilities.simple: In Melee Stance, critical Normal and Charged Attacks apply Riptide.

abilities.name: Master of Weaponry
abilities.canon: Increases your own party members' Normal Attack Level by 1.
abilities.simple: Raises the Normal Attack level of your own party members by 1.

abilities.name: Foul Legacy: Tide Withholder
abilities.canon: Decreases the CD of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 20%.
abilities.simple: His Skill cooldown is 20% shorter.

abilities.name: Foul Legacy: Understream
abilities.canon: When opponents affected by Riptide are defeated, Tartaglia regenerates 4 Elemental Energy.
abilities.simple: When a Riptide enemy is defeated, he regenerates 4 Energy.

abilities.name: Abyssal Mayhem: Vortex of Turmoil
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Abyssal Mayhem: Hydrospout
abilities.canon:
If Tartaglia is in Foul Legacy: Raging Tide's Melee Stance, triggers Riptide Slash against opponents on the field affected by Riptide every 4s, otherwise, triggers Riptide Flash.
Riptide Slashes and Riptide Flashes triggered by this Constellation effect are not subject to the time intervals that would typically apply to these two Riptide effects, nor do they have any effect on those time intervals.
abilities.simple: In Melee Stance he also triggers Riptide Slash on marked enemies every few seconds.

abilities.name: Havoc: Formless Blade
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Havoc: Obliteration by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Havoc: Obliteration by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Havoc: Annihilation
abilities.canon:
When Havoc: Obliteration is cast in Melee Stance, the CD of Foul Legacy: Raging Tide is reset.
This effect will only take place once Tartaglia returns to his Ranged Stance.
abilities.simple: Casting his Burst in Melee Stance resets his Skill cooldown (once until he leaves Melee Stance).

citlali.name: Citlali
citlali.role: Support: shield, Cryo and RES shred
mistakes: Using her Burst against enemies that can’t be frozen without a reason: her teams often skip it then.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Shadow-Stealing Spirit Vessel
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Calls upon secret arts passed down through the Masters of the Night-Wind from generation to generation, performing up to three strikes that deal Cryo DMG.

Charged Attack
Enters Aiming Mode, and after Holding, consumes a certain amount of Stamina to call forth a Frost Star that deals Cryo DMG to opponents in its path.

Plunging Attack
Gathers the power of Cryo and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals Aoe Cryo DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Cryo strikes, an aimed Frost Star Charged Attack, and a Cryo plunge.

abilities.name: Dawnfrost Darkstar
abilities.canon:
Invoking secret pacts passed down by her tribe over the millennia, Citlali deploys an Opal Shield and calls forth "Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Itzpapa," a creature that is (reputedly) terrifying beyond compare, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG.
The Opal Shield's DMG absorption scales based on Citlali's Elemental Mastery, and absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency. When it is deployed, it will cause Citlali to briefly be affected by Cryo.
After using this skill, Citlali gains 24 Nightsoul points and enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Citlali
When Itzpapa leaves the field, Citlali exits the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Itzpapa
·Itzpapa will follow the character.
·If Citlali has at least 50 Nightsoul points, Itzpapa enters the Opal Fire state and continuously consumes Nightsoul points to whip up a Frostfall Storm that follows the character and attacks opponents within its AoE, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Cryo DMG.
·When Citlali's Nightsoul points are fully depleted, Itzpapa's Opal Fire state also ends.
abilities.simple: An Opal Shield (extra strong against Cryo, scales on her Elemental Mastery) and her creature Itzpapa, which deals Cryo damage.

abilities.name: Edict of Entwined Splendor
abilities.canon: Summons "allies" from the starry skies and the vast earth, hurling forth an ice storm to bombard the area in front and deal Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG. This restores a set amount of Nightsoul points for Citlali, and also summons a Spiritvessel Skull near a maximum of 3 opponents within the AoE, with 1 Skull for each opponent. Spiritvessel Skulls explode after some time, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG and restoring a set amount of Nightsoul points for Citlali.
abilities.simple: A Cryo ice storm that restores her Nightsoul points and leaves Spiritvessel Skulls on up to 3 enemies, which explode later.

abilities.name: Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain
abilities.canon: While Itzpapa is on the field, after nearby party members trigger the Frozen or Melt reactions, the Pyro and Hydro RES of opponents affected by that reaction decreases by 20% for 12s. Additionally, Citlali will regain 16 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul points can be restored this way once every 8s.
abilities.razor: Melt or Freeze = less enemy RES.
abilities.simple: While Itzpapa is out, Frozen or Melt lowers the enemy’s Pyro and Hydro RES by 20% for 12s and restores her Nightsoul points.

abilities.name: Itzpapalotl's Star Garments
abilities.canon:
During the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm DMG is increased by 90% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery. During the Elemental Burst Edict of Entwined Splendor, Ice Storm DMG is increased by 1200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
In addition, when nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Citlali regains 4 Nightsoul points.
abilities.simple: Her Elemental Mastery adds a lot of damage to Itzpapa’s storm and her Burst’s ice storm; party Nightsoul Bursts give her Nightsoul points.

abilities.name: Night Realm's Gift: Smoke, Mirrors, and the Flowing Winds
abilities.canon:
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, can use Nightsoul Transmission: Citlali. When the active character is currently high enough in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Citlali: Citlali will leap up high, and will deploy "White Obsidian Tzitzimitl: Citlalin" to float in the air. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your party.

Holding Aiming Mode will cause Citlali to enter the "Spiritspeaker" state, which will allow her to interact with "Nightspirit Graffiti" and "Nightspirit Sigils," extracting information and power from them. The rules for interacting with these objects follow the same rules as those governing Iktomisaurus interactions.

Additionally, holding the jump button will cause Citlali to consume 75 Stamina and leap. In areas within Natlan where Phlogiston mechanics are present, Citlali will prioritize consuming 5 Phlogiston to leap to a height higher still.
When in the air, Citlali can Hold her Normal Attack to consume Phlogiston or Stamina and enter Aiming Mode and trigger Charged Attacks. When initiating Charged Attacks in mid-air, Citlali will prioritize consuming 20 Phlogiston.
abilities.razor: Natlan travel trick. Not for fighting.
abilities.simple: In Natlan’s Phlogiston areas she has a special Nightsoul Transmission. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Songs of Profound Mystery
abilities.canon:
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, triggering "Nightsoul Burst" restores 20 Phlogiston.
This cannot take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.
abilities.simple: In Natlan’s Phlogiston areas, Nightsoul Burst restores Phlogiston (not in Domains or the Abyss).

abilities.name: Radiant Blades of Centzon Mimixcoah
abilities.canon:
When she uses the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Citlali gains the "Opalstar Vestments" effect until Itzpapa leaves the field. During this time, she will obtain 10 stacks of Stellar Blade. When a nearby active character other than Citlali deals DMG using Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, or Elemental Skills and Bursts, 1 stack of Stellar Blade will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 200% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery.
After nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, Citlali will gain another 3 stacks of Stellar Blade. This effect can trigger once every 8s.

Using the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar will reset Stellar Blade stacks.
Additionally, when Citlali is using her leap, or is Aiming or using her Charged Attack in mid-air, her Phlogiston consumption is decreased by 45%.
abilities.simple: Her Skill gives her Stellar Blade stacks that boost other active characters’ damage.

abilities.name: Heart Devourer's Travail
abilities.canon:
Citlali gains 125 Elemental Mastery, and other characters shielded by her Opal Shield, or who have Itzpapa following them, gain 250 Elemental Mastery.
Additionally, when the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar is used, nearby active characters will also be granted an Opal Shield.

Also, the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" has its effects enhanced:
While Itzpapa is on the field, after nearby party members trigger Frozen or Melt, the opponent(s) affected by this reaction will have their Pyro and Hydro RES additionally decreased by 20% for 12s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Mamaloaco's Frigid Rain" to gain access to the above effect.
abilities.simple: She gains 125 Elemental Mastery, and shielded characters or those followed by Itzpapa gain 250.

abilities.name: Cloud Serpent's Feathered Crown
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Dawnfrost Darkstar by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Dawnfrost Darkstar by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Death Defier's Spirit Skull
abilities.canon: While the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar is active, when Itzpapa's Frostfall Storm hits opponents, an additional Obsidian Spiritvessel Skull will be summoned. When a Spiritvessel Skull summoned this way explodes, it deals 1800% of Citlali's Elemental Mastery as Nightsoul-aligned AoE Cryo DMG and restores 16 Nightsoul points and 8 Energy for Citlali. This effect can trigger once every 8s. This DMG is not considered Elemental Burst DMG.
abilities.simple: Itzpapa’s storm summons an extra Spiritvessel Skull that explodes for big Cryo damage.

abilities.name: Nemontemi's Hex
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Edict of Entwined Splendor by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Edict of Entwined Splendor by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Teoiztac's Secret Pact
abilities.canon:
After being summoned with the Elemental Skill Dawnfrost Darkstar, Itzpapa will always be in the Opal Fire state, and when Nightsoul points are exhausted, this state will not end.
Additionally, when Dawnfrost Darkstar is used, Itzpapa will consume all Nightsoul points, and while it is on the field, it will continuously consume Nightsoul points. Each Nightsoul point consumed in this way will grant Citlali 1 "Cifra of the Secret Law" point.
A maximum of 40 such points can be gained, and each point Citlali possesses will grant all nearby party members a 1.5% Pyro and Hydro DMG Bonus, and increase the DMG Citlali deals by 2.5%.
When Itzpapa leaves the field, or upon using Citlali's Elemental Skill again, all "Cifra of the Secret Law" points she has will be removed.
abilities.simple: Itzpapa stays in its Opal Fire state, and her damage keeps growing while it’s out.

lohen.name: Lohen
mistakes: Ending Masterstroke without using the special Skill: he can use it up to 3 times per mode.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Spear of Favonius — Broken Oath
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform a forward thrust.

Plunging Attack
