Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 spear strikes, a thrust Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Unforeseen Strike
abilities.canon:
As he searches for weaknesses, Lohen switches to Masterstroke mode. While in this state:
· Lohen can actively accumulate Joy, using it to unleash the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul.
· Nearby party members can accumulate Will to Win for Lohen, increasing the DMG dealt by Etched Into Bone and Soul.
Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul up to 3 times while in Masterstroke mode, after which, he will no longer be able to accumulate Joy.
abilities.simple: Switches to Masterstroke mode: he builds Joy to unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul (up to 3 times), and teammates’ damage builds Will to Win to power it.

abilities.name: Manifest Judgment
abilities.canon: Performs a swift series of forward strikes, consuming all Will to Win and dealing Cryo DMG. This DMG will be increased based on the amount of Will to Win consumed. If Lohen is in Masterstroke mode when this is performed, the duration of Masterstroke will be extended by 1.65s.
abilities.simple: Fast Cryo strikes that use all Will to Win for more damage. In Masterstroke mode it extends the mode by 1.65s.

abilities.name: Moratorium on Questioning
abilities.canon: When nearby party members accumulate Will to Win for Lohen by dealing DMG while he is in Masterstroke mode, if that DMG is not less than 3,000% of Lohen's Base ATK, it will accumulate an extra 60 Will to Win.
abilities.simple: In Masterstroke mode, a teammate hit of at least 3,000% of his Base ATK adds an extra 60 Will to Win.

abilities.name: Flippant Masterpiece
abilities.canon: While in Masterstroke mode, for 8s after another nearby party member triggers a Cryo Reaction, that character's ATK is increased by 15%, while Lohen's ATK is increased by 15%.
abilities.simple: In Masterstroke mode, for 8s after a teammate triggers a Cryo reaction, that teammate and Lohen gain 15% ATK.

abilities.name: When the Mood Strikes
abilities.canon:
Lohen gains "High Spirits" for 9s after he unleashes the Elemental Skill Unforeseen Strike: Increases the Skill Level of Unforeseen Strike by 1.
When unleashing an Elemental Skill, if the Level of any other party member's Normal Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst is not lower than Lohen's Elemental Skill Level, the duration of this instance of High Spirits will be increased by an additional 6s.
High Spirits can be gained once every 18s.
abilities.simple: After his Skill he gains High Spirits for 9s: his Skill level rises by 1.

abilities.name: O Breezes, That So Oft Bear Sorrowful Lament
abilities.canon:
Lohen's maximum Will to Win limit is increased to 300% of its original value.
Additionally, when other nearby party members deal DMG while Lohen is in Masterstroke mode, they accumulate 500% as much Will to Win for him as they originally would have.
abilities.simple: His Will to Win limit is 300% of normal, and teammates build it much faster in Masterstroke mode.

abilities.name: In Flight, I Strike Whatever Flies
abilities.canon: When in Masterstroke mode, after the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul hits an opponent or the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment is unleashed, Lohen gains "Evilsbane Blade" for 4s: The next time Lohen hits an opponent with a Normal or Charged Attack while in Masterstroke mode, he will follow up with an additional strike that deals AoE Cryo DMG equal to 500% of his ATK, and increase the Elemental Mastery of other nearby party members by 200 for 8s. Evilsbane Blade can be triggered once every 4s.
abilities.simple: In Masterstroke mode, his special Skill hit or Burst gives him Evilsbane Blade for 4s.

abilities.name: Only the Spear That Wounds Can Heal
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Unforeseen Strike by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Unforeseen Strike by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Radiant Love, Laughing Death
abilities.canon:
When Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment while in Masterstroke mode, his Will to Win will be maxed out, causing this instance of his Elemental Burst to gain the maximum possible DMG increase.

Additionally, when Lohen switches to Masterstroke mode, the following will occur depending on how much Elemental Energy he has:
· When Elemental Energy is not full: Lohen recovers 15 Elemental Energy.
· When Elemental Energy is full: If, during the next 15s, Lohen unleashes the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment, he will recover 15 Elemental Energy.
abilities.simple: His Burst in Masterstroke mode maxes out Will to Win for the biggest damage boost.

abilities.name: Never Ask, Nor Trouble You to Know
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Manifest Judgment by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Manifest Judgment by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: To Drown, to Sink, Unconscious — Supreme Joy
abilities.canon:
Using the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul and hitting an opponent with it or, while Masterstroke mode is active, unleashing the Elemental Burst Manifest Judgment, will not consume any Will to Win. Instead, Lohen's Joy will be maxed out, and if he hits an opponent the next time he uses the special Elemental Skill Etched Into Bone and Soul, the duration of this instance of Masterstroke will be extended by 1.25s. This effect can be triggered once every 7s.
Additionally, the CRIT DMG of all the DMG described above is increased by 175%, and the number of times Lohen can unleash Etched Into Bone and Soul during this instance of Masterstroke is increased by 2.
abilities.simple: His special Skill and Burst in Masterstroke mode no longer use up Will to Win.

fundamentals.simple: Lohen’s Skill starts Masterstroke mode: he builds Joy to use his special Skill up to 3 times, and teammates build Will to Win for it.

mualani.name: Mualani
mistakes: Biting without building Wave Momentum first: surf into enemies before the bite.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Cooling Treatment
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Hydro DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to smack a Pufferball into the air that deals AoE Hydro DMG upon landing.

Plunging Attack
Gathers the power of Hydro and plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Hydro attacks, a Hydro Charged Attack and a plunge.

abilities.name: Surfshark Wavebreaker
abilities.canon:
Combining her mastery of speed and the waves and water, Mualani can surf anytime, anywhere.
After using this skill, Mualani will gain 60 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Mualani
Continuously consume Nightsoul points. When they are depleted or when the skill is used again, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing will end. The state itself has the following traits:
·Mualani mounts her Sharky Surfboard, increasing Mualani's Movement SPD and interruption resistance. Mualani can move on water and liquid Phlogiston while this state is active, and she will take no DMG from the latter.
·Normal Attacks will be converted to Sharky's Bites, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Hydro DMG based on Mualani's Max HP. Sharky's Bites can be used in mid-air. DMG dealt this way is considered Normal Attack DMG.
·When she makes contact with opponents in this state, Mualani applies "Marked as Prey" to them and gains 1 Wave Momentum stack. Max 3 stacks. 1 stack can be gained from the same opponent every 0.7s.

Wave Momentum and Marked as Prey
When Mualani uses Sharky's Bite, her DMG dealt increases based on Wave Momentum stacks. When she has 3 stacks, Sharky's Bite will be converted to Sharky's Surging Bite, further increasing her DMG and removing all her stacks when hitting an opponent.
When Sharky's Bite hits an opponent Marked as Prey, that mark will be removed, and she will fire Shark Missiles at up to 5 nearby opponents Marked as Prey, dealing DMG to them equal to this Sharky's Bite instance and clearing their Marks. If more than 1 opponent is the target of Sharky's Bite and Shark Missiles, the DMG dealt will decrease, decreasing at most to 72% of the original DMG when 3 opponents are targeted.
abilities.simple: She rides Sharky and gains 60 Nightsoul points; hitting enemies builds Wave Momentum, and her next bite deals more damage.

abilities.name: Boomsharka-laka
abilities.canon: Fires a Super Shark Missile that can track opponents, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Hydro DMG based on Mualani's Max HP.
abilities.simple: Fires a homing Super Shark Missile for Hydro damage based on her Max HP.

abilities.name: Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater
abilities.canon: When Sharky's Surging Bite hits an opponent, a Puffer will be generated nearby. Mualani will restore 20 Nightsoul points when she picks up a Puffer. Only 2 such Puffers can be created in this way during a single instance of being in Nightsoul's Blessing.
abilities.simple: Sharky’s Surging Bite leaves a Puffer; picking it up restores Nightsoul points (once each time she enters Nightsoul’s Blessing).

abilities.name: Natlan's Greatest Guide
abilities.canon: After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Mualani will gain 1 stack of Wavechaser's Exploits, which lasts for 20s. Max 3 stacks. When she uses Boomsharka-laka, Mualani will clear all Wavechaser's Exploits stacks and increase the DMG of this Boomsharka-laka by 15%/30%/45% of her Max HP based on the number of stacks cleared.
abilities.simple: Party Nightsoul Bursts give stacks that strengthen her next Shark Missile.

abilities.name: Night Realm's Gift: Crests and Troughs
abilities.canon:
After her Nightsoul points are depleted, Mualani will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, she can use Nightsoul Transmission: Mualani. When the active character is currently sprinting, swimming, in a movement mode caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Mualani: Mualani will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 40 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.

Additionally, Mualani's Nightsoul point or Phlogiston consumption while moving on water and Liquid Phlogiston during Nightsoul's Blessing is decreased by 75% while in Natlan, and her Nightsoul point consumption is decreased by 35% while doing the same outside Natlan.
abilities.simple: When her Nightsoul points run out she keeps surfing with Phlogiston. In Natlan she has Nightsoul Transmission.

abilities.name: The Trick Is to Keep Smiling!
abilities.canon: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, 15 Phlogiston will be restored when interacting with some harvestable items. Additionally, the location of nearby resources unique to Natlan will appear on your mini-map.
abilities.simple: In Natlan’s Phlogiston areas, interacting with some objects restores Phlogiston. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: The Leisurely "Meztli"...
abilities.canon:
The DMG dealt by the first Sharky's Surging Bite after Mualani enters Nightsoul's Blessing and the Shark Missiles it triggers is increased by 66% of Mualani's Max HP. This instance of increased DMG is subject to the diminishing DMG rules of Surfshark Wavebreaker.
In addition, while out of combat, Mualani's Nightsoul's Blessing state consumes 30% less Phlogiston and Nightsoul points.
abilities.simple: Her first Surging Bite after entering Nightsoul’s Blessing deals extra damage.

abilities.name: Mualani, Going All Out!
abilities.canon:
Mualani gains 2 of Surfshark Wavebreaker's Wave Momentum stacks when she enters Nightsoul's Blessing state. She will gain 1 stack when obtaining a Puffer.
In addition, whenever Mualani obtains 2 Puffers within a single instance of the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will recover an additional 12 Nightsoul points over 2s. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."
abilities.simple: She starts with 2 Wave Momentum stacks when entering Nightsoul’s Blessing.

abilities.name: Surfing Atop Joyous Seas
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Surfshark Wavebreaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Surfshark Wavebreaker by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Sharky Eats Puffies
abilities.canon:
Mualani regenerates 8 Energy when obtaining a Puffer. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Heat-Resistant Freshwater Floater."
Additionally, Boomsharka-laka deals 75% increased DMG.
abilities.simple: Each Puffer restores 8 Energy.

abilities.name: Same Style of Surfboard on Sale!
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Boomsharka-laka by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Boomsharka-laka by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Spirit of the Springs' People
abilities.canon: The DMG increase from the Constellation "The Leisurely 'Meztli'..." is no longer limited to being triggered once every Nightsoul's Blessing.
abilities.simple: The bonus damage from C1 is no longer limited to the first bite.

wriothesley.name: Wriothesley
mistakes: Keeping his HP topped up all the time: his Charged Attack combo wants his HP to go down and back up.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Forceful Fists of Frost
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Coalescing frost about his fist, Wriothesley will unleash powerful Repelling Fists, performing up to 5 rapid attacks that deal Cryo DMG.
Apart from this, Normal Attack combo count will not reset for a short time after using Icefang Rush or sprinting.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina to leap and unleash a Vaulting Fist, dealing AoE Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE Cryo DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 Cryo punches and a Cryo Charged Attack. When his HP is low, a special Charged Attack can heal him (see his passive).

abilities.name: Icefang Rush
abilities.canon:
Adjusting his breathing, rhythm, and pace, Wriothesley sprints forward a short distance, entering the Chilling Penalty state and unleashing more powerful attacks than before.

Chilling Penalty
·Increases Wriothesley's interruption resistance
·When his HP is above 50%, it will enhance the Repelling Fists of Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost and increase its DMG. When such an attack hits, it will consume a fixed amount of Wriothesley's HP. HP can be lost this way once every 0.1s.
This effect will be canceled should Wriothesley leave the field.
abilities.simple: He enters Chilling Penalty: his Normal Attacks get stronger, and while his HP is above 50% each one uses a bit of HP.

abilities.name: Darkgold Wolfbite
abilities.canon:
Activating his boxing gloves, Wriothesley strikes out with an icy straight, then uses Icicle Impact to cause multiple instances of AoE Cryo DMG in a frontal area.

Arkhe: Ousia
After Icicle Impact ends, a Surging Blade will descend upon the opponent's position, dealing Ousia-aligned Cryo DMG.
abilities.simple: An icy straight punch, then several Cryo icicle hits in an area.

abilities.name: There Shall Be a Plea for Justice
abilities.canon:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60%, he will obtain a Gracious Rebuke. The next Charged Attack of his Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost will be enhanced to become Rebuke: Vaulting Fist. It will not consume Stamina, will deal 50% increased DMG, and after hitting will restore HP for Wriothesley equal to 30% of his Max HP.
You can gain a Gracious Rebuke this way once every 5s.
abilities.simple: Below 60% HP he gets Gracious Rebuke: his next Charged Attack becomes Rebuke: Vaulting Fist, which deals more damage and heals him.

abilities.name: There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin
abilities.canon: When Wriothesley's current HP increases or decreases, if he is in the Chilling Penalty state conferred by Icefang Rush, Chilling Penalty will gain one stack of Prosecution Edict. Max 5 stacks. Each stack will increase Wriothesley's ATK by 6%.
abilities.simple: While in Chilling Penalty, every change to his HP gives Prosecution Edict stacks that raise his ATK.

abilities.name: The Duke's Grace
abilities.canon: When Wriothesley crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, he has a 10% chance to receive double the product.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: Terror for the Evildoers
abilities.canon:
The Gracious Rebuke from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice" is changed to this:
When Wriothesley's HP is less than 60% or while he is in the Chilling Penalty state caused by Icefang Rush, when the fifth attack of Repelling Fists hits, it will create a Gracious Rebuke. 1 Gracious Rebuke effect can be obtained every 2.5s.

Additionally, Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will obtain the following enhancement:
· The DMG Bonus gained will be further increased to 200%.
· When it hits while Wriothesley is in the Chilling Penalty state, that state's duration is extended by 4s. 1 such extension can occur per 1 Chilling Penalty duration.

You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
abilities.simple: Gracious Rebuke can trigger more often and in more situations.

abilities.name: Shackles for the Arrogant
abilities.canon:
When using Darkgold Wolfbite, each Prosecution Edict stack from the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin" will increase said ability's DMG dealt by 40%.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Reckoning for Sin."
abilities.simple: His Burst deals more damage for each Prosecution Edict stack, and gives the party ATK.

abilities.name: Punishment for the Frauds
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Normal Attack: Forceful Fists of Frost by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Redemption for the Suffering
abilities.canon:
The HP restored to Wriothesley through Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased to 50% of his Max HP. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
Additionally, when Wriothesley is healed, if the amount of healing overflows, the following effects will occur depending on whether he is on the field or not. If he is on the field, his ATK SPD will be increased by 20% for 4s. If he is off-field, all of your own party members' ATK SPD will be increased by 10% for 6s. These two methods of increasing ATK SPD cannot stack.
abilities.simple: Rebuke: Vaulting Fist heals 50% of his Max HP.

abilities.name: Mercy for the Wronged
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Darkgold Wolfbite by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Darkgold Wolfbite by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Esteem for the Innocent
abilities.canon:
The CRIT Rate of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist will be increased by 10%, and its CRIT DMG by 80%. When unleashed, it will also create an additional icicle that deals 100% of Rebuke: Vaulting Fist's Base DMG as Cryo DMG. DMG dealt this way is regarded as Charged Attack DMG.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "There Shall Be a Plea for Justice."
abilities.simple: Rebuke: Vaulting Fist gains CRIT Rate and CRIT DMG, with an extra icicle attack.

nefer.name: Nefer
mistakes: Using Charged Attacks with no Verdant Dew: Phantasm Performance needs at least 1.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Striking Serpent
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 kicks that deal Dendro DMG with the ferocity and grace of a striking serpent.

Charged Attack
Nefer enters the Slither state, consuming Stamina to move rapidly forward for up to 2.5s. When the skill button is released, the duration ends, or Stamina runs out, Nefer will exit the Slither state and consume a certain amount of additional Stamina to deal Dendro DMG to opponents. When in the Shadow Dance state, additional Stamina consumption is decreased.
Additionally, unleashing the Elemental Skill Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights or sprinting while Nefer is in the Slither state will not cause her to exit the state.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Nefer plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 Dendro kicks. Her Charged Attack is Slither: she moves fast, then strikes with Dendro when it ends.

abilities.name: Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights
abilities.canon:
A dance that dissolved dynasties, as chilling as a winter's night on the great sea of sand, yet lingering with the tenderness of moonlit gauze. Nefer charges forward, dealing AoE Dendro DMG and entering the Shadow Dance state.
While in the Shadow Dance state, if you have at least 1 Verdant Dew, Nefer's Charged Attacks will be replaced with the special Charged Attack Phantasm Performance, which will not consume Stamina. When in the Shadow Dance state, Nefer's resistance to interruption is increased.

Two initial charges.
abilities.simple: She charges forward with Dendro and enters Shadow Dance. With at least 1 Verdant Dew, her Charged Attack becomes Phantasm Performance, which costs no Stamina.

abilities.name: Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm
abilities.canon: Grant "revelation" to the mysteries of the false through Thoth's true sight, dealing AoE Dendro DMG to opponents ahead. When unleashed, Nefer will consume all Veils of Falsehood to increase the DMG dealt by the current Elemental Burst.
abilities.simple: Dendro damage ahead. It consumes all her Veils of Falsehood to deal more damage.

abilities.name: A Wager of Moonlight
abilities.canon:
Nefer will be granted the corresponding buff effects based on the party's Moonsign.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When she unleashes her Elemental Skill Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights, any Dendro Cores on the field will be converted to Seeds of Deceit, and any Lunar-Bloom reactions triggered by nearby characters in the following 15s that would create Dendro Cores or Bountiful Cores will instead create Seeds of Deceit. Seeds of Deceit cannot trigger Hyperbloom or Burgeon reactions and will not burst.
When Nefer unleashes a Charged Attack or Phantasm Performance, she can absorb Seeds of Deceit within a certain range, gaining 1 stack of Veil of Falsehood for every seed absorbed. When this effect reaches 3 stacks, or when the third stack's duration is refreshed, Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100 for 8s.
abilities.simple: With Ascendant Gleam, her Skill turns Dendro Cores into Seeds of Deceit and changes Lunar-Bloom reactions for a while.

abilities.name: Daughter of the Dust and Sand
abilities.canon: When Nefer is in the Shadow Dance state, for 5s after a party member triggers a Lunar-Bloom reaction, Nefer's Slither state will provide additional Verdant Dew. Every 100 points of Nefer's Elemental Mastery beyond 500 will strengthen this additional provision effect by 10%. The maximum increase that can be achieved this way is 50%.
abilities.simple: In Shadow Dance, after a party member triggers Lunar-Bloom, Slither gives extra Verdant Dew; more if her Elemental Mastery is above 500.

abilities.name: Moonsign Benediction: Dusklit Eaves
abilities.canon:
When a party member triggers a Bloom reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Nefer has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Nefer is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
abilities.simple: With Nefer in the party, Bloom becomes Lunar-Bloom, and her Elemental Mastery raises its base damage (up to 14%). She also raises the party’s Moonsign.

abilities.name: Conspiracy of the Golden Vault
abilities.canon: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Nod-Krai Expedition for 20 hours.
abilities.simple: 25% more rewards from 20-hour Nod-Krai Expeditions. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Planning Breeds Success
abilities.canon: The Base DMG for Lunar-Bloom reactions caused by Nefer's Phantasm Performance is increased by 60% of her Elemental Mastery. This effect is also boosted by Veil of Falsehood.
abilities.simple: Lunar-Bloom from Phantasm Performance gets extra base damage from her Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: Observation Feeds Strategy
abilities.canon:
Enhances the effects of the Ascension Talent A Wager of Moonlight: Extends Veil of Falsehood's duration by 5s, and increases its stack limit to 5, as well as causing Phantasm Performance to deal up to 140% of its original DMG. When Nefer unleashes her Elemental Skill Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights, she will instantly gain 2 stacks of Veil of Falsehood. Additionally, when Veil of Falsehood reaches 5 stacks, or when the fifth stack's duration is refreshed, Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be increased by 200 for 8s instead.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "A Wager of Moonlight."
abilities.simple: Veils of Falsehood last longer and stack to 5, and Phantasm Performance can deal up to 140% of its normal damage.

abilities.name: Deceit Cloaks the Truth
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Senet Strategy: Dance of a Thousand Nights by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Delusion Ensnares Reason
abilities.canon:
When Nefer is on the field and in the Shadow Dance state, you will gain Verdant Dew 25% faster.
Additionally, while Nefer is in the Shadow Dance state, nearby opponents will have their Dendro RES decreased by 20%. When Nefer exits the Shadow Dance state or after she strays a certain distance away from the opponents, this effect will be removed after 4.5s.
abilities.simple: In Shadow Dance on the field, Verdant Dew comes 25% faster and nearby enemies lose 20% Dendro RES.

abilities.name: Opportunity Hides in the Margins
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Sacred Vow: True Eye's Phantasm by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Victory Flows from the Turning of Tides
abilities.canon:
When Nefer unleashes Phantasm Performance, the second stage of DMG dealt by herself will be converted to deal AoE Dendro DMG equal to 85% of her Elemental Mastery. Additionally, when the attacks from Phantasm Performance end, an extra instance of AoE Dendro DMG equal to 120% of Nefer's Elemental Mastery will be dealt. All of the aforementioned DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG dealt by Phantasm Performance.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
Nefer's Lunar-Bloom DMG is elevated by 15%.
abilities.simple: Phantasm Performance’s second hit turns into Dendro damage based on her Elemental Mastery, with an extra hit when it ends.

diluc.name: Diluc
mistakes: Using the third Skill slash too late: if he waits, the Skill goes on cooldown early.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Tempered Sword
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 claymore strikes, a spinning Charged Attack that uses Stamina over time, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Searing Onslaught
abilities.canon:
Performs a forward slash that deals Pyro DMG.

This skill can be consecutively used 3 times.
Enters CD if not cast again within a short period.
abilities.simple: A Pyro slash that can be used 3 times in a row before going on cooldown.

abilities.name: Dawn
abilities.canon:
Releases intense flames to knock back nearby opponents, dealing Pyro DMG. The flames then converge into the weapon, summoning a Phoenix that flies forward and deals massive Pyro DMG to all opponents in its path. The Phoenix explodes upon reaching its destination, causing a large amount of AoE Pyro DMG.
The searing flames that run down his blade cause it to be infused with Pyro.
abilities.simple: Flames knock enemies back, then a Phoenix flies forward; afterwards his attacks become Pyro for a while.

abilities.name: Relentless
abilities.canon: Diluc's Charged Attack Stamina Cost is decreased by 50%, and its duration is increased by 3s.
abilities.simple: His Charged Attack costs 50% less Stamina and lasts 3s longer.

abilities.name: Blessing of Phoenix
abilities.canon: The Pyro Infusion provided by Dawn lasts for 4s longer. Additionally, Diluc gains 20% Pyro DMG Bonus during the duration of this effect.
abilities.simple: The Pyro infusion from his Burst lasts 4s longer and gives him 20% Pyro DMG Bonus.

abilities.name: Tradition of the Dawn Knight
abilities.canon: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Claymore-type weapons.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: Conviction
abilities.canon: Diluc deals 15% more DMG to opponents whose HP is above 50%.
abilities.simple: 15% more damage to enemies above 50% HP.

abilities.name: Searing Ember
abilities.canon:
When Diluc takes DMG, his ATK increases by 10% and his ATK SPD increases by 5%. Lasts for 10s.
This effect can stack up to 3 times and can only occur once every 1.5s.
abilities.simple: Taking damage gives him ATK and Attack SPD stacks for 10s.

abilities.name: Fire and Steel
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Searing Onslaught by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Searing Onslaught by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Flowing Flame
abilities.canon:
Casting Searing Onslaught in rhythm greatly increases damage dealt.
2s after casting Searing Onslaught, casting the next Searing Onslaught in the combo deals 40% additional DMG. This effect lasts for 2s.
abilities.simple: Using his Skill slashes in rhythm (about 2s apart) greatly increases their damage.

abilities.name: Phoenix, Harbinger of Dawn
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Dawn by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Dawn by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Flaming Sword, Nemesis of the Dark
abilities.canon:
After casting Searing Onslaught, the next 2 Normal Attacks within the next 6s will have their DMG and ATK SPD increased by 30%.
Additionally, Searing Onslaught will not interrupt the Normal Attack combo.
abilities.simple: After his Skill, his next 2 Normal Attacks deal more damage and swing faster.

lauma.name: Lauma
mistakes: Holding her Skill with no Verdant Dew: Hold needs at least 1.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Peregrination of Linnunrata
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks that deal Dendro DMG.

Charged Attack
Lauma undergoes Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis, transforming into an envoy of the tranquil forest and consuming Stamina to charge forward for up to 10s. While in this state, Lauma's interruption resistance is increased, and she can consume additional Stamina to perform up to two consecutive jumps.
When exiting the Spirit Envoy state, Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis will enter cooldown, during which time, Lauma's Charged Attack will be transformed into Spiritcall Prayer: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to deal AoE Dendro DMG to opponents in front of her after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the might of Dendro, Lauma plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Dendro DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Dendro attacks. Her Charged Attack turns her into a forest envoy who charges forward.

abilities.name: Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko
abilities.canon:
Silently incants an ancient hymn, summoning a Frostgrove Sanctuary with different effects depending on whether you Tap or Hold.

Tap
Intone a Hymn of Hunting, dealing AoE Dendro DMG.

Hold
Can be unleashed when you have at least 1 Verdant Dew. Lauma consumes all Verdant Dew and intones a Hymn of Eternal Rest, dealing one regular instance of AoE Dendro DMG and another instance of AoE Dendro DMG that is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. Each Verdant Dew consumed will give Lauma one stack of Moon Song. Each time you Hold to cast an Elemental Skill, a maximum of 3 Verdant Dew can be consumed in this way.

Additionally, when Lauma's Elemental Skill or attacks from Frostgrove Sanctuary hit an opponent, that opponent's Dendro RES and Hydro RES will be decreased for 10s.
abilities.simple: Summons a Frostgrove Sanctuary. Tap: Dendro damage. Hold (needs Verdant Dew): uses all Verdant Dew for Dendro damage plus a hit counted as Lunar-Bloom.

abilities.name: Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon
abilities.canon:
Let the wishes of all beings become as moonlight that bathes the earth. Lauma incants a sacred song of the far north, gaining 18 stacks of Pale Hymn.
Additionally, if Lauma uses her Elemental Burst while she has Moon Song, or she gains Moon Song within 15s of using her Elemental Burst, she will consume all Moon Song stacks and gain 6 stacks of Pale Hymn for every Moon Song stack consumed. This effect can only be triggered once for each Elemental Burst used, including the 15 seconds following its use.

Pale Hymn
When nearby party members deal Bloom, Hyperbloom, Burgeon, or Lunar-Bloom DMG, 1 stack of Pale Hymn will be consumed and the DMG dealt will be increased based on Lauma's Elemental Mastery. If this DMG hits multiple opponents at once, then multiple stacks of Pale Hymn will be consumed, depending on how many opponents are hit.
The duration for each stack of Pale Hymn is counted independently.
abilities.simple: She gains 18 stacks of Pale Hymn, which boost the party’s Bloom-type damage, plus more stacks for any Moon Song she spends.

abilities.name: Light for the Frosty Night
abilities.canon:
For the next 20s after Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, corresponding differing buff effects will be granted depending on the party's Moonsign. The buffs provided by different Moonsign levels cannot stack.

Moonsign: Nascent Gleam
Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG dealt by all nearby party members can score CRIT Hits, with CRIT Rate fixed at 15%, and CRIT DMG fixed at 100%. CRIT Rate from this effect stacks with CRIT Rate from similar effects that allow these Elemental Reactions to CRIT.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam
All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG CRIT Rate +10%, CRIT DMG +20%.
abilities.simple: For 20s after her Skill, the party gets buffs that depend on its Moonsign level.

abilities.name: Cleansing for the Spring
abilities.canon:
Each point of Elemental Mastery Lauma has will give her the following bonuses:
· DMG dealt by her Elemental Skill is increased by 0.04%. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 32%.
· The cooldown of her Charged Attack Spirit Envoy Metamorphosis is reduced by 0.02%. The maximum reduction obtainable this way is 20%.
abilities.simple: Her Elemental Mastery boosts her Skill damage (up to 32%) and shortens her Charged Attack’s cooldown.

abilities.name: Moonsign Benediction: Nature's Chorus
abilities.canon:
When a Bloom reaction is triggered by a party member, it will be converted into the Lunar-Bloom reaction, with every point of Elemental Mastery that Lauma has increasing Lunar-Bloom's Base DMG by 0.0175%, up to a maximum of 14%.

Additionally, when Lauma is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.
abilities.simple: With Lauma in the party, Bloom becomes Lunar-Bloom, and her Elemental Mastery raises its base damage.

abilities.name: Prayers for the Forest
abilities.canon:
Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Nod-Krai on the mini-map.
Additionally, Lauma appears to have a special affinity with some small animals affected by kuuvahki...
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: "O Lips, Weave Me Songs and Psalms"
abilities.canon:
After Lauma uses her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko or her Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon, she will gain Threads of Life for 20s.
During this time, when nearby party members trigger Lunar-Bloom reactions, nearby active characters will recover HP equal to 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 1.9s.
Additionally, the Stamina cost for Lauma's Spirit Envoy Form will be reduced by 40%, and its Max Duration will be extended by 5s.
abilities.simple: After her Skill or Burst she gains Threads of Life for 20s, with benefits when the party reacts.

abilities.name: "Twine Warnings and Tales From the North"
abilities.canon:
The Elemental Burst Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon is enhanced:
· Pale Hymn effects are increased: All nearby party members' Bloom, Hyperbloom, and Burgeon DMG is further increased by 500% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery, and their Lunar-Bloom DMG is further increased by 400% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is increased by 40%.
abilities.simple: Pale Hymn gives the party much more Bloom, Hyperbloom and Burgeon damage based on her Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: "Seek Not to Tread the Sly Fox's Path"
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Runo: All Hearts Become the Beating Moon by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "Nor Yearn for the Great Bear's Might"
abilities.canon: When attacks from the Frostgrove Sanctuary summoned by her Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko hit opponents, Lauma will regain 4 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.
abilities.simple: Frostgrove Sanctuary hits restore 4 Energy (once every 5s).

abilities.name: "If Truth May Be Subject to Witness"
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: "I Offer Blood and Tears to the Moonlight"
abilities.canon:
When the Frostgrove Sanctuary attacks opponents, it will deal 1 additional instance of AoE Dendro DMG equal to 185% of Lauma's Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG. This instance of DMG will not consume any Pale Hymn stacks and will provide Lauma with 2 stacks of Pale Hymn, as well as refreshing the duration of Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner.
This effect can occur up to 8 times during each Frostgrove Sanctuary. When using the Elemental Skill Runo: Dawnless Rest of Karsikko, all Pale Hymn stacks gained in this manner will be removed.

Additionally, when Lauma uses a Normal Attack while she has Pale Hymn stacks, she will consume 1 stack to convert this to deal Dendro DMG equal to 150% of her Elemental Mastery. This DMG is considered Lunar-Bloom DMG.

Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Bloom DMG is elevated by 25%.
abilities.simple: Frostgrove Sanctuary attacks add a Dendro hit equal to 185% of her Elemental Mastery, counted as Lunar-Bloom.

fundamentals.simple: Lauma’s Skill and Burst buff Bloom-type reactions for the party. Holding her Skill spends Verdant Dew for Lunar-Bloom damage.

cyno.name: Cyno
mistakes: Letting his Burst end early: his Skill during the Burst extends it.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Invoker's Spear
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 spear strikes, a Charged Attack and a plunge. During his Burst these become Electro.

abilities.name: Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer
abilities.canon:
Performs a swift thrust, dealing Electro DMG to opponents along the path.

When Cyno is under the Pactsworn Pathclearer state triggered by Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, he will instead unleash a Mortuary Rite that deals thunderous AoE Electro DMG and extends the duration of Pactsworn Pathclearer.
abilities.simple: A swift Electro thrust. During his Burst it changes into Mortuary Rite, which deals more damage and extends the Burst.

abilities.name: Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness
abilities.canon:
Calls upon a divine spirit to indwell him, morphing into the Pactsworn Pathclearer.

Pactsworn Pathclearer
Cyno's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks will be converted to Electro DMG that cannot be overridden.
·Cyno's Elemental Mastery and resistance to interruption will increase, and he gains immunity to Electro-Charged DMG.

This effect will be canceled when Cyno leaves the field and lasts a maximum of 18s.
abilities.simple: He becomes the Pactsworn Pathclearer: his Normal, Charged and Plunging Attacks become Electro and get stronger.

abilities.name: Featherfall Judgment
abilities.canon:
When Cyno is in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state activated by Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, Cyno will enter the Endseer stance at intervals. If he activates Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer while affected by this stance, he will activate the Judication effect, increasing the DMG of this Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer by 35%, and firing off 3 Duststalker Bolts that deal 100% of Cyno's ATK as Electro DMG.
Duststalker Bolt DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.
abilities.simple: During his Burst he periodically gets Endseer: his next Skill also fires Duststalker Bolts for extra damage.

abilities.name: Authority Over the Nine Bows
abilities.canon:
Cyno's DMG values will be increased based on his Elemental Mastery as follows:
· Pactsworn Pathclearer's Normal Attack DMG is increased by 150% of his Elemental Mastery.
· Duststalker Bolt DMG from his Ascension Talent Featherfall Judgment is increased by 250% of his Elemental Mastery.
abilities.simple: His Burst attacks and Duststalker Bolts deal extra damage based on his Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: The Gift of Silence
abilities.canon: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Sumeru Expedition for 20 hours.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: Ordinance: Unceasing Vigil
abilities.canon:
After using Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, Cyno's Normal Attack SPD will be increased by 20% for 10s. If the Judication effect of his Ascension Talent Featherfall Judgment is triggered during Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer, the duration of this increase will be refreshed.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."
abilities.simple: After his Burst, his Normal Attack speed rises by 20% for 10s.

abilities.name: Ceremony: Homecoming of Spirits
abilities.canon: When Cyno's Normal Attacks hit opponents, his Electro DMG Bonus will increase by 10% for 4s. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 5 stacks.
abilities.simple: His Normal Attacks give him Electro DMG Bonus stacks.

abilities.name: Precept: Lawful Enforcer
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Austerity: Forbidding Guard
abilities.canon:
When Cyno is in the Pactsworn Pathclearer state triggered by Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness, after he triggers an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Stellar-Conduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, or Electro Swirl reaction, he will restore 3 Elemental Energy for all nearby party members (except himself.)
This effect can occur 5 times within one use of Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness.
abilities.simple: During his Burst, his Electro reactions restore Energy to the rest of the party.

abilities.name: Funerary Rite: The Passing of Starlight
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Secret Rite: Chasmic Soulfarer by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Raiment: Just Scales
abilities.canon:
After using Sacred Rite: Wolf's Swiftness or triggering the Judication effect of the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment," Cyno will gain 4 stacks of the "Day of the Jackal" effect. When he hits opponents with Normal Attacks, he will consume 1 stack of "Day of the Jackal" to fire off one Duststalker Bolt.
"Day of the Jackal" lasts for 8s. Max 8 stacks. It will be canceled once Pactsworn Pathclearer ends.
A maximum of 1 Duststalker Bolt can be unleashed this way every 0.4s.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Featherfall Judgment."
abilities.simple: After his Burst or an Endseer Skill, his Normal Attacks fire extra Duststalker Bolts.

shikanoinheizou.name: Shikanoin Heizou
mistakes: Using his Skill with no Declension stacks: Swirls and Hold charging build them.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Fudou Style Martial Arts
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 fisticuffs empowered by a mighty wind, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina and performs a sweeping kick that deals Anemo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the surging wind, Heizou plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 Anemo punches, an Anemo Charged Attack and a plunge.

abilities.name: Heartstopper Strike
abilities.canon:
Tap
Wields the swift winds to launch a Heartstopper Strike that deals Anemo DMG.

Hold
Charges energy to unleash an even stronger blow. He will obtain the Declension effect while charging, which will increase the power of the Heartstopper Strike. When the skill button is released or the skill finishes charging, he will strike forward, dealing Anemo DMG.

Declension
Increases the power of the next Heartstopper Strike. Max 4 stacks.
When you possess 4 Declension stacks, the Conviction effect will be produced, which will cause the next Heartstopper Strike to be even stronger and have a larger AoE.
abilities.simple: Tap: a Heartstopper Strike with Anemo. Hold: charge it up for a stronger blow, gaining Declension stacks.

abilities.name: Windmuster Kick
abilities.canon:
Leaps into the air and uses the Fudou Style Vacuum Slugger and kicks his opponent. The Vacuum Slugger will explode upon hit and create an Arresting Windtunnel that pulls in nearby objects and opponents, dealing AoE Anemo DMG.
When Vacuum Slugger hits opponents affected by Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, these opponents will be afflicted with Windmuster Iris. This Windmuster Iris will explode after a moment and dissipate, dealing AoE DMG of the corresponding aforementioned elemental type.
Vacuum Slugger can afflict a maximum of 4 opponents with the Windmuster Iris. A single opponent cannot be under the effect of Windmuster Irises of different elements at the same time.
abilities.simple: A kick that creates an Arresting Windtunnel, pulling enemies in with Anemo damage.

abilities.name: Paradoxical Practice
abilities.canon: When Shikanoin Heizou activates a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction while on the field, he will gain 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s.
abilities.simple: Triggering Swirl or Stellar Swirl on the field gives a Declension stack.

abilities.name: Penetrative Reasoning
abilities.canon: After Shikanoin Heizou's Heartstopper Strike hits an opponent, increases all party members' (excluding Shikanoin Heizou) Elemental Mastery by 80 for 10s.
abilities.simple: When his Heartstopper Strike hits, the rest of the party gains Elemental Mastery.

abilities.name: Pre-Existing Guilt
abilities.canon:
Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.
abilities.simple: Your party uses 20% less Stamina when sprinting. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Named Juvenile Casebook
abilities.canon: For 5s after Shikanoin Heizou takes the field, his Normal Attack SPD is increased by 15%. He also gains 1 Declension stack for Heartstopper Strike. This effect can be triggered once every 10s.
abilities.simple: For 5s after he takes the field, his Normal Attack speed rises by 15%, and he gains a Declension stack.

abilities.name: Investigative Collection
abilities.canon: The pull effect of the Arresting Windtunnel created by Windmuster Kick is enhanced, and its duration is increased to 1s.
abilities.simple: The Windtunnel pulls harder and lasts 1s.

abilities.name: Esoteric Puzzle Book
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Heartstopper Strike by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Heartstopper Strike by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Tome of Lies
abilities.canon:
The first Windmuster Iris explosion in each Windmuster Kick will regenerate 9 Elemental Energy for Shikanoin Heizou. Every subsequent explosion in that Windmuster Kick will each regenerate an additional 1.5 Energy for Heizou.
One Windmuster Kick can regenerate a total of 13.5 Energy for Heizou in this manner.
abilities.simple: His Burst’s first explosion restores 9 Energy.

abilities.name: Secret Archive
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Windmuster Kick by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Windmuster Kick by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Curious Casefiles
abilities.canon: Each Declension stack will increase the CRIT Rate of the Heartstopper Strike unleashed by 4%. When Heizou possesses Conviction, this Heartstopper Strike's CRIT DMG is increased by 32%.
abilities.simple: Each Declension stack adds 4% CRIT Rate to Heartstopper Strike.

fundamentals.simple: Heizou builds Declension stacks, then his Skill’s Heartstopper Strike hits harder and buffs the party’s Elemental Mastery.

noelle.name: Noelle
noelle.role: Main DPS & support: Geo shield healer
mistakes: Using her Burst without her shield up: at C1 having both active guarantees healing.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Favonius Bladework - Maid
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash. 

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 4 claymore strikes, a spinning Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Breastplate
abilities.canon:
Summons protective stone armor, dealing Geo DMG to surrounding opponents and creating a shield. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Noelle's DEF.
The shield has the following properties:
·When Noelle's Normal and Charged Attacks hit a target, they have a certain chance to regenerate HP for all characters.
·Possesses 150% DMG Absorption efficiency against all Elemental and Physical DMG.

The amount of HP healed when regeneration is triggered scales based on Noelle's DEF.
abilities.simple: Geo damage and a shield based on her DEF; her attacks can heal the party while it’s up.

abilities.name: Sweeping Time
abilities.canon:
Gathering the strength of stone around her weapon, Noelle strikes the opponents surrounding her within a large AoE, dealing Geo DMG.
Afterwards, Noelle gains the following effects:
·Larger attack AoE.
·Converts attack DMG to Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Increased ATK that scales based on her DEF.
abilities.simple: A big Geo strike, then larger, Geo-converted attacks with ATK raised based on her DEF.

abilities.name: Devotion
abilities.canon:
When Noelle is in the party but not on the field, this ability triggers automatically when your active character's HP falls below 30%:
Creates a shield for your active character that lasts for 20s and absorbs DMG equal to 400% of Noelle's DEF.
The shield has a 150% DMG Absorption effectiveness against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
This effect can only occur once every 60s.
abilities.simple: Off the field, when the active character’s HP drops low, she gives them a shield (once in a while).

abilities.name: Nice and Clean
abilities.canon:
Noelle will decrease the CD of Breastplate by 1s for every 4 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores on opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.
abilities.simple: Every 4 Normal or Charged Attack hits cut her Skill cooldown by 1s.

abilities.name: Maid's Knighthood
abilities.canon: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a DEF-boosting dish, Noelle has a 12% chance to obtain double the product.
abilities.simple: An exploration or crafting perk. It doesn’t change how you fight.

abilities.name: I Got Your Back
abilities.canon: While Sweeping Time and Breastplate are both in effect, the chance of Breastplate's healing effects activating is increased to 100%.
abilities.simple: With her Burst and shield both active, the shield’s healing always triggers.

abilities.name: Combat Maid
abilities.canon: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Noelle's Charged Attacks by 20% and increases her Charged Attack DMG by 15%.
abilities.simple: Her Charged Attacks cost 20% less Stamina and deal 15% more damage.

abilities.name: Invulnerable Maid
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Breastplate by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Breastplate by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: To Be Cleaned
abilities.canon: When Breastplate's duration expires or it is destroyed by DMG, it will deal 400% of Noelle's ATK as Geo DMG to surrounding opponents.
abilities.simple: When her shield expires or breaks, it deals 400% of her ATK as Geo damage.

abilities.name: Favonius Sweeper Master
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Sweeping Time by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Sweeping Time by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Must Be Spotless
abilities.canon:
Sweeping Time increases Noelle's ATK by an additional 50% of her DEF.
Additionally, every opponent defeated during the skill's duration adds 1s to the duration, up to 10s.
abilities.simple: Her Burst adds ATK equal to 50% of her DEF, and defeating enemies extends it.

fundamentals.simple: Noelle’s shield can heal the party when she attacks; her Burst turns her attacks into Geo and scales them with DEF.

iansan.name: Iansan
iansan.role: Support: ATK for the active character
mistakes: Swapping her in after the damage dealer’s window: her Scale buffs whoever is on the field.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Weighted Spike
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

Nightsoul State: Swift Stormflight
While in the Nightsoul's Blessing state: Iansan's Charged Attack will be transformed into the formidable Swift Stormflight, consuming a certain amount of Stamina to stomp fiercely down, dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 spear strikes and a lunge. In Nightsoul’s Blessing her Charged Attack becomes Swift Stormflight.

abilities.name: Thunderbolt Rush
abilities.canon:
Iansan charges forward a certain distance, dealing Nightsoul-aligned Electro DMG to all opponents in her path.
After this Skill is used, Iansan will regain 54 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state. Within 5s after this is done, using a Normal Attack will trigger 1 quick Swift Stormflight stomp from Iansan that will not consume Stamina.

Nightsoul's Blessing: Iansan
Continuously consumes Nightsoul points. If she runs out, or uses this Skill again, her Nightsoul's Blessing state will end. It has the following properties:
· Increases Iansan's Movement SPD.
· Holding sprint will switch Iansan to Rushing Thunderbolt mode, greatly increasing her Movement SPD temporarily. In this mode, Iansan can make flying leaps using terrain, or consume additional Nightsoul points to move on water or liquid Phlogiston while being immune to DMG from the latter.
abilities.simple: An Electro charge that gives her 54 Nightsoul points and Nightsoul’s Blessing; a Normal Attack within 5s does a free Swift Stormflight stomp.

abilities.name: The Three Principles of Power
abilities.canon:
Iansan's stomping foot shatters the very earth with "Power," dealing Nightsoul-aligned AoE Electro DMG. She then whips out her "Limited-Edition Kinetic Energy Scale (For Workouts)."
When this Skill is used, Iansan will gain 15 Nightsoul points and enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state.
When the Kinetic Energy Scale leaves the field, Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state will end.

Kinetic Energy Scale
The Kinetic Energy Scale will follow the character around, boosting the ATK of your current active party member in different ways based on Iansan's Nightsoul points.
· If Iansan has less than 42 Nightsoul points, the ATK bonus will be based on her Nightsoul points and ATK.
· If Iansan has at least 42 Nightsoul points, the Kinetic Energy Scale will switch to the "Ardent Support!" state, in which the ATK bonus will be stronger and based on her ATK alone.
Additionally, the Scale will log the distance your current active character (excluding Iansan) has moved so long as it is active, restoring Nightsoul points to Iansan every second based on the distance moved in the previous second.
The Scale will disappear once her Nightsoul's Blessing state ends. It will also disappear after 1 second when you are not in a state of combat. While it is active, Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state will not end even if she is not on the field.
abilities.simple: Electro damage, then her Kinetic Energy Scale comes out and powers up the active character. Her Nightsoul’s Blessing ends when it leaves.

abilities.name: Enhanced Resistance Training
abilities.canon:
After Swift Stormflight hits opponents, Iansan will gain the Precise Movement effect for 15s.
During this time, her ATK is increased by 20%, and whenever she regains Nightsoul points through the Kinetic Energy Scale in her Elemental Burst, The Three Principles of Power, she will gain 1 extra Nightsoul point. Additionally, when your current active party member consumes or restores Nightsoul points, the extra Nightsoul points Iansan gains the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale will be increased to 4. This effect can occur once every 2.8s.
"Precise Movement" will expire when Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.
abilities.simple: After Swift Stormflight hits, she gains 20% ATK and extra Nightsoul points from her Scale for 15s.

abilities.name: Kinetic Energy Gradient Test
abilities.canon:
When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Iansan will obtain the Warming Up effect for 10s.
During this time, when Iansan restores at least 1 Nightsoul point, she will heal your current active character for 60% of her ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 2.8s.
abilities.simple: After a party Nightsoul Burst, she heals the active character for 60% of her ATK when she restores Nightsoul points (once every 2.8s).

abilities.name: Night Realm's Gift: Hard Work and Drive
abilities.canon:
After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted and Iansan is on the field, she will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Iansan can be used. When the current active character is sprinting or in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Iansan will trigger the following: Iansan enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and obtains 25 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party.
While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Iansan will not take fall DMG when using terrain differences to make leaps.
abilities.simple: On the field with no Nightsoul points left, she uses Phlogiston to stay in Nightsoul’s Blessing. In Natlan she has Nightsoul Transmission.

abilities.name: Caloric Balancing Plan
abilities.canon: While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, regain 10 Phlogiston when Phlogiston levels drop below 50%. This can occur once every 10s.
abilities.simple: In Natlan’s Phlogiston areas she restores Phlogiston when it runs low. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: Starting's Never Easy
abilities.canon: When Iansan is in combat and is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will restore 15 Elemental Energy for every 6 Nightsoul points she consumes. This effect can trigger once every 18s.
abilities.simple: In Nightsoul’s Blessing she restores 15 Energy for every 6 Nightsoul points used (once every 18s).

abilities.name: Laziness is the Enemy!
abilities.canon: When using the Elemental Burst The Three Principles of Power, Iansan will also gain the Precise Movement effect from her Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" for 15s. Additionally, if Iansan is off-field while Precise Movement is active, she will also increase your current active character's ATK by 30%. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" to access the above effect.
abilities.simple: Her Burst also gives her Precise Movement, with extra effects while she’s off-field.

abilities.name: Scientific Diet Planning
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Thunderbolt Rush by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Thunderbolt Rush by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Slow and Steady Wins the Race
abilities.canon:
When the Kinetic Energy Scale is present, Iansan will gain 2 stacks of Surging Force after your current active character (excluding herself) uses their Elemental Burst. The stacks last until the Scale leaves the field, and Surging Force can be gained once per Scale summoning. Whenever Iansan restores Nightsoul points via the Scale, she will consume 1 Surging Force stack and restore 4 additional Nightsoul points.
Additionally, if her Nightsoul restoration from the Scale overflows, Iansan will gain 50% of the overflow the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale.
abilities.simple: While her Scale is out, she gets Surging Force when the active character uses their Burst.

abilities.name: We Can Push It Further!
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of The Three Principles of Power by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of The Three Principles of Power by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Teachings of the Collective of Plenty
abilities.canon:
The Kinetic Energy Scale's duration is increased by 3s.
Additionally, when Iansan triggers Nightsoul point restoration, if there is any overflow, she will gain the Extreme Force effect, which increases the DMG dealt by your current active character by 25% for 3s.
abilities.simple: The Scale lasts 3s longer, and overflowing Nightsoul restoration gives the active character 25% more damage for 3s.

rosaria.name: Rosaria
rosaria.role: Support: Cryo and CRIT Rate share
mistakes: Using her Burst last: teammates should get her CRIT Rate share before the damage window.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Spear of the Church
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
abilities.simple: Up to 5 spear strikes, a Charged Attack, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Ravaging Confession
abilities.canon:
Rosaria swiftly shifts her position to appear behind her opponent, then stabs and slashes them with her polearm, dealing Cryo DMG.
This ability cannot be used to travel behind opponents of a larger build.
abilities.simple: She moves behind the enemy and stabs and slashes for Cryo damage (not behind very large enemies).

abilities.name: Rites of Termination
abilities.canon:
Rosaria's unique take on this prayer ritual: First, she swings her weapon to slash surrounding opponents; then, she summons a frigid Ice Lance that strikes the ground. Both actions deal Cryo DMG.
While active, the Ice Lance periodically releases a blast of cold air, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents.
abilities.simple: Slashes nearby enemies, then an Ice Lance strikes the ground and keeps dealing Cryo damage.

abilities.name: Regina Probationum
abilities.canon: When Rosaria strikes an opponent from behind using Ravaging Confession, Rosaria's CRIT Rate increases by 12% for 5s.
abilities.simple: Hitting from behind with her Skill gives her 12% CRIT Rate for 5s.

abilities.name: Shadow Samaritan
abilities.canon:
Casting Rites of Termination increases CRIT Rate of all nearby party members (except Rosaria herself) by 15% of Rosaria's CRIT Rate for 10s.
CRIT Rate Bonus gained this way cannot exceed 15%.
abilities.simple: Her Burst gives other party members CRIT Rate equal to 15% of hers.

abilities.name: Night Walk
abilities.canon:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.
abilities.simple: At night your party moves a little faster. A world perk.

abilities.name: Unholy Revelation
abilities.canon: When Rosaria deals a CRIT Hit, her ATK SPD increases by 10% and her Normal Attack DMG increases by 10% for 4s.
abilities.simple: Her CRIT hits give 10% Attack SPD and 10% Normal Attack damage for 4s.

abilities.name: Land Without Promise
abilities.canon: The duration of the Ice Lance created by Rites of Termination is increased by 4s.
abilities.simple: The Ice Lance lasts 4s longer.

abilities.name: The Wages of Sin
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Ravaging Confession by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Ravaging Confession by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Painful Grace
abilities.canon:
Ravaging Confession's CRIT Hits regenerate 5 Energy for Rosaria.
Can only be triggered once each time Ravaging Confession is cast.
abilities.simple: A critical Skill hit restores 5 Energy.

abilities.name: Last Rites
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Rites of Termination by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Rites of Termination by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: Divine Retribution
abilities.canon: Rites of Termination's attack decreases opponents' Physical RES by 20% for 10s.
abilities.simple: Her Burst lowers enemies’ Physical RES by 20% for 10s.

fundamentals.simple: Rosaria’s Skill strikes from behind; her Burst leaves an Ice Lance that keeps dealing Cryo and shares CRIT Rate with the team.

charlotte.name: Charlotte
mistakes: Using Tap Skill when you need marks on many enemies: Hold covers more targets.

sources.name: PawPixl explanations (Claude development session (checked against genshin-db 5.2.15 text))

abilities.name: Cool-Color Capture
abilities.canon:
Normal Attack
Taking aim at targets using Monsieur Verite, her custom Kamera, Charlotte performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Cryo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a fixed amount of Stamina, and after a moment's preparation, will deploy Monsieur Verite to deal AoE Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Gathering the power of Cryo, Charlotte plunges toward the ground, dealing DMG to all opponents in her path and dealing AoE Cryo DMG upon landing.

Arkhe: Pneuma
At certain intervals, upon using a Charged Attack, Charlotte will cause a Spiritbreath Thorn to descend and pierce opponents, dealing Pneuma-aligned AoE Cryo DMG.
abilities.simple: Up to 3 Cryo attacks, a Cryo Charged Attack after a short cast, and a plunge.

abilities.name: Framing: Freezing Point Composition
abilities.canon:
Using the keen instincts of an ace reporter, Charlotte uses her photography skills to produce different effects based on whether the ability is Tapped or Held.

Tap
Takes a snapshot using Monsieur Verite, dealing AoE Cryo DMG to opponents in front of her and applying Snappy Silhouette to a maximum of 5 opponents. During this effect's duration, it will deal Cryo DMG to affected opponents at intervals.

Hold
Popping Monsieur Verite's viewfinder open, Charlotte enters Composition Mode, and during this time, the viewfinder will expand as you hold until you reach a Finisher Frame state. In this state, Charlotte can move and change direction freely.
When the hold state ends, Monsieur Verite will deal Cryo DMG to all opponents locked on within the viewfinder, and apply the same Snappy Silhouette as Tap Mode does to them. If you unleash this ability only after reaching Finisher Frame, you will instead apply Focused Impression, which lasts longer and deals more DMG, although the Skill CD will be longer.
Composition Mode lasts a maximum of 15s and allows a maximum of 5 opponents to be selected.
abilities.simple: Tap: a snapshot deals Cryo damage and marks the enemy. Hold: aim and mark several enemies for a bigger effect.

abilities.name: Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation
abilities.canon:
Condensing ice to create The Steambird's signature, Charlotte creates a Newsflash Field that will deal AoE Cryo DMG and restores HP for all nearby party members based on Charlotte's ATK.
Newsflash Field
·While the ability is active, Monsieur Verite will deal Cryo DMG at intervals to opponents within its AoE.
·Will continuously restore HP to active character(s) within its AoE based on Charlotte's ATK.
abilities.simple: Cryo damage and healing for the party, then a Newsflash Field where Monsieur Verite deals Cryo damage and keeps healing.

abilities.name: Moment of Impact
abilities.canon: When opponents marked by "Focused Impression" are defeated, Framing: Freezing Point Composition's CD will be decreased by 2s. This CD decrease can be triggered 4 times every 12s.
abilities.simple: Defeating enemies marked by Focused Impression shortens her Skill cooldown by 2s.

abilities.name: Diversified Investigation
abilities.canon: When the party contains 1/2/3 Fontainians other than herself, Charlotte gains a 5%/10%/15% Healing Bonus. When the party contains 1/2/3 non-Fontainians, Charlotte gains a 5%/10%/15% Cryo DMG Bonus.
abilities.simple: Fontaine party members give her Healing Bonus; other party members give her Cryo DMG Bonus.

abilities.name: First-Person Shutter
abilities.canon: After activating the Special Analysis Zoom Lens, Charlotte's "Framing: Freezing Point Composition" Hold Mode cannot trigger its original effects, but instead enables her to take photos in a rather unique manner...
abilities.simple: After using her Special Analysis Zoom Lens, her Hold Skill works differently. An exploration perk.

abilities.name: A Need to Verify Facts
abilities.canon: After Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation heals a character, it will mark them with Verification, which will heal them once every 2s for 80% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect lasts 6s.
abilities.simple: Characters healed by her Burst get Verification, which heals them again over time.

abilities.name: A Duty to Pursue Truth
abilities.canon: When using Framing: Freezing Point Composition, when Monsieur Verite hits 1/2/3 (or more) opponents, Charlotte's own ATK will be increased by 10%/20%/30% for 12s.
abilities.simple: Her Skill raises her ATK depending on how many enemies Monsieur Verite hits.

abilities.name: An Imperative to Independence
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: A Responsibility to Oversee
abilities.canon: When Still Photo: Comprehensive Confirmation hits an opponent marked by Snappy Silhouette or Focused Impression, it will deal 10% more DMG and restore 2 Energy to Charlotte. This restoration can be triggered 5 times every 20s.
abilities.simple: Her Burst deals more damage to marked enemies and restores Energy.

abilities.name: A Principle of Conscience
abilities.canon:
Increases the Level of Framing: Freezing Point Composition by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.
abilities.simple: Raises the level of Framing: Freezing Point Composition by 3 (max 15). More damage, same buttons.

abilities.name: A Summation of Interest
abilities.canon: When the active character's Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent marked by Framing: Freezing Point Composition's Focused Impression, Monsieur Verite will initiate a coordinated attack that deals 180% of Charlotte's ATK as AoE Cryo DMG and heals active character(s) within the AoE for 42% of Charlotte's ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 6s and both DMG and healing dealt in this way will be considered as having been done by Charlotte's Elemental Burst.
abilities.simple: When the active character’s Normal and Charged Attacks hit a Focused Impression enemy, she follows up with extra damage and healing.

fundamentals.simple: Charlotte marks enemies with her camera Skill and her Burst creates a Newsflash Field that heals the party.
